item.g:title: Barbour Foley Slipper Brown
item.g:description: The Barbour Foley Slippers comes with a branded badge on the side, featuring a slip-on style wear and suede upper. Coming in Camel colour, these slippers sport a cushioned footbed and strap. These slippers are made from recycled plastic bottles. Wipe with damp cloth Suede

item.g:description: Ideal for pairing with Barbour wellingtons, these knee-length socks are made in a merino-wool blend with a terry-loop inner and a stretch cuff for enhanced grip. Super soft and incredibly warm, they're detailed with linked toe seams for a smooth, comfortable finish. item.g:title: Beretta B-Xtreme GTX Jacket Veil Avayde
item.g:description: The Beretta B-Xtreme GTX Jacket is designed especially for waterfowl hunting where gear durability and protection from the elements are essential. It is waterproof, windproof, and extremely durable thanks to the Gore-Tex 3L Tricot Laminate this jacket is constructed with. The Gore-Tex 3L Tricot Laminate this jacket is constructed of makes it waterproof, windproof, and extremely durable. In addition, this jacket is very breathable which prevents overheating during strenuous activity but allows heat retention when stopped. To make this jacket even tougher critical areas are reinforced with a fabric containing 16% Kevlar®. The cuff is made of Gore-Tex stretch material that is extremely elastic and waterproof. This jacket is available in Veil Avayde™, an advanced Waterfowl Concealment Camo designed for reeds and marshes. Designed for duck hunting where wetlands, potholes, small lakes and swamps are the main environments, the waterfowler articles guarantee waterproofness, breathability and resistance. Features Ergonomic hood Waterproof YKK zip 2 YKK zippered chest pockets 2 front pockets with inside reinforcement 2 ventilation YKK zips under the arms Reinforced inserts with Kevlar ® Velcro wrist regulation Utility welded tape call for ducks Beretta rubber logo on left sleeve Fitting: comfort fit

item.g:title: Beretta Tosark Pants Green Moss
item.g:description: Designed specifically for silent hunting, Tosark men's hunting trousers provide waterproof and breathable protection. Crafted with soft, noiseless microfiber and elastic inserts for greater mobility, they feature the Beretta Waterproof Breathable (BWB) EVO membrane and Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment. Easily combined with the Tosark or Tri-Active EVO jacket, these trousers are perfect for the Open Country environment where silent, breathable protection is necessary.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kaipak Trousers Black Regular Leg
item.g:description: Hardwearing trekking trousers in G-1000 Eco with recycled polyester/organic cotton – Kaipak Trousers M are casual yet technical trekking trousers that work just as well on the trail as for everyday use. They are slightly wind and shower resistant, and readily release moisture when the pace picks up. The hybrid construction has stretch panels at the waist, crotch and back of the knees, and the articulated cut with pre-shaped knees and rear provides good freedom of movement. Two large leg pockets with discreet bellows, two hand pockets and leg endings with adjustments and boot hooks. Wind- and water-resistant G-1000 Eco with recycled polyester/organic cotton. Stretch panels at the waist, crotch and back of knees for freedom of movement. Two large leg pockets with discreet bellows, two hand pockets. Articulated cut with pre-shaped knees and rear. Leg endings with adjustments and boot hooks. Adaptable with Greenland Wax, Durable, Water-resistant, Wind resistant, Stretch

item.g:description: The¬†Fjallraven Ovik Fleece Hoodie is a casual item which is ideal for layering when out and about. This hoodie is really practical with a full zip close and two concealed zip close waist pockets all with with branded tan leather pull tabs. Made from a polyester and cotton mix with reinforced elbow/lower arms, this is a comfortable yet hard-wearing item. A tan leather brand badge is located on the left arm and a small woven Swedish flag can be found on the lower left seam paying respect to the brand's heritage.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Stina Jacket Indigo Blue
item.g:description: Made from durable G-1000® Lite with G-1000® Original reinforcing the shoulders, the Fjallraven Women's Stina Jacket in Indigo Blue is a practical everyday layer and one of the more wearable women's everyday jackets in the range. A fixed hood sits close around the face without blocking your view, while pre-shaped sleeves keep movement easy. Two vertical zipped pockets sit discreetly under the chest for small essentials, and a two-way front zip with an inner flap seals out the wind. The hem is adjustable and the cuffs fasten with buttons. The fabric can be treated with Greenland Wax for added water resistance. Features Outer: G-1000® Lite (65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton) with G-1000® Original reinforcements Fixed hood Pre-shaped sleeves Two-way front zip with inside flap Two vertical chest pockets and two hand pockets Adjustable hem and buttoned cuffs Adaptable with Greenland Wax Care: machine wash 40°C

item.g:description: Wet, muddy trails are part of the experience, but wet feet don't need to be. Enjoy dry feet and a superlight feel as you move from road to trail and back in these adidas trail running shoes. A breathable GORE-TEX membrane seals out wet conditions while ultralight Lightstrike cushioning encourages speed and agility over rough terrain. Confident traction across wet and dry ground is a given with the lugged Continental™ Rubber outsole. Regular fit Lace closure Engineered mesh upper with mudguard and suede tongue Breathable and stable feel GORE-TEX lining LIGHTSTRIKE cushioning Weight: 320 g (size UK 8.5) Midsole drop: 8 mm Continental™ Rubber outsole Upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content

item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Graphic Mountain 2.0 T-Shirt Black
item.g:description: Experience comfort and let your imagination roam freely with this Adidas Terrex t-shirt, designed to provide ultimate comfort after a day of adventure: Material: Crafted from soft cotton jersey, this t-shirt ensures a gentle and comfortable feel against your skin. It's the perfect choice for unwinding after a long day of outdoor exploration. Design: Featuring a bold Terrex graphic on the back, this t-shirt adds an adventurous and outdoorsy touch to any outfit. Whether you're in your backyard or exploring remote locations, this t-shirt complements your style and showcases your love for the outdoors. Partnership: Adidas partners with Better Cotton to support and improve global cotton farming practices. Better Cotton focuses on making cotton production better for the people involved, the environment, and the future of the cotton sector. The use of Better Cotton in this t-shirt reflects Adidas' commitment to sustainable and responsible sourcing. Sourcing: Better Cotton used in this t-shirt is sourced through a chain-of-custody model called mass balance. While Better Cotton may not be physically traceable to the end product, it ensures that the demand for Better Cotton benefits the farmers who produce it in equivalent volumes. The adidas Terrex t-shirt is more than just a comfortable piece of clothing; it represents a commitment to sustainability, comfort, and an adventurous spirit. Whether you're relaxing at home or venturing into the great outdoors, this t-shirt is designed to accompany you on your journey.

item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Mt Rr Jacket 2. 0 Black
item.g:description: This adidas hiking jacket keeps you dry and feeling ready for the adventure ahead. Breathable and fully seam-sealed with an adjustable hem, hood and cuffs, it stands up to foul weather. RAIN.RDY blocks wind and channels rain away from your body. The shoulder seams are shifted back for extra comfort when wearing a backpack. Zip your keys and smart phone or other important items inside the inner pocket and head out in the right frame of mind. Made with a series of recycled materials, and at least 60% recycled content, this product represents just one of our solutions to help end plastic waste. • Regular fit • Full zip with adjustable hood and chin guard • Waterproof 100% recycled plain woven polyester and ripstop • Mesh lining • RAIN.RDY • Front zip pockets and inner zip pocket • Adjustable cuffs • Slightly longer back with Terrex adjustable hem • Fully seam-sealed • Ripstop

item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Swift R3 Mid Gore-Tex Hiking Shoes Bludaw / Grefou / Impora
item.g:description: Gear up for the adventure in these men's Swift R3 Mid GORE-TEX boots from adidas Terrex. In a Core Black colourway, these boots have a breathable mesh upper with supportive seamless overlays. They feature a waterproof GORE-TEX membrane for lasting wear, and have a speed lacing system with a padded mid-cut collar for a secure fit. They have a molded sockliner and a cushioned EVA midsole for comfy wear, and a grippy Continental Rubber outsole for total traction when you take on the terrain. Finished with signature adidas branding throughout

item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Trailmaker Mid Cold.Rdy Hiking Boots Shadow Brown / Wonder Silver / Semi Flash Aqua
item.g:description: The Adidas Terrex Trailmaker Mid Cold.Rdy Hiking Boots are designed for those who love adventure, even in cold weather. Here's what you can expect: Features: COLD.RDY Insulation: These boots are equipped with COLD.RDY technology provides excellent insulation to keep your feet warm and comfortable in cold conditions. Traxion Outsole: The Traxion outsole offers exceptional grip in all directions, ensuring you stay steady on various terrains. Lightweight Design: These boots are lightweight, allowing you to move quickly and comfortably as you transition from town to trail and back. Recycled Materials: They are made with recycled materials, which include production waste like cutting scraps and post-consumer household waste. item.g:title: Beretta Bryce GTX Boots Forest
item.g:description: Introducing the Bryce GTX hiking boots, meticulously crafted for hunting in temperate climates, ensuring both performance and comfort: Weather-Ready: These boots feature Gore-Tex Prism lining, offering guaranteed waterproofing and breathability. No matter the conditions, your feet will stay dry and comfortable. Durability: The boots are designed to withstand the rigors of outdoor activities. They feature coated crust leather reinforcements that provide protection all around the foot. The PU sole ensures long-lasting durability, allowing you to enjoy these boots over an extended period. Improved Mobility: The boots have a reduced height, enhancing your mobility and agility while navigating various terrains. Tech Outdoor Shoes & Boots: This range includes different models, each with unique combinations of materials and Vibram® soles, ensuring complete stability and traction. The soles are equipped with self-cleaning channels, and toe and heel wings for enhanced grip on rocky surfaces. Comfort and Support: An antishock polyurethane intersole reduces joint stress, guaranteeing a comfortable and stable fit. The GORE-TEX membrane ensures waterproofness and warmth, even in the most extreme conditions. The Bryce GTX hiking boots are your reliable companion for outdoor adventures in temperate climates. Whether you're hunting or hiking, these boots provide the protection, durability, and comfort you need to tackle diverse terrains and weather conditions.

item.g:title: Beretta Waterproof Gloves Green Moss
item.g:description: Introducing the Beretta Waterproof Gloves in Green Moss – the ultimate solution for reliable protection and optimum comfort in challenging weather conditions. Specially crafted to withstand the cold and wet elements, these gloves are perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, shooters, hunters, and anyone requiring quality waterproof and breathable hand protection. Experience the perfect blend of functionality, comfort, and peace of mind with our Beretta Waterproof Gloves. Key Features: BWB EVO Membrane: These gloves are constructed with the BWB EVO membrane, which is designed to offer complete waterproofing, wind protection, and excellent breathability. This membrane ensures that your hands stay dry and comfortable in wet and windy conditions. Waterproof: As the name suggests, these gloves are waterproof, making them an ideal choice for activities in wet and rainy weather. Breathable: While providing waterproofing, these gloves are also breathable. This feature helps prevent moisture buildup inside the gloves, ensuring your hands stay comfortable and dry. Silent: These gloves are designed to be silent, which is particularly important for hunting and other activities where noise control is essential. Temperature Range: These gloves are suitable for temperatures ranging from 0 to 10 degrees Celsius, making them well-suited for cold to cool weather conditions. Touchscreen Index Finger: The gloves feature a touchscreen-compatible index finger, allowing you to use touch-screen devices without having to remove them. Elasticated Neoprene Wrist: The elasticated neoprene wrist ensures a secure and comfortable fit, helping to keep out moisture and cold air. Non-Slip Palm Insert: A non-slip palm insert is included for a secure grip, especially in wet conditions. Printed Beretta Logo: The gloves proudly display the Beretta logo, representing the brand's identity.

item.g:title: Beretta Watershield Gloves Green
item.g:description: Introducing the Men's Beretta Watershield Gloves in Green - the ultimate shooting gloves that combine performance and functionality. Crafted with Polartec® Windpro® and WRT (Water Resistant Technology) membrane, these gloves are windproof, ensuring optimal comfort in varying weather conditions. The fingertip inserts enable the use of touchscreen devices, allowing for seamless communication while on the move. With their thin construction and anti-slip gripping palm insert, these gloves provide a comfortable trigger pull, enhancing your shooting accuracy. Designed for a wide range of outdoor activities, from hiking and hunting to sports shooting, these gloves are the perfect companion for any shooting enthusiast. Experience superior performance and versatility with the Men's Beretta Watershield Gloves. Key Features: Touch-screen inserts on the index fingertip. Elastic Neoprene cuff. The Beretta logo printed on the cuff. Anti-slip and gripping palm insert.

item.g:title: Beretta Wilton Crew Neck Tech Sweater Brownbark / Moss
item.g:description: Introducing the Men's Beretta Wilton Crew Neck Tech Sweater, a warm and cosy wool blend knit designed to protect from the cold while offering practical features for outdoor activities: Material: Crafted from a warm and comfortable wool blend, this sweater is ideal as a mid-layer for hunting in the field. It boasts nylon shoulder and elbow inserts, which enhance its durability. These inserts are also treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) finish, making them water-resistant and adding to the sweater's practicality. Additionally, it has been treated with an antibacterial finish to reduce odours, ensuring freshness even during extended use. Features: Regular fit for a comfortable and classic look. Crew neck design. Ribbed cuffs and hem for a snug fit and added style. Composition: The sweater is made from a blend of 50% wool, 30% polyester, and 20% viscose, ensuring warmth, comfort, and durability. The Men's Beretta Wilton Crew Neck Tech Sweater is a versatile and functional garment, perfect for keeping you warm and protected during outdoor pursuits, particularly hunting. Its combination of wool, water-resistant inserts, and antibacterial treatment make it a practical choice for staying comfortable and odor-free in the field.

item.g:title: Beretta Wolf GTX Boots Forest Night
item.g:description: Wolf GTX boots are crafted to provide maximal comfort while undertaking active pursuits, like hunting. The GORE-TEX Carbon membrane ensures the waterproofness of the boots in unfavorable climates. The upper is made of Cordura® for excellent breathability, while structural, anti-abrasion polymer inserts boosts durability and are applied with HF technology. Feet remain dry and clean, due to the OrthoLite® arch support and 3D Mesh lining that facilitate sweat evaporation. Additionally, the Vibram® Omnify sole ensures great mobility, shock absorption and traction across all surfaces.

item.g:title: Beretta Womens Extrelle Active EVO Jacket Green
item.g:description: The Beretta Women's Extrelle Active EVO Jacket in Green is designed for active pursuits in silent environments and offers various features to enhance your outdoor experience. Key Features: Waterproof and Breathable: The jacket is equipped with the BWB EVO (Beretta Waterproof Breathable EVO) membrane, ensuring it is both waterproof and breathable, keeping you dry and comfortable. Abrasion-Resistant Inserts: The jacket features abrasion-resistant inserts on the shoulder and elbow areas, increasing its durability and longevity. Elastic Inserts: Elastic inserts under the arms provide freedom of movement, allowing you to move comfortably during outdoor activities. High Visibility Option: This jacket is available in a High Visibility orange version that is certified EN20471, enhancing safety in various environments. DWR Treatment: The outer material is treated with a DWR (Durable Water Repellent) treatment, enhancing water resistance. Matching Pants: You can pair this jacket with the Extrelle Active EVO Pants for a complete outfit. Designed for field sports in open country environments, this jacket prioritises silence and breathability, meeting the essential requirements for both active and static pursuits.

item.g:title: Beretta Womens Tri-Active EVO Jacket Green Moss
item.g:description: The Beretta Women's Tri-Active EVO Jacket in Green Moss is a versatile outdoor jacket designed for stalking or hide hunting. This jacket is waterproof and breathable, thanks to the BWB EVO (Beretta Waterproof Breathable EVO) membrane, which ensures protection from the elements. It's treated with Durable Water Repellent (DWR) finishing for added water resistance. The stretch inserts provide excellent freedom of movement, making it suitable for various outdoor pursuits. Key Features: Removable and performed "Easy Movement" hood for a clear field of vision. Soft microfleece inner collar for comfort. YKK zip closure and press studs with a placket for secure fastening. Handwarmer pockets with drawstring adjustment at the waist and an anti-flap system. Adjustable hook and loop fastening cuffs for a customised fit. Stretch panels on the shoulder blades for improved mobility. Drawstring adjustment for added versatility. Removable "Beretta Hands Free" braces for convenience. Internal pocket with YKK zip for secure storage. Beretta rubber logo on the left sleeve. Regular fit for comfortable wear. This jacket is perfect for outdoor enthusiasts who need protection from the elements without sacrificing comfort and mobility.

item.g:title: Beretta Womens Tri-Active EVO Pants Moss / Brownbark
item.g:description: The Beretta Women's Tri-Active EVO Pants in Moss/Brownbark are designed for outdoor activities, particularly for hunting, where silent materials are crucial. Here are some of the key features of these pants: Waterproof and Breathable: These pants feature the BWB EVO membrane, which stands for Beretta Waterproof Breathable EVO. This technology ensures that the pants are both waterproof and breathable, helping to keep you dry and comfortable in various outdoor conditions. Stretch Panels: The pants are equipped with stretch panels, providing maximum freedom of movement. This is particularly important for active outdoor activities, like hunting. Ventilation: To improve breathability, these pants have ventilation openings on the outer legs with YKK zippers. This allows you to regulate your body temperature while on the move. Functional Design: The pants have various functional elements, including a YKK zip and press stud closure, belt loops, inside buttons for braces, side pockets with YKK zips, a front pocket on the left leg, and a back pocket with a YKK zip. These features offer convenience and practicality during your outdoor adventures. Lower Back Support: The pants include high protective lower back support made of soft microfleece, which adds comfort and protection. Adjustment and Logo: You can find an adjustment feature at the back of the pants at the bottom with a YKK zip for a customized fit. They also feature the Beretta logo on the back. Fit: These pants have a regular fit, ensuring they are comfortable and versatile for various outdoor activities. Material: They are made of 100% polyester and feature a soft and silent microfibre as the main fabric. The Beretta Women's Tri-Active EVO Pants are designed to offer comfort, functionality, and protection for outdoor enthusiasts, especially those involved in hunting activities.

item.g:title: Birkenstock Arizona BF Reg Sandal Black
item.g:description: The BIRKENSTOCK Arizona is a genuine classic that has been delighting both men and women for decades. This simple sandal with two straps stands for timeless design and has long held cult status thanks to its comfort factor. The upper is made from the skin-friendly, hard-wearing synthetic material Birko-Flor®. Anatomically shaped cork-latex footbed Upper: Birko-Flor® Footbed lining: suede Sole: EVA Details: two straps, each with an individually adjustable metal pin buckle “Made in Germany”

item.g:title: Fjallraven Ovik Fleece Half Zip Dark Grey
item.g:description: Stay warm and comfortable in the Fjällräven Övik Fleece Half Zip in Dark Grey, a versatile mid-layer sweater designed for outdoor adventures. Here are the key features and care instructions for this fleece jacket: Key Features: Recycled Polyester: This fleece jacket is made from recycled polyester, making it a sustainable choice for environmentally-conscious individuals. It helps reduce the environmental impact of production. G-1000 Reinforcements: The elbows and underside of the forearms are reinforced with G-1000 fabric, known for its durability and resistance to wear and tear. This ensures the jacket's longevity, even in rugged conditions. Convenient Zipper: The generous front zipper makes it easy to put on and take off, allowing you to adjust your ventilation as needed during outdoor activities. Chest Pocket: The jacket features a single zippered chest pocket, providing a secure place to store small essentials like keys, a phone, or a wallet. Care Instructions: Washing: Machine wash at 40°C using a normal process. Ironing: Iron at a maximum temperature of 110°C, with a one-dot setting. Additional Care: Wash with similar colours, and use a leather balm on leather details regularly to maintain their quality. Sustainability: This product embodies Fjällräven's commitment to sustainability through longevity. By using recycled materials and timeless design, Fjällräven creates products that are built to last for many years, reducing the need for frequent replacements and minimizing waste. The Fjällräven Övik Fleece Half Zip is not only a functional and durable outdoor garment but also a responsible choice for those who care about the environment. Enjoy your outdoor adventures while staying warm and eco-conscious with this fleece jacket.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Nikka Trousers Curved Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Nikka Curved Trousers Black have been designed for women with curvy figures, with a generous fit over the rear and thighs and the waist is a more accentuated than other models. Allowing a higher comfortable wear with less restrictions with the new design. Made from a combined stretch fabric below the waist and G-1000 reinforcements over the rear, knees and leg endings for free movement and durability. Fjallraven have featured hand pockets with zippers, positioned for easy access when out exploring in the outdoors. One large leg pocket with a flap, a smaller internal pocket with mesh on the right leg and a small leg pocket suitable for a mobile phone or GPS on the left leg. Finished with a raw-length leg endings so the fit can be tailored personal for you. Material: G-1000 Original: 65% polyester, 35% cotton Material 2:¬†Stretch: 63% polyamide, 26% polyester, 11% elastane

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Nikka Trousers Curved Dark Navy
item.g:description: Technical trekking trousers with Curved Fit in Dark Navy, designed for women with curvy figures. The fit is more generous over the rear and thighs, while the waist is more accentuated than on other trouser models. This gives a more comfortable pair of trousers that sit better on a curvy figure, without being tight, bunching or having a gap at the back of the waist. The trousers combine stretch fabric and G-1000 for excellent freedom of movement and durability – perfect when trekking when you do not want to be restricted by tight trousers. The rear and knees are pre-shaped for the best possible fit, and the waist is cut lower at the front and higher at the back so they sit well when you are carrying a backpack and moving about. Hand pockets with zippers are positioned so they are easily accessed even when wearing a backpack with a hip belt. One large leg pocket with a flap and a smaller inner pocket in mesh on the right leg, plus a smaller leg pocket for a mobile phone or GPS on the left leg. Stretch fabric below the waist and G-1000 reinforcements over the rear, knees and leg endings. Raw-length leg endings that can easily be adjusted to your height. Key Features: Trekking trousers in stretch fabric and g-1000® combine freedom of movement with durability. Generous, curved fit that is optimized for female figures with more width at hips and thighs. G-1000® reinforcements at rear, knees and leg endings. Waist higher at the back for extra comfort when wearing a backpack. Pre-shaped knees. Adaptable with Greenland Wax, Breathable, Durable, Water-resistant, Wind resistant, Stretch

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Stina Trousers Dark Olive
item.g:description: Comfortable, hardwearing outdoor trousers with pre-shaped, tapered legs. The main material is durable and pliant G-1000 Stretch and four-way stretch panels provide freedom of movement. The stretch panels, together with a slightly higher waist with elastic at the sides, also contribute to a great fit on a wide range of body types. Classic, simple design with discreet leg pockets make for a new outdoor favourite that is at home both in the outdoors and for everyday life in town. Durable G-1000 Stretch with organic cotton and partly recycled polyester. Side panels in stretch fabric and elastic at the sides of the waist. Buttoned leg pockets with low-profile bellows. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Anorak Mais Yellow / Aloe Green
item.g:description: Go hiking in classic style with Vardag Anorak made from durable, weather-resistant G-1000 Eco. The design is simple with adjustable hood, kangaroo pocket and hand pockets. Its loose fit combined with a long front zipper and a side zipper makes it easy to pull on/take off and wear with other layers. A timeless, long-lasting garment for hiking, daytrips and everyday use, all year round. Durable, wind- and water-resistant jacket in G-1000 Eco. 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton. Adjustable hood and long zipper with buttoned placket. Zippers in the sides for ventilation and easy pull on/take off. Zippered hand pockets and buttoned kangaroo pocket. Adaptable with Greenland Wax, Durable, Ventilation, Water-resistant, Wind resistant

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Anorak Mustard Yellow
item.g:description: Made from durable, weather-resistant G-1000® Eco, the Fjallraven Women's Vardag Anorak in Mustard Yellow is a simple pull-on layer and one of the more practical anoraks in the range. It is a hard-wearing choice for hiking, day trips and everyday use across the year, and can be treated with Greenland Wax for added protection. Specifically made for those suffering with Hallux Valgus Bunion, this boot provides optimal pain-free comfort thanks to a reinforced PU foam wedge providing cushioning shock absorption and roll-off performance. Finished off with GORE-TEX waterproof lining for durability as well as premium nubuck leather upper for performance, it makes an excellent option for flat hikes as well as tours through Alpine valleys hut-to-hut tours! Enjoy hiking without giving up comfort or support using Hanwag Alta Bunion II GTX Boot. Membrane: GORE-TEX Upper material: Nubuck leather, Suede, Textile Outer sole: Vibram® Endurance Pro Lining: GORE-TEX

item.g:title: Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot Black / Light Grey
item.g:description: Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot in Black/Light Grey - an innovative lightweight hiking shoe featuring modern styling and versatile functionality - boasts innovative sustainability features including Durable Perwanger Leather upper construction combined with 100% recycled fabric from factory waste as well as PFC-free waterproof membrane. Furthermore, all materials were ethically sourced from European suppliers; creating this shoe in Europe makes them even more impressive. Durability and sustainability do not need to compromise comfort and functionality - the Blueridge Low ES offers both in spades. Boasting a newly designed midsole made of stabilising PU for all-day support on all sides and at the heel, and featuring non-slip Terragrip outsole with four millimetre-deep tread for outstanding gripping and traction on hiking trails, offering seamless heel strike/roll-off. The Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot is the ultimate sustainable hiking shoe - waterproof, breathable and environmentally conscious hikers should turn their attention toward this environmentally conscious shoe that does not compromise quality, comfort or style. Membrane: EcoShell Footwear Upper material: Suede, Textile Outer sole: Hanwag Hike Pro Lining: EcoShell Footwear

item.g:title: Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot Dusk / Anthracite
item.g:description: Experience hiking like never before with the Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot in Dusk/Anthracite. Boasting modern styling, lightness and multifunctionality - making it perfect for various uses - as well as innovative sustainability features including its top quality Perwanger leather upper, 100% recycled fabric component of its upper layer and PFC-free waterproof membrane, this boot will take your hiking adventures to new levels of enjoyment! HANWAG shoes were developed with environmental sustainability in mind; its proprietary PU membrane provides waterproofing and breathability without using harmful fluorocarbons; therefore making the shoe both waterproof and eco-friendly. Furthermore, all materials sourced are from European suppliers making up its entirety in Europe. But don't let its focus on durability and sustainability mislead you - the Blueridge Low ES boasts exceptional levels of functionality and comfort with its perfect fit, newly developed midsole, raised edge of stabilising PU sole providing greater support on all sides and at-heel strike/roll-off performance effortless and smooth! In addition, a non-slip "Terragrip" outsole featuring a four-millimetre deep tread depth with extra large lugs provides cushioned heel strike/roll-off performance effortlessly and smoothly. The Hanwag Blueridge Low ES Boot can bring modern style and functionality to a variety of hiking trails - from damp autumnal foothills to sandy Mediterranean coastal paths - for an enhanced hiking experience. Upgrade your trekking with Hanwag! Membrane: EcoShell Footwear Upper material: Suede, Textile Outer sole: Hanwag Hike Pro Lining: EcoShell Footwear

Be prepared to conquer an array of hiking trails easily - from damp autumnal foothills to sandy Mediterranean coastal hikes - by investing in the Hanwag Blueridge Low Lady ES hiking boot! Experience durability, sustainability and comfort all combined into one package! item.g:title: Hanwag Womens Makra Trek Lady GTX Petrol / Mint
item.g:description: The Hanwag Women's Makra Trek Lady GTX trekking shoe in Petrol/Mint is designed to meet the demands of challenging hikes in Alpine regions with light luggage, even up to altitudes of 3000 meters. Here are some key features and benefits of these trekking shoes: Colourful and Sporty Look: The Makra Trek Lady GTX offers a vibrant and sporty design, making it a stylish choice for outdoor enthusiasts. Suitable for Demanding Tours: These shoes are specifically crafted for demanding treks in the Alpine region, ensuring performance and comfort during your adventures. Hanwag 3D Prism Base Technology: This technology contributes to a lightweight and comfortable sole construction, making it easier to traverse various terrains. Vibram Integral Light Sole: The Vibram Integral Light sole provides excellent cushioning and high stability. Its lower stance height enhances stability while walking on uneven surfaces. Hanwag 2 Zone Lock: This feature offers improved heel hold and ensures a secure fit with a mechanical clamp. It's easy to adjust with a single hand movement and prevents slipping without manual intervention. Waterproof GORE-TEX Membrane: The GORE-TEX membrane keeps your feet dry even in wet conditions, making these shoes suitable for various weather environments. Perwanger Leather: The shoes feature Perwanger leather, known for its durability, breathability, and robustness. This combination of materials enhances the overall performance of the shoes. The Hanwag Women's Makra Trek Lady GTX trekking shoes are designed to provide comfort, stability, and protection for your outdoor adventures, making them a reliable choice for Alpine trekking and beyond. The stylish design adds an extra touch of flair to your hiking gear.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Alonra Traveller Jacket Dark Grey
item.g:description: The Alondra Traveller provides carrying space during warm weather activities including exploring and sightseeing, nature watching and photography.Such activities in warm weather need clothing that protects from the sun, wind and showers, is robust, and allows essential equipment to be carried securely. If treated with Nikwax CottonProof, Nikwax Cotton+ is a quick-drying fabric well-suited to providing protection and durability. Through careful design, significant weight can be transported without discomfort and items easily be accessed without disruption to wildlife. The Alondra Traveller has plentiful pockets, and is designed for comfortable load-carrying and for freedom of movement. Excellent, easily accessible storage from 10 well-placed pockets, which allow equipment to be organised, transported and easily accessed.Careful engineering ensures the weight of equipment is well distributed across the padded shoulders for comfort. Freedom of movement due to articulation in the arms and shoulders, and poppered side slits for sitting and striding. Nikwax Cotton+ is a tough yet lightweight fabric that provides sun, wind and shower protection (when treated with Nikwax CottonProof). Nikwax Cotton Plus FabricNikwax Cotton+ is a blend of cotton with modern synthetic fibres. By combining the best properties of both fibres, Nikwax Cotton+ offers easy wear and easy care qualities - it is fast-drying, lightweight and comfortable to wear in warm weather but also robust and protective. As well as blocking the wind and harmful UV rays, it will, if maintained with Nikwax CottonProof, provide shower resistance too.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Cambia Zip Neck Top Black
item.g:description: The Paramo Cambia zip is a directional baselayer, quick drying and highly versatile, giving two levels of cooling through reversibility. Ideal for high energy or warm weather activities. The Cambia Zip Neck uses Parameta T+ reversible fabric. It offers variable cooling, depending on the way out it is worn, providing two baselayers in one.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Grid Technic Baselayer Indigo Blue
item.g:description: No matter what your activity, finding a clothing system which can cope with differing temperatures and activity levels throughout the day is a challenge. People often end up adding or removing multiple layers to stay comfortable. The Grid Technic helps reduce the number of layers you need by offering cooling when exposed to the wind, or insulation when covered with a windproof or waterproof. The Grid Technic has a zipped neck, thumb loops and a feminine cut. Variable ventilation to the skin provided by the zipped neck. A zip garage at the top protects soft skin under the chin. Thumb loops to hold sleeves in place when required. In cold conditions, this eliminates any gap between glove and jacket in order to maintain hand warmth. A comfortable, feminine silhouette with a broad range of movement provided by efficient styling in stretch fabric.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Torres Alturo Jacket Midnight / Hot Coral
item.g:description: Overlayer jacket providing fast block insulation and functionality for high mountain activities in extreme or prolonged cold and wet conditions. The Torres Alturo is helmet and harness-friendly and can be packed down into its own pocket. Nikwax Analogy® Insulator fabric delivers reliable warmth even when wet.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Velez Adventure Trousers Reg Rock Grey / Black
item.g:description: The Velez Adventure Trousers are for very active outdoor people who enjoy a range of outdoor activities. If you are going out in changeable conditions, you face the hassle of having to put on waterproof trousers if the weather deteriorates. These are often carried separately, as they are too noisy, sweaty and uncomfortable to wear all the time. The Velez Adventure Trousers can be worn comfortably all day next to skin, even if it is not raining. The highly breathable and directional Nikwax Analogy® fabric combines with ventilation to deliver optimum comfort. The Velez Adventure Trousers have great ventilation freedom of movement and ankle adjustment. PRODUCT FEATURES: Easy and rapid temperature adjustment when on the move provided by discreet thigh zips with internal storm flaps. Great freedom of movement from excellent knee and leg articulation. Adaptable for different activities thanks to ankle adjustment with hook and loop fastening. Nikwax Analogy Waterproof fabric is more than just breathable, it is directional. This means it is capable of moving liquid water away from your body and not just water vapour. It is essential to avoid a build-up of water in your clothing system when you are working hard, as too much retained moisture will lead to your body rapidly chilling when you stop and rest. In conventional clothing systems, approximately 20% of sweat production is dealt with effectively, leaving the remaining 80% trapped inside. Nikwax Analogy garments are unique, in that they pump out this 80% of liquid water and allow it to drain away; you are left feeling dry and comfortable.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Ventura Fleece Jacket Midnight Marl
item.g:description: Water-repellent directional fleece hoodie designed to combine with Ventura Windproof to create a versatile system for high mountain activities. The Ventura's Nikwax Fleece fabric protects against mist and drizzle. Simple hood and practical pocketing. The Ventura Fleece is for women who enjoy mountain activities across the seasons. On the mountains in summer, you want a warm, light midlayer to keep you comfortable when at rest, or in cooler conditions. Often you need to carry a waterproof jacket in case the weather deteriorates. The Ventura Fleece not only provides insulation but the water-shedding fabric is excellent for summer showers.

item.g:title: Patagonia Down Sweater Vest Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia Down Sweater Vest is crafted from a lightweight ripstop shell fabric that is filled with an 800-fill-power Traceable Down which has been ethically produced ensuring birds are not force-fed or live-plucked. This vest is ideal to be worn as a layer in the cooler months or as an outer layer on warmer days as it focuses on core warmth and protection from the elements. This vest is also compact, storing in to an internal pocket with a carabiner clip in loop.

item.g:title: Patagonia P-6 Logo Responsibili Tee Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia P-6 Logo Responsibili-Tee in Navy is a simple design with a lot more to it than meets the eye. This normal looking tee is actually beautifully created from recycled materials. More specifically, Patagonia have saved 63 gallons of water by creating this tee with 4.8 plastic bottles and 0.26 of fabric spares. It also has Fair Trade Certified™ sewing. With functionality in mind, the tee features tapered shoulder seams and a soft ribbed crew neck. The Patagonia Text Logo can be found subtly to the front chest, and more vividly in the print to the back. Patagonia’s ink prints are also PVC and Phthalate Free. A great tee to top up your Spring and Summer wardrobe. Available in alternative colours.

item.g:title: Red Wing 6-Inch Classic Moc Boot Black Cherry
item.g:description: The Red Wing Classic Moc Toe Boot in Black Cherry is the epitome of timeless craftsmanship and American heritage. Red Wing Shoes, a family-owned business founded in 1905 in Minnesota, has dedicated over a century to perfecting the art of crafting durable, high-quality leather shoes and boots. Their commitment to excellence and craftsmanship has resulted in footwear that stands the test of time. PRODUCT FEATURES: High-Quality Leather: Red Wing Shoes are known for their use of top-quality leather. The Classic Moc Toe Boot is crafted with premium leather that not only looks fantastic but also promises exceptional durability. Moc Toe Design: This iconic boot takes inspiration from the classic moccasin, featuring a moccasin-style toe that adds a touch of authenticity and style. It's a design that's both timeless and versatile. Black Cherry Shade: The boot comes in a striking black cherry shade that adds character and richness to your look. It's a hue that pairs well with various outfits and occasions. Contrasting Laces: The boot is complemented by yellow and red laces, adding a pop of colour and flair to your ensemble. These laces are not just for functionality but also contribute to the boot's aesthetic. White Topstitching: The white topstitching on the boot's exterior enhances its visual appeal. It's a subtle detail that adds depth and character to the overall design. Cream Soles: The boots are finished with cream soles, which not only provide a comfortable and cushioned walking experience but also create a striking contrast against the black cherry leather. The Red Wing Classic Moc Toe Boot is a testament to a century of dedication to craftsmanship and quality. With its combination of premium materials, iconic design, and attention to detail, this boot is more than footwear; it's a statement of pride and purpose. Perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions, these boots are built to endure and elevate your style.

item.g:title: Red Wing 6-inch Classic Moc Boot Black Prairie
item.g:description: The Red Wing Classic 6″ Mocc Leather Boot in Black Prairie is built to perform and protect. Made from premium leather throughout which is rigid where high protection is needed and soft in areas where comfort is key such as the tongue and ankle. This boot has a higher rise making it more of a work-wear boot which the brand are well regarded for, however they can also be worn as an everyday boot. Sitting on a chunky contrast sole with a rubber grip making them suitable for all weather and terrains.

item.g:title: Red Wing 6-Inch Classic Moc Boot Olive Mohave
item.g:description: The Red Wing 6" Classic Moc Boot in Olive Mohave salutes American Craftsmanship and Design. The boots are made in the USA from the Olive Mohave Leather that ages gracefully, perhaps even looking better with wear and use. The boots are water, moisture and stain resistant making them suitable for working outdoors. They also have a durable rubber outsole, further adding to their traction and the Goodyear welt construction avoids any squishing of toes while providing a snug fit. They're super comfortable and easy to style casually. They feature contrasting coloured sole and stitching for added style.

item.g:title: Red Wing 6-inch Classic Moc Boot Oro Russet
item.g:description: Red Wing Shoes, a family-owned business founded in 1905 in Minnesota, has dedicated over a century to perfecting the art of crafting high-quality leather footwear. Their Moc Toe Boot in Oro Russet, inspired by classic moccasins, is a timeless and versatile style known for its durability and iconic design. In a striking red hue with contrasting yellow and red laces, moccasin-style toe, white topstitching, and cream soles, these boots are both visually appealing and rugged. item.g:title: Red Wing 8-Inch Classic Moc Boot Oro Legacy
item.g:description: Red Wing Men's 8-inch Classic MOC boot in Oro Legacy Leather The 8-inch Classic Moc stands tall as one of the most iconic boots in the Red Wing Heritage line. Born from the archives, this rugged lifestyle boot is built with the same materials, process, and quality as the 1952 original. The 8-inch Classic MOC Boot The 8-inch Classic Moc is arguably the most well-known boot in the Red Wing Heritage Collection. The commanding style was originally built as a hunting boot when it debuted in 1952, and its comfort and toughness quickly made it a favourite at job sites. Today, the boot is still made in Red Wing, Minnesota with the same commitment to craftsmanship and materials that made it a legend. The iconic Traction Tred rubber outsole and moc toe construction stand out as the signature features of the boot, and Puritan triple stitching and a Goodyear welt ensure lasting durability. Fit Information A new pair of Red Wing Heritage footwear should fit comfortably tight on the foot, with enough room to freely wiggle toes. NO. 23 Last The no. 23 was created in the 1950s and is Red Wing’s most iconic last. Includes extra room in the forefoot and instep to fit a variety of foot shapes.

item.g:title: Red Wing Classic 6 Inch Moc Toe Boots Copper Rough and Tough
item.g:description: The Red Wing Classic Moc Toe Boots Rough and Tough, are crafted from their signature Copper Rough & Tough Leather, the 1907 debuted in 2005 for Red Wing's centennial celebration and has since become a staple. Distinguished by its Norwegian-style welt and subtle toe box, it boasts a leather footbed for immediate comfort and comes with both leather and taslan laces. item.g:description: Designed with inspiration from West Coast culture from the late 1980s to the early 1990s, these Rototo socks come with retro stripes in Light Gray. "RRL"-debossed leather logo label on the back right waist. 100% cotton. Machine washable. For best results, wear 90 days without washing. Made in USA.

Complete with a dark blue wash and red cast, these Ralph Lauren RRL jeans are the ideal casual to smart piece of denim. The subtle broken in look on takes it's inspiration from the 1940s so you have a timeless classic pair of jeans.

item.g:title: RRL by Ralph Lauren Slim Narrow Grandfalls Jean Grandfalls Wash
item.g:description: Made in the USA from exclusive 16.25 oz. Japanese denim. Medium-blue wash Jean Grandfalls with a red-blue cast from RRL by Ralph Lauren. Hand-distressed and hand-applied pigment. Unique finishing process controls shrinkage while maintaining the original character of the fabric. PRODUCT FEATURES: Slim Narrow Fit: the slimmest fit, with a medium-low pitched waist, a slim tapered leg, and a narrow leg opening. Size 32W has an 8¾" rise and a 14" leg opening. Hand-set chain-stitched waistband with inserted belt loops for added durability. Button fly with our signature buttoned closure ensures a consistent fit through years of wear. USA-made buttons and washers. Five-pocket styling with authentic washers and rivets. Selvedge coin pocket. "RRL" embroidery at the coin pocket. Heavy twill pocket lining. Roughout suede "RRL"-debossed logo label at the back right waist. 100% cotton. Machine washable. For best results, wear 90 days without washing. Made in USA. Japanese denim. Due to the natural characteristics of this material, the colouring may rub off onto fabrics and upholstery.

item.g:title: RRL by Ralph Lauren Vermont Cotton Twill Shirt Red / Black
item.g:description: The RRL by Ralph Lauren Vermont Cotton Twill Shirt In Red / Black combines classic style with modern functionality. The vintage-inspired overshirt is a versatile addition to your wardrobe, offering a classic look with the warmth and functionality needed for the modern lifestyle. Imported for your convenience, it seamlessly blends fashion with responsibility. PRODUCT FEATURES: Material: Crafted from brushed twill cloth custom-developed with a yarn-dyed checked pattern, it offers a timeless and rugged aesthetic. The body is lined with high-pile fleece, providing both warmth and comfort. The sleeves feature quilted lining for added insulation. Closure: Enamelled snaps are used for the front snapped placket, providing a secure and stylish fastening. Fit: Size medium has a 74.3 cm back body length, a 47.6 cm shoulder, a 117.5 cm chest, and an 88.9 cm sleeve length, making it a versatile and comfortable choice for various body types. The point collar adds a classic touch, while the extended buttoned throat tab enhances protection from the elements. Sleeves: Long sleeves with buttoned barrel cuffs offer adjustability and style. Pockets: Two chest buttoned pockets provide convenient storage space for your essentials. Composition: Shell: 100% cotton Body lining: 71% polyester, 29% acrylic Sleeve lining: 51% cupro, 49% cotton Sleeve fill: 100% polyester Sustainability: By choosing this cotton product, you're supporting the Better Cotton™ mission, which aims to help cotton communities thrive while safeguarding the environment. Please note that this product is sourced via a mass balance system and may not contain Better Cotton™. Visit bettercotton.org/massbalance for more information about mass balance. Care: This overshirt is machine washable, making it easy to maintain its quality and appearance.

item.g:title: RRL by Ralph Lauren Womens Kyle Trouser Ankle Pleated New Olive
item.g:description: Expertly crafted for the modern woman, the RRL Womens Kyle Trouser Ankle Pleated injects vintage workwear style into your wardrobe. These olive green trousers take inspiration from 1940s design with their wide-leg cropped silhouette, pleated front, and adjustable side tabs that flatter a variety of figures. Constructed from soft Japanese cotton twill that has been stonewashed for a lightly worn-in look and feel, the Kyle Trouser Ankle Pleated will become a favorite piece for casual Fridays at the office or weekend activities. Details such as the back flap pockets, button belt loops, and Double RL's signature slim vintage fit polish off the trousers with heritage style. For the best fit, consider sizing up if you prefer a more relaxed silhouette. The Ralph Lauren Double RL collection is perfect for those who appreciate exceptional craftsmanship and timeless clothing with an authentic American spirit. Make the Kyle Trouser Ankle Pleated the next staple in your wardrobe. PRODUCT FEATURES: Mid-rise. Cropped wide-leg fit. Relaxed through hip, thigh and leg. Designed to hit above the ankle. Size 32 has a 27.9 cm rise, a 78.7 cm waist and a 59.1 cm leg opening. All sizes have a 64.1 cm inside leg. Button fly with a buttoned closure. Corozo buttons. Pleated front Two side on-seam pockets. Two buttoned back pockets. Adjustable buckled tabs at the waist. Buttoned belt loops. 100% cotton. Machine washable or dry clean.

item.g:title: Sitka Jetstream Jacket Deep Lichen
item.g:description: Introducing the mens windproof Sitka Jetstream Jacket in the striking Deep Lichen colour. This jacket is equipped with the revolutionary WINDSTOPPER® technology from Gore-Tex Labs, ensuring ultimate protection against relentless cold winds. With its carefully crafted design, it offers both comfort and freedom of movement. Whether you need warmth or breathability, this dependable softshell jacket, featuring a cosy micro-grid fleece lining, provides unparalleled versatility. Stay comfortable and protected in style with this perennial favourite from our lineup. PRODUCT FEATURES: Crafted from recycled polyester fabric with a polyester micro-grid fleece interior, the Jetstream Jacket is not only functional but also environmentally conscious. Thanks to GORE® WINDSTOPPER® product technology, this jacket is 100% windproof, ensuring you stay shielded from the harshest gusts. The durable water-repellent finish wards off light precipitation and prevents the fabric from becoming saturated. Taped and skived seams provide added weather protection without adding bulk, ensuring you stay comfortable and agile. Zippered hand and chest pockets offer secure storage for your essentials, keeping them easily accessible. Pit zips allow you to release excess heat when you're on the move, helping you maintain a comfortable temperature. The jacket features an updated fit for a relaxed, comfortable feel with plenty of mobility, making it ideal for various outdoor activities. Weighing in at just 26 oz., this jacket offers impressive protection without unnecessary bulk.

item.g:title: Sitka Kelvin AeroLite Jacket Optifade Subalpine
item.g:description: Amidst the specialised gear designed for outdoor pursuits, having versatile equipment proves to be a true asset. This lightweight and compressible Sitka Kelvin AeroLite jacket in Optifade Subalpine not only maximises warmth but also minimises bulk, making it an ideal choice for a variety of activities. Whether you're embarking on backcountry hunts, off-season scouting trips, or simply navigating daily life, this jacket fits seamlessly under a shell, offering an extra layer of warmth when needed. What sets it apart is the Synthetic PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation with Cross Core™ technology, which replicates the warmth and compressibility of down insulation while delivering exceptional warm-when-wet performance. PRODUCT FEATURES: Weighing in at just 16 oz., this jacket is incredibly lightweight, ensuring comfort during extended wear. Featuring Cross Core™ technology, this insulation mimics the warmth and compressibility of down while retaining the advantage of staying warm even when wet. The lightweight insulation (35% recycled) is infused with silica aerogel, a remarkably weightless material composed of over 95% air, providing additional thermal insulation. With a 20-denier polyester face and a 20-denier polyester backer, this jacket is built to withstand the rigours of outdoor adventures. The durable water repellent (DWR) finish resists precipitation and prevents the face fabric from becoming saturated. Gusseted stretch cuffs allow for smooth, easy layering and unrestricted movement, especially crucial during active pursuits and shooting. The fitted hood offers low-profile warmth and concealment without obstructing peripheral vision. A deep, zippered chest pocket provides a safe and easily accessible place to store your valuables during your adventures.

item.g:title: Sitka Mountain Evo Jacket Sitka Black
item.g:description: Introducing the ultimate outerwear for backcountry hunting and high-intensity mountain activities - the men's Sitka Mountain Evo Jacket in Black. Designed with your needs in mind, this lightweight technical jacket offers both protection from the elements and flexibility for easy, lightweight breathability. We've integrated cutting-edge WINDSTOPPER® technology by Gore-Tex Labs in crucial areas to ensure top-tier protection. Additionally, we've included four-way stretch panels in key areas like the underarms and back, allowing for unrestricted movement and optimal breathability. Experience the perfect balance of performance and comfort with the Sitka Mountain Evo Jacket in Black. PRODUCT FEATURES: Engineered with WINDSTOPPER® by Gore-Tex Labs technology, ensuring that you're shielded from the elements in the areas where it matters most. Body-mapped four-way stretch polyester panels are strategically placed to maximize mobility and breathability, especially in high-activity zones. Ultrasonic welded seams provide added protection without contributing to bulk or weight, ensuring a streamlined and efficient design. Designed for warmth and concealment, the contoured hood doesn't compromise your peripheral vision, making it ideal for hunting and other outdoor pursuits. Zippered hand and chest pockets offer convenient and secure storage for your essentials, keeping them easily accessible. This jacket weighs just 13.6 oz., ensuring that it won't weigh you down during your high-exertion adventures.

item.g:title: Sunspel Long Sleeve Riviera Polo Black
item.g:description: The Sunspel Long Sleeve Riviera Polo in Black is the long sleeve adaptation of the original Riviera Polo which was originally tailored for Daniel Craig in Casino Royale and has therefore become somewhat of an iconic piece in Sunspel's clothing collection. Featuring a classic open pointed collar and short sleeves, this polo is carefully crafted from a soft, comfortable and breathable cotton which was designed by Peter Hill, the grandson of Sunspel’s founder. item.g:title: Trickers Evedon Chukka Boot Snuff
item.g:description: Our new Trickers Evedon Chukka Boot Snuff is a distinguished addition to any wardrobe. Handcrafted with care in our factory in Northampton, England, these boots have 5 eyelets and feature a natural full leather lining with a woven canvas pull loop. To finish off the look, we've added a Barbour welt and single Dainite studded rubber sole for your comfort and durability. Built on the classic 4497s last, this boot is true to size and fits perfectly. These chukka boots are constructed out of high-quality C.F. Stead® Repello® Suede that has been tanned particularly well for an attractive appearance and full handle. Scotchguard® has also been added during the tanning process in order to make sure these shoes are as stain-resistant as possible - you can wear them knowing that their proofing will remain effective over time! To top it off, the iconic “Dainite” soles provide extra comfort while still remaining weatherproof and easy-to-clean. With these timelessly stylish chukkas on your feet, you'll be prepared for all your daily adventures without sacrificing fashion one bit! Built to Last Tricker's shoes are constructed to last, with expert craftsmanship displayed in every pair. Meticulously handcrafted in our Northampton, England factory by experienced craftspeople using traditional methods and high-quality materials, our shoes are made to the same exacting standards that first established Tricker's reputation in the footwear industry. Each pair goes through 260 processes from start to completion, ensuring durability, practicality and style. These values have been passed down through five generations and are honored as steadfastly today as they were in 1829. With Tricker's, style and practicality come in a durable package that lasts. We are proud to hold a Royal Warrant for shoe manufacturing awarded by His Royal Highness, The Prince of Wales since 1989.

item.g:title: Filson Mackinaw Wool Double Coat Red Black Classic Plaid
item.g:description: The Mackinaw Wool Double Coat features Filson's renowned Mackinaw Wool and a layer of waxed cotton Tin Cloth on the shoulders and arms for ultimate protection against rain and snow. This combination also provides superior breathability through the torso. Originally designed for Pacific Northwest foresters in 1914, the Double Coat is based on our iconic Mackinaw Wool Cruiser. The spacious back pocket, designed for timber cruisers, is now perfect for storing gloves and hats. The tightly-woven 24-oz. Mackinaw Wool Twill is exceptionally durable, wind-resistant, and warm. This 100% wool is comfortable in a wide range of weather conditions, making it the top choice over any other material. Evolved from the waxed canvas used for jackets and pants for loggers and hunters in the 1920s, Filson Tin Cloth is renowned for its tight weave and special treatments that enhance durability and water resistance; sourced from Britain's oldest and finest mills. Made from 24-oz. 100% wool reinforced with Tin Cloth Four front pockets, two with hidden handwarmer pockets Full-width pass-through rear pocket Removable hood with button-secure throat shield Button-close front MATERIAL 24-oz./LY 100% Mackinaw Wool + 14-oz. 100% cotton oil finish Tin Cloth CARE Do not wash or dry clean – brush or wipe clean with a damp rag. Rewax as needed to maintain maximum water resistance. To prevent the transfer of oils, we recommend avoiding prolonged contact between Filson oil finish goods and light-coloured fabrics, especially in warm weather. ORIGIN Made in Vietnam

item.g:title: Jackman Waffle Armoured Midneck Olive Green
item.g:description: The Jackman Waffle Armoured Midneck in Olive Green is a unique piece in collaboration with Lavenham, a well-known British brand with over 50 years of history. Combining Jackman's signature waffle mid-neck and Lavenham's quilted elements, this sweater adds a refreshing twist to a timeless design. The waffle fabric is slowly knitted at low speeds using thick yarn, creating a soft and plush material that is naturally stretchy. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Stina Fleece Green
item.g:description: Comfortable and soft fleece sweater; made from recycled polyester with a slightly marbled look. As appropriate on a mountain hike as it is when worn as a warm middle layer under a shell jacket or by itself over a shirt as the dew falls on a nice summer evening. The fleece is manufactured in an environmentally friendly process that both spins and dyes the thread in the same step. For this model, that means about 50 per cent less water and 31 per cent less energy consumption compared to a traditionally produced fleece sweater. A high collar protects you from biting winds, and there is a protective flap of fleece between the zipper and chin. Two spacious zippered side pockets. All of the zipper flaps are made from natural-tone leather. Mélange fleece made from solution-dyed recycled polyester. Lightweight fleece that gives that extra layer on colder days. High collar with chin guard, and two zippered hand pockets. Material: 82% polyester (recycled), 18% polyesterLegal notice: Contains non-textile elements of animal origin.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Stina Trousers Short Leg Black
item.g:description: Comfortable, hardwearing outdoor trousers with pre-shaped, tapered legs. The main material is durable and pliant G-1000 Stretch and four-way stretch panels provide freedom of movement. The stretch panels, together with a slightly higher waist with elastic at the sides, also contribute to a great fit on a wide range of body types. Classic, simple design with discreet leg pockets make for a new outdoor favourite that is at home both in the outdoors and for everyday life in town. Durable G-1000 Stretch with organic cotton and partly recycled polyester. Side panels in stretch fabric and elastic at the sides of the waist. Buttoned leg pockets with low-profile bellows. Zippered hand pockets. Material: G-1000® Stretch: 50% polyester (recycled), 15% polyester (T400), 35% cotton (organic) 63% polyamide, 26% polyester, 11% elastaneLegal notice: Contains non-textile elements of animal origin.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Hoodie Chalk White
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Vardag Hoodie in Chalk White is a cosy, practical hoodie in 100% organic cotton with a comfortable, slightly looser fit. Its raglan sleeves, boxy cut and plain hem make this the perfect sweater for many body types. The ribbed cuffs and drawstring hood will keep warm air in. A light, breathable mid layer that is perfect when you need a little more warmth.100% cotton (organic). Product Features: Fit: Relaxed Fit Sleeve type: Long sleeve Hood: Yes Hood features: Fixed

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Pile Fleece Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Vardag Pile Fleece in Black is a warm, comfortable jacket in two-layer teddy fleece made from recycled polyester. Structured outside and a flat-knitted jersey inside. Two hand pockets with zippers for safely storing small things. Full-length zipper at the front makes it easy to regulate warmth. Perfect as a robust, warm mid layer on cold winter days and also works well as a jacket in milder temperatures. PRODUCT FEATURES: Two-layer teddy fleece made from 100% recycled polyester. Structured outside, flat-knitted inside. Zippered hand pockets. Classic Fjällräven logo from the 1970s. Material: 100% polyester (recycled)

item.g:title: Goldwin Pullover Floating Wind Shell Hoodie Olive Drab
item.g:description: A windbreaker pullover with a comfortable and supple texture that incorporates the functions required for running, such as lightness, breathability, and water repellency. By eliminating the seams using ultrasonic welding, the finish feels good on the skin. The front zipper is thin and soft. Knit tape on cuffs The roomy 3D pattern features wider sleeves and a body for comfortable arm movement and body mobility. The back body is slightly longer to prevent the fabric from sliding up. The hood has a three-dimensional neck design that does not impair wind resistance. Packable into the pocket inside the hood

item.g:title: Hanwag Banks Lady GTX Boot Navy / Asphalt
item.g:description: Hanwag Banks Lady GTX Boots in Navy/Asphalt make hiking enjoyable! Constructed of LWG (Leather Working Group)-rated nubuck leather for high-quality yet eco-friendly production. Their midsole's 1.5 millimetres thicker polyurethane wedge provides smooth roll-off, better shock absorption and longer-lasting comfort - the Hanwag Banks Lady GTX Boot is suitable for hiking across lower mountain ranges, as well as easier walks, while their GORE-TEX lining keeps your feet dry in wet conditions. Membrane: GORE-TEX Upper material: Suede, Textile Outer sole: Vibram® Endurance Pro Lining: GORE-TEX

item.g:title: Hanwag Coastrock Low ES Shoe Seablue / Sulphur
item.g:description: Sporty design, lightweight construction and sustainable materials. The Coastrock Low ES is a lightweight shoe, designed for straightforward terrain and trails, shorter day hikes and active everyday use. Its high-quality Perwanger leather upper comes in fresh colourways, further underlining the overall sporty design. On the sustainability front, this model has a PFC-free EcoShell membrane. Hanwag’s proprietary waterproof, breathable and sustainable PU membrane is based on a complex, hydrophilic system that offers waterproofing and breathability without using fluorocarbons. Not only the membrane but also the entire shoe is PFC-free. To ensure a perfect high-quality connection between the sole and upper, we use Direct Injection technology, where the soft sole material is directly injected and connected with the shoe upper. This makes the new Hanwag Hike Light sole particularly lightweight and especially comfortable to wear. It’s made of a selection of cushioning ingredients – softer PU at the heel and toe area – with stabilising rubber elements in the midfoot area. This multifunctional shoe is constructed deliberately without a distinctive heel – the flatter the terrain, the less you need one. This then ensures a smoother roll-off for the foot. Hydrophilic, PFC-free EcoShell PU membrane in a sturdy 3-layer laminate High-quality, long-lasting Perwanger leather upper Hanwag ‘Hike Light’ rubber outsole for perfect grip 3D I-PU midsole technology combines perfect cushioning at the heel and forefoot with outstanding support at the midfoot.

Adds 15/16" to length of pul

item.g:title: Paramo Grid Technic Baselayer Moss
item.g:description: The Grid Technic is an essential kit for both highly demanding and everyday outdoor activities. No matter what your activity is, finding a clothing system which can cope with differing temperatures and activity levels throughout the day is a challenge. People often end up adding or removing multiple layers to stay comfortable. The Grid Technic helps reduce the number of layers you need by offering cooling when exposed to the wind, or insulation when covered with a windproof or waterproof. The Grid Technic has a zipped neck, thumb loops and an athletic fit. Variable ventilation to the skin is provided by the zipped neck. A zip garage at the top protects soft skin under the chin. Thumb loops to hold sleeves in place when required. In cold conditions, this eliminates any gap between the glove and jacket to maintain hand warmth. A comfortable, athletic silhouette with a broad range of movement provided by efficient styling in stretch fabric.

item.g:title: Patagonia Balaclava Black
item.g:description: Simplicity gets a technical twist with this Patagonia Balaclava in Black, built from warm, quick-wicking Capilene® Thermal Weight fabric with flat seams to prevent chafing under a hat or beanie and a hinged opening that allows it to be worn multiple ways depending on conditions. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory.

item.g:title: Patagonia Brodeo Beanie Hat Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia Brodeo Beanie Hat in Black is ideal for winter thanks to it's warm and comfortable nature. Made from a recycled wool/nylon fabric. It adopts a classic single ribbed fold-back design with a small woven brand tab to finish off.

item.g:title: Patagonia Down Sweater New Navy
item.g:description: The Men's Down Sweater™ in New Navy has a NetPlus® 100% postconsumer recycled nylon ripstop shell made from recycled fishing nets. This lightweight, windproof Patagonia down jacket is filled with 800-fill-power Responsible Down Standard down for reliable warmth without unnecessary bulk. Features Shell: NetPlus® 100% postconsumer recycled nylon ripstop with PFC-free DWR finish Insulation: 800-fill-power 100% Responsible Down Standard down (certified by Control Union, CU 880272) Centre-front zip with interior storm flap and chin zip garage Two on-seam handwarmer pockets with welted zips; internal zip chest pocket converts to a stuffsack Nylon-bound elastic cuffs and drawcord hem

item.g:title: Patagonia Foot Tractor Wading Boots Aluminum Bar Built By Danner Forge Grey
item.g:description: *Please note that these boots are designed to be worn over waders and are therefore sized up accordingly. If you are planning on wearing without waders/fishing socks then you may wish to buy the size down from your regular size. The Patagonia Foot Tractor Wading Boots Aluminum Bar in Forge Grey, Built By Danner, is a new collaboration from the famous boot builders Danner. After countless hours of in-the-water research from ambassadors and anglers all over the world, here is what they have designed. Ultra-comfort and support combined with a quick-drain design are a must for those long fishing days . The grip combined with strategically placed aluminium bars, have been designed for maximum traction on muddy trails and subsurface terrain. The waterproof, full grain leather and flexibility provide support and comfort while protecting your feet. A speed lacing system with traditional eyelets provides easy tightening, ensuring the ankle is supported for wading on uneven surfaces. Each pair of Wading Boots has been hand-crafted with pride in Portland, Oregon.

item.g:title: Patagonia Foot Tractor Wading Boots Felt Forge Grey
item.g:description: *Please note that these boots are designed to be worn over waders and are therefore sized up accordingly. If you are planning on wearing without waders/fishing socks then you may wish to buy the size down from your regular size. The Patagonia Foot Tractor Wading Boots in Felt Forge Grey are the highest-performing wading boots you will find. Heavy-duty protection, support and durability for all your fishing needs, Patagonia have created these wading boots to protect your feet whilst you're doing what you do best. Crafted from full-grain leather and PFC free tanning processing that resists the breakdown of the boots, even leather so that you have some long-lasting boots that can also be reconditioned. The though 1,000 denier nylon panel adds to the resistance of these boots, combined with perforated drains on either side of the boots to make these Patagonia wading boots fast drying so you stay comfortable all day. Stability is a key box to tick for fishing boots and the stitchdown construction on these Patagonia wading boots ensures a wider platform and protection to the boot sidewall so they can also be resoled by Danner®. PRODUCT FEATURES: Moulded bi-fit board Long lasting mid sole Felt sole / ideal for flat rocks, large boulders and gravel Upper: full-grain leather / 1,000 denier / 100% nylon panelling Lining: 67% polyester / 33% nylon Mid Sole: 8IR rubber Lower Mid Sole: Polyether Polyurethane Out Sole: 3/8" 100% polyester felt Foot Tractor Boots are ideal with thicker wader booties or socksIf you want to wear them with thin wader booties / wet-wading then please size down

item.g:title: Patagonia River Salt Wading Boots Built By Danner Feather Grey
item.g:description: *Please note that these boots are designed to be worn over waders and are therefore sized up accordingly. If you are planning on wearing without waders / fishing socks then you may wish to buy the size down from your regular size. The Patagonia River Salt Wading Boots, Built By Danner in Feather Grey, are the result of a collaboration between Patagonia and famous boot builders Danner. Continuing with the same excellent qualities of performance, craftsmanship and innovation attributes as the Foot Tractors, the River Salt Wading Boots are designed for all long haul fishing trips. The interior of the Wading Boot has been improved to ensure a stable platform, featuring a molder bi-fit board combing the shank, midsole and lasting board in to an individual piece without reducing comfort or sustainability. With the newly designed soles, stitch down construction and stable platform, Patagonia believe these Wading Boots could potentially be the last pair you ever purchase. The soles can be easily resoled for a lifetime performance. The combination of being full-grain leather, tough material yet lightweight, waterproof, 1,000 denier nylon panels all provide protection from the river rock and coral heads. Patagonia have customised the fit across both the forefoot and ankle for increased support on uneven surfaces. The additional traction compound T. The Vibram® Megagrip has been developed for both wet and dry surfaces. If you are wanting to fish from a home pool or cross sharp coral and dirt-road walk-ins the additional traction has you covered.

item.g:title: Patagonia Swiftcurrent Expedition Waders Forge Grey
item.g:description: The Patagonia Swiftcurrent Expedition Wader in Forge Grey are Patagonias toughest and most-technical waders to date! They have been specially engineered for durability as well as mobility and are made from 100% recycled H2No™ Performance Standard face fabric. Featuring a single-seam construction for improved durability and a gusseted crotch for comfort and freedom of movement. The durable 100% recycled polyester microfiber H2No™ Performance Standard shell helps to provide a breathable yet waterproof barrier and has a DWR (durable water repellent) finish applied to the material. Comfort has been a key consideration in the design of these waders as such there is a fully adjustable, quick-release suspender system allowing the wearer to easily convert from chest to waist height wear and vice versa. The top hem has a drawcord cinch and there is a Secure Stretch no snag wadding belt. There are an array of features throughout the waders including waterproof flip-out pockets and horizontal-zip chest pocket; which allows the wearer to keep their hands warm; all to the interior of the garment and the centre-back hanger loop means that drying is quick and easy. The exterior features of the waders include a reach-through kangaroo pocket as well as a horizontal-zip chest pocket which allows quick access to tippet, nippers and floatant. The finishing touches include articulated legs, removable foam kneepads and heavy-duty scuff guards near the ankles as well as anatomical booties which are lower in volume and have a 'sock-like' fit for all day comfort and wading.

It’s a hip length fleece jacket that has two zipped hand warmer pockets for your personal bits on bobs. Polyester jersey fabric trims to the wind flap, cuffs and hem. This fleece is dyed using a more environmentally friendly method which uses less chemicals, water and energy than traditional methods making it a great find for our more environmentally conscious consumer. item.g:title: Polo Ralph Lauren Cauldwell 3-in-1 Water-Repellent Jacket Defender Green
item.g:description: This Defender Green set from Polo Ralph Lauren comes with a hooded jacket and a detachable liner that reverses between a matte and glossed side. PRODUCT FEATURES: Size medium jacket has a 73 cm front body length (front and back), a 59.7 shoulder, a 132.1 cm chest and a 91.4 cm sleeve length; sleeve length is taken from the centre back of the neck and changes 1.9 cm between sizes. size medium liner has a 69.2 cm front body length, a 69.2 cm back body length, a 121.9 cm chest and an 89.5 cm sleeve length; sleeve length is taken from the centre back of the neck and changes 1.9 cm between sizes. Jacket: drawstring hood with a built-in brim; leather stoppers; full-zip front with a leather zip pull; long sleeves with buttoned barrel cuffs; corozo buttons; ventilating metal grommets at the underarms. Jacket: two chest cargo pockets; two front waist buttoned pockets; interior left waist pocket; drawstring hem; leather "Polo Ralph Lauren" shield patch with our signature Pony on the left sleeve; unlined. Reversible liner: V-neck; buttoned placket; corozo buttons; long sleeves; ventilating metal grommets at the underarms; left chest patch pocket; two front waist patch pockets; fully lined and filled. Shell: 100% nylon. Lining and fill: 100% polyester. Machine washable.
