item.g:title: Primus Firestick Stove
item.g:description: The Primus Firestick Stove offers a streamlined, ultra-packable silhouette for adventurers who always want their stove within reach. Complete with a stand-alone, matchstick-style Piezo igniter and a wool storage pouch, this stove can slide into a coat pocket, a mesh water bottle pocket, or a bike pannier with ease. Mount this small burner on top of any gas canister, and fire it up with the single-handed use Piezo igniter. This slim stove offers a 2500W flame that can boil a liter of water in four and a half minutes, or can be lowered to simmer a delicate sauce. The wool storage pouch offers convenient insulation while handling your hot pot. After enjoying your hot meal, simply unscrew the Firestick Stove from the fuel, twist on the cap to hold the pot supports closed, and quickly stow in the wool storage pouch, along with the Piezo igniter. PRODUCT FEATURES: Pot supports offer flame protection in windy conditions and protect the stove when stowed Fine control valve for precise flame and heat control Twist on cap holds the pot support in a locked position Wool storage pouch doubles as a pot holder Remote, matchstick-style Piezo igniter included, no lighter required Invented in Sweden, made in Europe Gas NOT included

item.g:title: Primus Trek Pot 0.6L
item.g:description: The Primus Trek Pot 0.6L is the perfect pot for any size of adventure where minimal packing is a priority. We have challenged the size norms for this type of pot and we use the handle for securing everything into a compact package. The pot is made of hard-anodised aluminum, holds 0.6 litres and has a ceramic, non-stick coating. The bottom is a little thicker than the sides which makes cooking easier and reduces the risk of burning food during cooking. The bottom also has a spiral pattern which provides good friction against the pot support and more effective heat transfer. The handle can be locked in two positions. It offers a sturdy grip and makes cooking and serving much easier. When the handle is removed and mounted for packing, it occupies very little space and holds all the parts of the pot together. The lid is made of PP plastic and also serves as a strainer with a silicone handle. SPECIFICATIONS: Weight140 g Height90 mm Diameter94 mm Volume0.6 l

item.g:title: Snow Peak Field Barista Coffee Dripper
item.g:description: The Coffee Drip is one of the pieces in Snow Peaks new Field Barista series. Perfect for cafe aficionados unwilling to compromise the quality of that first cup of coffee in the morning no matter where their adventures take them. item.g:title: Westley Richards Selous Safari Jacket Savanna Green
item.g:description: Introducing the iconic Westley Richards Selous Safari Jacket in Savanna Green, a timeless piece famously embraced by legendary author and adventurer, Ernest Hemingway. This safari jacket is hailed as a must-have for any African expedition, staying true to its classic design while incorporating modern enhancements. Meticulously crafted from a premium Italian linen blend fabric, this jacket offers a perfect balance of cool comfort and durability, making it ideal for the rugged terrain of the African bush. The belted waist and checked shoulder add a touch of sophistication to its authentic design, reminiscent of the original version created back in 1939. Designed with practicality in mind, the Westley Richards Safari Jacket features four expandable bellow pockets, allowing ample space for essential items. The elasticated action back ensures unrestricted movement, while the padded shoulder checkering adds extra comfort during long journeys. With its easy packability, this jacket is a traveller's dream, fitting seamlessly into any luggage or backpack. Whether you're an avid explorer or a modern adventurer, the Westley Richards Selous Safari Jacket provides the perfect blend of style and functionality for your safari experience. PRODUCT FEATURES: 66% Linen, 32% Cotton, 2% Elastane Italian fabric Real horn buttons and buckle Bellow pockets Adjustable belt fastening Action back and vent Made in Portugal

Don't let your furry friend miss out on the YETI gear! Constructed with double-wall, non-insulated stainless steel, this Dog Bowl is durable, easy to clean, and resistant to rust - perfect for those long hikes or days spent at the park. item.g:title: YETI Hopper Flip 12 Soft Cooler Charcoal
item.g:description: The YETI Hopper Flip 12 Soft Cooler in Charcoal is a compact, carry-friendly cooler for lunches, drinks and days outdoors. Its wide-mouth opening makes loading and finding food easy, while ColdCell™ insulation helps keep contents cold through the day. Rugged enough for regular use and light enough to grab by the handles or shoulder strap, this YETI soft cooler is built for picnics, fishing trips, camping and weekends away. Please note: Hopper® Soft Coolers are not compatible with dry ice. The airtight zipper would not allow proper ventilation and could cause the cooler to explode. item.g:title: YETI Hopper M30 Cool Bag Black
item.g:description: The YETI® Hopper® M30 Cool Bag in Black is built to handle outdoor trips, combining robust durability with an easy-loading design. Featuring re-engineered MagShield Access, this YETI cooler bag has an extra-wide mouth that stays open when needed, making it simple to load and unload food and drinks. The MagShield closure uses ultra-strong magnets to create a secure, cold-holding seal, while Quick-Release Buckles add another layer of protection. The rugged DryHide™ Shell and ColdCell™ insulation help the Hopper® M30 stand up to countryside outings, fishing trips and camping weekends while keeping provisions cold. For added versatility, the YETI® Hopper® M30 has a built-in HitchPoint™ Grid, allowing you to attach handy accessories such as the Rambler® Bottle Sling or SideKick Dry® Gear Case. Finished in sleek Black, this cool bag delivers dependable performance and easy access for outdoor days. WARNING: Do not leave your soft cooler open in the presence of children and animals. Entrapment and suffocation can occur. WARNING: Hopper® Soft Coolers are not compatible with dry ice. The use of dry ice will cause the airtight vessel to explode. WARNING: This product contains magnets. Placing near a pacemaker may cause interference. item.g:title: Beretta Bakhold Thermo Jacket Brown Bark
item.g:description: The Mens Beretta Bakhold Thermo Jacket in Brown Bark is a versatile and highly functional hunting jacket designed for stalking or hide hunting in outdoor environments where staying silent and dry is crucial. Here are the key features and details of this jacket: Purpose: The jacket is designed for stalking or hide hunting, making it ideal for activities where silence and the ability to stay dry are essential. Waterproof and Breathable: It features Beretta's Waterproof Breathable (BWB) EVO membrane, providing complete waterproofness and wind protection while maintaining excellent breathability. This ensures you stay dry and comfortable in various weather conditions. Graphene Lining: The jacket incorporates a Thermal Graphene Body Map Technology lining for maximum thermal insulation. This lining, infused with graphene, enhances the jacket's cold resistance. Ventilation Zips: Underarm ventilation zips are included to prevent overheating and ensure breathability during physical activity. High Visibility Vest: The jacket features a removable vest made from high visibility material certified to EN20471 standards. This provides added safety during outdoor activities, especially in low-light conditions. DWR Treatment: The outer material is treated with "Durable Water Repellent (DWR)," enhancing its water resistance. Compatibility: The jacket can be combined with Beretta's Bakhold pants or Muker GTX pants for a complete hunting outfit. Open Country Environment: This jacket is designed for open lands with small forests and sparse vegetation. In such environments, silence and breathability are paramount. Additional Features: Removable hood Preformed "Easy Movement" design for a free field of vision Soft microfleece inner collar YKK zip closure and snap buttons with a placket Radio pocket with a hole for an antenna Hand warmer pockets with YKK zips Large front pockets with snap buttons Velcro adjustable wrist cuffs Underarm ventilation openings with YKK zips Single-entry rear game bag with a YKK zip Removable and washable game bag lining Removable "Beretta Hands-Free" braces Adjustable drawstring at the bottom Rubberized Beretta logo on the left sleeve Regular fit The Beretta Bakhold Thermo Jacket in Brown Bark is a versatile and highly functional hunting jacket designed to meet the specific needs of hunters in various outdoor environments. Its combination of waterproof and breathable features, along with the use of graphene technology, makes it an excellent choice for those who demand high-performance gear during their outdoor pursuits.

item.g:description: Introducing the Beretta Butte Softshell Vest in Moss/Brown Bark for men - an ideal outer layer offering protection from the elements while maintaining breathability. With its rugged yet refined moss and brown bark colour scheme, the men's Beretta Butte Softshell Vest brings versatile style to the outdoorsman's wardrobe. Designed for freedom of movement, this vest from Beretta ensures a worry-free range of motion while you stay focused on the path ahead. Because the last thing you need is your gear holding you back. Slip on the new Butte and head out in confidence, knowing this vest has you covered. item.g:title: Beretta CK rifle GA 22 / 223 / 56 Neutral Ufi
item.g:description: Enhance the performance and longevity of your rifle with the Beretta CK Rifle Cleaning Kit GA 22 / 223 / 56 Neutral Ufi. This basic carbine cleaning kit is a must-have for firearm enthusiasts. Inside each kit, you'll find a PVC-coated steel rod, which can be assembled into two ergonomic, non-slip handle pieces for easy use. item.g:title: Beretta Short Merino Socks Green
item.g:description: Short socks in merino wool and acrylic fibre. The Beretta short Merino Socks are made with a mix of merino wool and acrylic fibres that ensure warmth and high breathability thanks to the thermoregulation properties of natural fibres combined with the performance of technical fibre. The typical curling of merino wool fibres acts as an insulator trapping more air than the other natural fibres and creating a protective barrier against thermal excursion. Features: Rib structure ensures leg tightness without constraint. An elastic insert in the footbed keeps the movement stable and avoids the lateral slip of the sock. High heel with nylon reinforcement protects the part from higher wear and improves the strength of the product. Mesh areas with honeycomb structure help the moisture management improving breathability.

item.g:title: Dubarry Cyprus Shorts Navy
item.g:description: Classic, stylish and sporty, the Dubarry Cyprus men's crew shorts are a new design inspired by Dubarry's heritage and informed in-depth knowledge of sailing. The lightweight fabric repels water, dries remarkably fast when it does get wet, and serves as an effective sun protection with UPF-50 UV protection. They're also hard-wearing and will retain their colour after repeated exposure to sun and salt, even with regular washing. Technical features include a contoured, adjustable waistband with a non-slip inner and high back, designed for a secure and comfortable fit. Ample pockets secured with zips help keep your hands free when moving about on deck, and in one of the inner pockets you'll find a handy removable eyewear cleaning cloth on a bungee cord to keep your sunglasses clear of salt spray. Lightweight, water repellent and quick drying 97% nylon / 3% elastane fabric is colour fast after sun and salt exposure and repeated washing Shields from harmful sun rays with UPF 50 protection Contoured adjustable waistband has non-slip inner with high back Ample secured pockets on legs and back Removable eyewear cleaning cloth on a bungee cord in an inner pocket

item.g:title: Dubarry Genoa Brimmed Sun Hat Navy
item.g:description: As any sailor will tell you, exposure to UV rays is often extreme when you're out on the water and a wide-brimmed sun hat is an important part of your personal boating kit. It also reduces glare, helping you keep an effective lookout. Not just any hat, though you need one that's designed to stay on your head in gusty winds, with plenty of all-round shade and without a floppy brim that flaps annoyingly in a fresh breeze. An easily adjustable retention cord is also essential, and it's wise to choose one that's made from a water-repellent, quick-drying fabric with built-in UPF-50 sun protection. A new design that's strongly informed by our own long experience of sailing, the Genoa sun hat ticks all of these boxes and more. Lightweight, 100% Nylon material Quick drying and water repellent Shields from harmful sun rays with UPF 50 protective finish Retention cord fitted to keep headwear secure

item.g:title: Dubarry Womens Livorno Jackets Navy
item.g:description: An essential for every sailor’s kitbag and a versatile outer layer for everyday use. This Aquatech fleece-lined crew jacket for women combines exceptional waterproofing, breathability and wind resistance with classic yachting style. Croatia’s construction includes a supple outer shell with a durable water-repellent finish, taped seams and a polar fleece lining that cuts out wind chill. The sleeves are lined with super smooth nylon so they glide effortlessly on and off your arms. Key features include adjustable cuffs, corrosion-proof zips, a stand-up collar to keep the cold breeze off your neck, a chin guard for comfort and a neatly concealed rollaway hood. There’s also an eyewear cleaning cloth in one of the pockets, on a bungee cord, to keep the salt spray off your shades. Waterproof 100% polyester outer shell with taped seams and adjustable cuffs Durable water repellent (DWR) finish on outer fabric Waterproofness is a 5000mm waterhead and breathability at 5000gms Lined with a breathable 150gm2 polar fleece with added wind resistance Sleeve lining 100% nylon Zipped stand up collar with chin guard and concealed rollaway hood Keep eyewear crystal clear with a cleaning

item.g:title: Filson Dry Roll-Top Tote Bag Green
item.g:description: The Filson Dry Roll-Top Tote Bag combines 100% waterproof protection with simple and straight forward design! When cinched with the side buckles, the roll top closure prevents all water entry so that your belongings will stay dry all day. Crafted from tough 840-denier nylon tarpaulin fabric coated with thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), water simply cannot penetrate it. The advantages of using a nylon fabric with this coating are lightness of weight, flexibility and abrasion resistance. The highly-flexible TPU coating is resistant to ultraviolet light and chemicals, ensuring durability and longevity without breakdown from hard use. The seams are radio-frequency (RF) welded, a cement-free process that permanently fuses the fabric layers together, assuring flexible integrity without fail. All webbing and padding is securely stitched to an additional layer of the waterproof fabric, which is then RF-welded to the bag’s body. This is the same construction as used in the manufacture of white-water rafting gear. The true beauty of the this waterproof tote bag lies in its simplicity. The roll-top design has been proven for decades–with no moving parts, when the top is rolled down 3 turns and the side buckles cinched down, a waterproof seal is assured. The 28-liter bag rides comfortably at the hip when carried with the detachable, adjustable padded shoulder strap. For hand carry, the 2”-wide webbing handles are equipped with a comfortable neoprene grip. They extend down the sides of the tote bag for strength, and feature MOLLE loops and D-rings for attaching additional gear that requires quick access without waterproof protection. The Dry Roll-Top Tote Bag–combining the versatile convenience that’s the hallmark of Filson totes with state-of-the-art waterproof protection. *Please note the Dry Bags have a 84OD TPU coating and will fade in direct sunlight. This is a natural occurrence and will create a vintage feel over time.

The highly flexible TPU coating is resistant to ultraviolet light and chemicals, ensuring durability and longevity without breakdown from hard use. The seams are radio-frequency (RF) welded, a cement-free process that permanently fuses the fabric layers, assuring flexible integrity without fail. This is the same construction as used in the manufacture of white-water rafting gear, where equipment failure could have fatal consequences. This ultralight button-front shirt combines excellent moisture management and ventilation with a classic look that’s as comfortable on the river as it grabbing a beer after a long day of casting. Constructed with an ultralight blend of polyester and nylon, the Twin Lakes’ fabric wicks moisture away from the body for rapid evaporation. The vented back yoke sports a mesh underlayer, allowing heat to escape and allowing the breeze to provide natural cooling. Under-arm embroidered eyelets provide further ventilation. Unlike ordinary synthetics, this performance fabric is treated and tested to provide UPF30+ sun protection to prevent the harmful effect of ultraviolet rays on unprotected skin. And with an antimicrobial finish, there’s a need for concern about the perpetual odour that can build up in lesser fabrics. To round out the full complement of features, traditional Filson button-flapped chest pockets and slotted-utility pockets provide convenient access to accessories such as sunglass-cleaning cloths or small tools. item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Backpack Corn
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken Mini is back in a brand new colour! The Mini backpack is a perfectly formed smaller version of the Kanken Classic. It is ideal for children or for adults who are looking for a smaller backpack as the straps can be adjusted to suit both. Just like its parent, the Kanken Mini is made from super strong Vinylon F fabric, which is built to withstand dirt, and moisture. This can be very handy with little ones! It features a main zip close compartment with a zip close pocket to the front and a flat pocket to each side, so there is plenty of storage space available. Inside you will find an interior pocket containing a PE foam pad which protects your belongings from rubbing on your back and can also be removed to sit on. Of course, the Fjallraven Kanken Mini is finished off with the iconic reflective arctic fox logo to the front.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Backpack Light Oak
item.g:description: Kånken was created in 1978 to help prevent back problems among Swedish school children and, since then, has become one of Fjällräven's most appreciated products. The Mini-version is suitable for small children as well as for full-grown adults who are looking for a small backpack. It is perfect for carrying a change of clothes for preschool or food on an outing, and as a smart everyday bag for books, water bottles, fruit and more. The shoulder straps are long and adjustable and fit both small and big backs. They can be fastened with a clasp so that they are not in the way when at their tightest. The material is hard-wearing, lightweight Vinylon F fabric that is able to withstand dirt and wetness. The main compartment has a large zipped opening, which makes it easy to pack and unpack. Two flat side pockets and a zipped pocket on the front. The included PE foam seat cushion is stored in the interior back pocket and also prevents the contents in the main compartment from poking against your back. Handles at the top and slender, adjustable shoulder straps. The logo on the front is reflective. It also has an address label inside the main compartment. Popular backpack in hardwearing Vinylon F fabric. Carried as a backpack or a bag via convertible straps. Removable seat pad, reflective logo. Name and address label on inside of pack. Water-resistant, Quick-drying, Durable

item.g:description: The Fjällräven Kånken No. 2 Backpack in Deep Patina is a robust and stylish backpack made from durable G-1000 HeavyDuty fabric. It features leather handles and details for added durability and a touch of classic style. The backpack has a spacious main compartment, a front pocket, and comes with a padded sitting pad for added convenience. Just like other Fjällräven products, this backpack is produced without using PFCs (perfluorinated chemicals) and is designed to serve you for a lifetime.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Backpack is a great all round bag ideal for travel, education, work or everyday use. Perhaps one of the most durable Kanken bags on the market, the Kanken No. 2 is created from Fjallraven’s hardwearing G-1000 HeavyDuty fabric which can also be waxed for further protection. The backpack boasts a spacious zip close main compartment, a large zip close pocket to the front and two open side pockets meaning you can easily separate and organise your things. There is also a large inside back pocket containing a removable foam seat pad which can be taken out and used whenever you may need to rest or left in for comfort. Short handles and adjustable straps make the Kanken No.2 easy to carry. Settings this backpack apart is the leather details including the unique leather Fjallraven arctic fox badge to the front.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Black Edition
item.g:description: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 backpack in Black. The Kanken No. 2 re-envisages the style of the original Kanken Classic in G-1000 Heavy Duty, with tan leather trims and detailing. Includes zippered front pocket, and features vintage brass strap adjusters and Arctic Fox embossed poppers. Can be carried as a backpack or as a bag via convertible straps, and includes a sturdy seat pad in G-1000 Heavy Duty fabric, with embroidered G-1000 logo. Lined in G-1000 Lite, with contrasting colour internal rear pocket. The Kanken No. 2 can also be waxed using Fjallraven Greenland Wax for additional protection against the elements. 38cm height, 27cm width, 13cm depth Approx. 16 litre volume

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Laptop 15 Black
item.g:description: Introducing the Black Edition of Kånken No. 2 Laptop, a versatile and durable backpack designed for everyday use and outdoor adventures. The Black Edition of Kånken No. 2 Laptop is a practical and stylish backpack that's built to last. Whether you're commuting to work, heading to school, or embarking on outdoor adventures, this backpack provides the durability, comfort, and environmental responsibility you desire in a backpack. Features: Material: Crafted from G-1000 HeavyDuty fabric, this backpack offers exceptional durability and is built to withstand the demands of daily life and outdoor activities. It features a padded computer compartment for added protection and comes with stylish black leather detailing. Comfort: Designed for your comfort, the Kånken No. 2 Laptop includes the classic Kånken padded seat pad and comfortable padded shoulder straps, making it an ideal choice for those on the move. Adaptable: This backpack is adaptable and can be treated with Greenland Wax to enhance its water resistance and durability. It's quick-drying, ensuring it's ready for your next adventure. Environmental Consciousness: This product is produced without PFCs (per- and polyfluorinated chemicals) and features organic cotton and recycled polyester, reflecting a commitment to sustainability and responsible production practices.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Laptop 15 Black Edition
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Laptop bag offers a zip close padded laptop compartment suitable for laptops up to 15 inches. For your other belongings, there is another spacious zip close compartment. In addition, there are two open side pockets and a zip close front pocket. Inside is also a back pocket containing a removable seat pad, perfect for little breaks when out and about. The bag is made from durable, water resistant, dirt resistant G-1000 HeavyDuty fabric which Fjallraven is well known for. Carrying the Kanken No. 2 Laptop Backpack is easy with the leather top straps and padded shoulder straps which are adjustable to suit you. The bag is finished off with a premium leather Fjallraven arctic fox logo to the front.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Navy
item.g:description: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Backpack in Navy. The Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Backpack is a great all round bag ideal for travel, education, work or everyday use. Perhaps one of the most durable Kanken bags on the market, the Kanken No. 2 is created from Fjallraven’s hardwearing G-1000 HeavyDuty fabric which can also be waxed for further protection. The backpack boasts a spacious zip close main compartment, a large zip close pocket to the front and two open side pockets meaning you can easily separate and organise your things. There is also a large inside back pocket containing a removable foam seat pad which can be taken out and used whenever you may need to rest or left in for comfort. Short handles and adjustable straps make the Kanken No.2 easy to carry. Settings this backpack apart is the leather details including the unique leather Fjallraven arctic fox badge to the front.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Sling Black
item.g:description: Small shoulder bag in classic Kånken style with pliant straps and practical design. This totally black version is made from durable, water-resistant G-1000 fabric and has details in black leather. Besides the main compartment, there's an additional flat rear compartment that are both zippered. G-1000 HeavyDuty Eco in recycled polyester and organic cotton. Zippered main compartment with inside pocket. Zippered quick-access pocket on the back. Adjustable shoulder strap and handles at the top. Name label inside.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Organizer Fog
item.g:description: Just when we thought Fjallraven had thought of everything - along comes the NEW Kanken Organizer! Designed to fit perfectly within your Kanken backpack the new organizer allows you to store everything you need in a secure and purposeful fashion. The foldable Kanken Backpack Organizer features two zippered pockets, two pen holders and a sleeve pocket for storing A4 documents as well as a name label to ensure everyone knows who owns the latest Kanken Accessory! Expertly designed to compliment your Kanken Backpack the organiser slots seamlessly into the rear sleeve within the main compartment of your treasured Kanken meaning there's no chance you'll leave anything behind. Compatible with the following kanken's: Kanken Classic Re Kanken Kanken 13″ Kanken 15″ Kanken 17″ Kanken No. 2 Dimensions: 12.2 x 10.6 x 0.2

Part of Kånken Essentials, a series of smart accessories for outdoor life, travel and everyday use. PRODUCT FEATURES Durable, waxed G-1000 HeavyDuty Eco S. Recycled polyester, organic cotton. item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Rain Cover Mini Pink
item.g:description: Kånken’s Vinylon fabric can resist a brief showers but for persistent rain you’ll need a little extra protection. This rain cover is especially designed to fit your favourite backpack. It has a reflective logo and elasticated edging plus press buttons that hold it in place. Easy to pack into its integrated pocket, and with a small loop so you can attach it to your Kånken Mini with a small carabiner, for example. Fits Kånken Mini. Integrated pack bag with Velcro. Buttons at the top fasten it to the backpack’s shoulder straps. Reflective Kånken logo.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Rain Cover Mini UN Blue

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Rainbow Classic Backpack Light Oak / Rainbow Pattern
item.g:description: Nature has no prejudices – the rainbow has become a symbol for diversity, acceptance and equality and we think it perfectly captures the spirit of outdoor life. With Kånken Rainbow, Fjällräven celebrates every individual’s right to express themselves. Part of the sales from each backpack goes towards environmental projects within the Arctic Fox initiative. A special edition pack with all that great Kånken love, and a bit more. Made from durable, water resistant Vinylon F fabric. Pliant rainbow-coloured shoulder straps and handles at the top. Comes with a seat pad that is stored in a pocket in the main compartment. Reflective logo plus front pocket and side pockets. Address tag inside the main compartment.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Rainbow Sling Cobalt Blue
item.g:description: Introducing the special edition Kånken Sling with vibrant rainbow webbing straps, designed with sustainability in mind. This unique sling is produced without PFCs (per- and polyfluorinated compounds) and is built to last a lifetime, reflecting Fjällräven's commitment to environmentally friendly practices. The rainbow, symbolizing diversity, openness, and equal rights, perfectly embodies the inclusive spirit of outdoor life. Kånken Rainbow celebrates the freedom of self-expression, and with each backpack sold, 1% of the proceeds is dedicated to supporting projects within the Arctic Fox Initiative. This special edition Kånken Sling offers all the beloved features of the classic Kånken design, with the added flair of rainbow webbing straps. Its compact dimensions make it a convenient choice for carrying your essentials. The bag is made from Vinylon F material and features a durable polyamide lining. With a height of 20 cm, width of 15 cm, and depth of 8 cm, it offers a volume of 2.5 litres, making it suitable for a tablet up to 8 inches in size. The bag includes four pockets for organized storage, including an inside compartment, open outside pocket(s), outside compartment, and zippered outside pocket(s). Please note that this bag should not be washed, dry cleaned, bleached, tumble dried, or ironed. Instead, maintain its vibrant appearance with a soft brush and lukewarm water when necessary. Choose the Kånken Rainbow Sling to make a bold statement, support sustainability, and express your individuality while enjoying the great outdoors.

item.g:description: Replacement foam seat pad for the Kanken. Slots into the reverse compartment of your Kanken. This item is included with all new Kankens, but perfect if you need a spare or replacement for your original.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Sling Apple Mint
item.g:description: Introducing the Fjallraven Kanken Sling In Apple Mint a compact and convenient way to carry your essentials: Size: This small shoulder bag is designed with compact dimensions, making it an ideal choice for those who want to carry only a few essential items. It measures 20 cm in height, 15 cm in width, and 8 cm in depth. The shoulder strap has a length of 142 cm, offering versatile wearing options. The bag has a volume of 2.5 liters, making it suitable for your daily needs. It can accommodate a tablet with an 8" size. Material: Like the classic Kånken backpack, this shoulder bag is constructed from exceptionally hardwearing Vinylon fabric, ensuring durability and longevity. Design: The bag retains the characteristic Kånken format, featuring pliant straps and practical storage options. It includes four pockets for convenient organization: an inside compartment, open outside pocket(s), an outside compartment, and zippered outside pocket(s). There's also a small pocket on the back, perfect for quick access to your phone and other small essentials. Weight: The bag is lightweight, weighing only 190 grams, making it comfortable to carry all day. The Small Shoulder Bag is a compact and stylish accessory for those who appreciate the iconic Kånken design and want a convenient way to carry their essentials. Whether you're exploring the city or heading out for a quick errand, this bag offers practical storage and easy access to your belongings.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Re-Kanken Classic Backpack Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Re-Kanken Classic Backpack is an eco-friendly Kanken Bag made solely from recycled plastic bottles meaning it can then be recycled once again. What’s more, the bags are SpinDyed using less water, chemicals and energy than typical dying processes. The Re-Kanken bag model features a spacious main compartment with all round zip for easy access. It also has a zip close front pocket and two flat side pockets meaning to can separate your belongings easily. Inside is a slip pocket containing a foam seat pad which prevents your belongings from digging into your back and can be removed to sit on when out and about. Carrying the Re-Kanken Classic backpack is easy thanks to the short top carry handles and the adjustable backpack straps. Setting this bag apart from the rest is the tonally embroidered Fjallraven badge to the front.

item.g:title: James Purdey Shetland Shooting Fleece Jacket Khaki Green
item.g:description: The Purdey Shetland Shooting Fleece Jacket in Khaki Green is warm and comfortable, ideal for the cooler shooting seasons. Made from a super-soft fleece with reinforcement to the shoulder and pockets for added durability and that classic country look. The fleece offers a full zip close with premium leather pull tab, a protective collar to keep the wind at bay and elasticated cuffs to help seal in that all important body heat.

item.g:title: James Purdey Short Pattern Sock Petrol Blue
item.g:description: These Purdey Short Pattern Socks in Petrol Blue are hand knitted and are made in the U.K. They have a very smart pattern knitted into them. These socks are very warm and will keep your feet feeling very cosy.

item.g:title: James Purdey Silver Side By Side Engraved 1 And 2 Cufflinks Silver
item.g:description: The Purdey Silver Side-By-Side Engraved 1 and 2 Cufflinks in Silver are a unique and stylish addition to a gentleman's formal attire. These cufflinks are inspired by a Purdey Over-and-Under shotgun and feature intricate miniature engraving. Each cufflink is numbered and comes beautifully presented in an Audley Red gift box, adding to their appeal as a gift or personal accessory. These cufflinks are crafted from solid Sterling Silver and are hallmarked in Birmingham, ensuring their quality and authenticity. They are proudly made in England, reflecting a tradition of fine craftsmanship and attention to detail.

item.g:title: James Purdey Sporting Polo Shirt Navy
item.g:description: Designed with the shooter in mind the Purdey Sporting Polo Shirt in Navy incorporates padding from the front to the back of the shoulder which will help to reduce recoil impact when shooting and increase comfort when carrying bags thanks to the load dispersal. FEATURES: 54% Tencel, 43% cotton, 3% elastane

item.g:title: James Purdey Sterling Silver Flask Cufflinks
item.g:description: Add a touch of elegance to your shirt cuffs with the Purdey Sterling Silver Flask Cufflinks. The hip flask is a quintessential field accessory making these Cufflinks a perfect gift for any outdoor enthusiast. Whale Tail closure. Made from Sterling silver.

item.g:title: Leica Calonox View Binoculars
item.g:description: The Leica Calonox View thermal imaging camera is the ideal choice for professionals seeking reliable, high-quality images. With a simple touch of a button, this camera captures unrivaled image quality and offers digital zoom, pan, tilt, and digital focus capabilities. Whether you work in surveying, geotechnical engineering, agriculture, or other specialised fields, the Calonox View delivers top-class image quality. Powered by the new generation of Leica Calonix Thermal Imaging Camera Technology, this camera ensures precision, accuracy, and reliability. It is designed to be the perfect companion for land management applications, offering ease of use and capturing images effortlessly. Explore inaccessible areas with confidence using its digital zoom, pan, tilt, and digital focus features. The Calonox View is built to withstand any environment, making it suitable for rugged professional work. Experience excellent image quality and reliable results in fields like surveying, geotechnical engineering, and agriculture. With its powerful features, accuracy, and user-friendly operation, the Leica Calonox View thermal imaging camera is your ultimate professional companion. Embrace endless possibilities today by unlocking the full potential of this remarkable camera. The essentials: Powerful 640x512 px VOx Sensor with12 µm pixel size and LIO™) for impressive imaging performance High-resolution HD display (1280 x 960 px) 2.5-10x magnification range for detailed identification 3000m detection range Photo/video function with 16GB internal storage (plus live view) Internal rechargeable battery with up to 5 hours operating time Intuitive 3 button menu Wi-Fi functionality App available

item.g:title: Leica Ultravid 8x32 HD-Plus Binoculars
item.g:description: Introducing the Leica Ultravid 8x32 HD-Plus Binoculars - the perfect companion for capturing incredible detail and creating unforgettable experiences. Designed to exceed expectations, these binoculars bring your vision to life, transforming every moment into an extraordinary adventure. Equipped with state-of-the-art fluoride lenses, the Ultravid HD-Plus delivers unparalleled colour accuracy. Experience vivid, true-to-life colours that will leave you in awe. With exceptional brightness and razor-sharp clarity, the world becomes your canvas, explored with breathtaking precision. Say goodbye to unwanted light as the Ultravid HD-Plus minimizes it, offering perfect contrasts and revealing even the tiniest of details. Every scene becomes a captivating masterpiece, fuelling your passion for the world. Swift and precise focusing is a top priority. With Ultravid binoculars, effortlessly adjust focus with less than two turns, ensuring quick adjustments from close-ups to infinity. No more missed moments or blurry images, just pure clarity at your fingertips. Crafted to withstand tough conditions, the Ultravid HD-Plus is your reliable companion. Its lightweight yet durable magnesium alloy chassis will accompany you on all your adventures. The titanium center hinge axle guarantees seamless operation, allowing you to keep your focus on the unfolding world. Dive into underwater wonders with a submersible depth of 16.4 ft, making it perfect for marine enthusiasts. Come rain or shine, nothing will obstruct you from exploring endless possibilities. The AquaDura® coating protects the lenses from water and dirt, ensuring crystal-clear vision in any situation. Unleash your inner explorer with the Leica Ultravid 8x32 HD-Plus Binoculars. Join our community of passionate nature enthusiasts, photographers, and adventurers who rely on the finest optics for unparalleled experiences. Elevate your vision, immerse yourself in your surroundings, and capture every moment with precision and style. Choose Ultravid HD-Plus and embark on your extraordinary journey. The essentials: Relaxed observing during the day and into the early twilight hours Large field of view of 135 m/443 ft. for a thorough overview on vast terrain Compact, lightweight and powerful A small companion for long tours, whether it's an ascent in the Alps or nature observation on vast terrain

item.g:description: Strongly adherent synthetic special grease with ceramic solid lubricants. Ensures the safe functioning of all types of weapons due to its excellent lubricating effect.

item.g:description: Highly adherent, medium-viscous special oil for preserving and lubricating guns and metal parts. Ensures optimum corrosion protection and, thanks to its outstanding lubricating properties, provides optimum wear protection for moving parts and at all lubrication points.

item.g:title: Liqui Moly Rapid Cleaner In Spray
item.g:description: A combination of selected acetone-free solvents for the rapid, efficient cleaning and de-greasing of components. The low surface tension of this product gives it excellent penetration properties, enabling it to dissolve oil, grease, resin and contaminants easily, even in hidden areas. After the solvent has evaporated, the surface is left free of grease and residues. Only to be used on metal parts of a gun.

item.g:title: Musto Womens Edinburgh Primaloft Quilted Jacket Dark Sapphire
item.g:description: The Musto Womens Edinburgh Primaloft Quilted Jacket is both functional and flattering as well as being the embodiment of sustainable style. The insulation is crafted from PrimaLoft® Black Eco which consists of 60% recycled materials and the beautiful colour is created using the environmentally friendly e-dye® waterless colouring process. The overall aesthetic of the jacket is enhanced by the diamond and horizontal quilting to the jacket's outer layer; there is a YKK® zip and stud storm-guard closure, as well as stud down bellow pockets which also have a hand rest facility. Comfort is guaranteed thanks to the super snug high-back collar and there is Musto branded badge on the sleeve.

item.g:title: Lacoste Original L.12.12 Petit Pique Cotton Polo Shirt Midnight Blue
item.g:description: Lacoste Original L.12.12 Petit Piqué Cotton Polo Shirt Midnight Blue. The Original L.12.12 is the very first polo shirt invented by René Lacoste in 1933. With its collar, button placket and Petit Piqué, it revolutionised elegant sportswear and freedom of movement. Made using 20 kilometres of thread knitted under two levels of tension and a crocodile logo with 2367 stitches, the Original L.12.12 is a real coming together of know-how and expertise. If you are between two sizes, we recommend the smaller size. FEATURES: Petit Piqué, the Lacoste signature knit Ribbed collar and sleeves Classic fit, comfortable cut and sleeves Genuine mother of pearl buttons Embroidered crocodile sewn on the chest Cotton (100%)

item.g:title: Patagonia R1 TechFace Hoody Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia R1 TechFace Hoodie in Black is made from a warm, stretchy and breathable material with abrasion and weather resistance. This cool-weather crosslayer was designed for extended versatility in shifting mountain conditions. PRODUCT FEATURES: Lightweight double-weave fabric is soft and warm next to the skin, but doesn’t trap heat; the smooth outer face resists abrasion and sheds moisture with a durable water repellent (DWR) finish Adjustable, stretchy hood with a laminated visor provides coverage and visibility with or without a helmet The articulated pattern allows for a wide range of movements, especially reaching overhead or across the body An external zippered chest pocket and two high handwarmer pockets with mesh backers for ventilation keep goods close at hand and accessible even with a harness or a pack waistbelt Low-bulk cuffs stay out of the way when reaching for handholds Hem adjusts by pulling a cord in the handwarmer pocket and releases with cord locks at the front hem

item.g:title: Red Wing 6-Inch Classic Moc Boot Rose Abilene
item.g:description: The Red Wing 6-Inch Classic Moc Boot in beautiful and muted Dusty Rose Abilene leather; refreshing the beloved silhouette in a new take on a fan-favourite colour. First introduced in 1952, the Classic Moc has grown into one of the most beloved lifestyle boots in the world. Built today with the same pride and process as decades ago, the boots’ iconic Traction Tred outsole, formulated with polyurethane for a lighter, comfortable fit, and moc toe construction lead the way. The Puritan triple stitching and Goodyear welt make this style a legend in long-lasting wear. PRODUCT FEATURES: Leather type: Rose Abilene Leather care: Roughout/Nubuck Kit Leather protector Construction: Goodyear Welt Sole: Polyurethane Traction Tread Outsole

item.g:title: RRL by Ralph Lauren Slim Fit Selvedge Jean Once Washed 3
item.g:description: Slim Fit Selvedge Jean Once Washed 3 is made by RRL by Ralph Lauren in the USA from RRL's exclusive 16 oz. Hand-set chain-stitched belted waistband with inserted belt loops for added durability. Reinforced button fly ensures a consistent fit through years of wear. Five-pocket styling with authentic washers and rivets. Selvedge coin pocket. "RRL" embroidery at the coin pocket. Heavy twill pocket lining. Leather "RRL"-debossed logo label on the back right waist. 100% cotton. Machine washable. For best results, wear 90 days without washing. Made in USA.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Backpack Blackberry
item.g:description: Kanken was created in 1978 to help prevent back problems among Swedish school children and, since then, has become one of Fjallraven's most appreciated products. The Mini-version is suitable for small children as well as for full-grown adults who are looking for a small backpack. It is perfect for carrying a change of clothes for preschool or food on an outing and as a smart everyday bag for books, water bottles, fruit and more. The shoulder straps are long and adjustable and fit both small and big backs. They can be fastened with a clasp so that they are not in the way when at their tightest. The material is hard-wearing, lightweight Vinylon F fabric that is able to withstand dirt and wetness. The main compartment has a large zipped opening, which makes it easy to pack and unpack. Two flat side pockets and a zipped pocket on the front. The included PE foam seat cushion is stored in the interior back pocket and also prevents the contents in the main compartment from poking against your back. Handles at the top and slender, adjustable shoulder straps. The logo on the front is reflective. It also has an address label inside the main compartment. Product Features: Popular backpack in hardwearing Vinylon F fabric. Carried as a backpack or a bag via convertible straps. Removable seat pad, reflective logo. Name and address label on the inside of the pack.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Backpack Sunstone Orange
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken Mini in Sunstone Orange is a smaller backpack (measuring just 60cm) with adjustable shoulder straps. It is suitable for both children and adults - perfect for school, day trips or biking to work. Made from durable, lightweight and showerproof Vinylon F to keep belongings safe and dry. The Fjallraven Kanken Mini includes a functional main compartment with a large opening making it easy to add and remove belongings, two side pockets and a zippered pocket in the front. A seat cover in an internal pocket protects the back and provides a rest for tired legs. Finished off with the brand's round reflective logo, the Fjallraven Kanken Mini backpack is both functional and stylish. Measures: H 29cm x W 20cm x D13cm 7L capacity Made from Vinylon F, showerproof and lightweight Internal pocket with seat pad Front pocket for small belongings Adjustable shoulder straps

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Classic Backpack Sunstone Orange
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken Classic Backpack in Sunstone Orange is made from Vinylon F, a hard-wearing, lightweight fabric that is able to withstand dirt and wetness. The spacious main compartment has a large opening with a zip, which makes it easy to pack and unpack. It has two flat side pockets and a zipped pocket on the front, perfect for those bits and bobs that you want to keep close at hand. The included PE foam seat cushion is stored in the interior back pocket where it prevents the contents of the backpack from poking against your back. Product Features: Reflective front logo. Address label inside the main compartment. 2 handles at the top for carrying. Adjustable shoulder straps.

item.g:title: Fjallraven High Coast Totepack Mellow Yellow
item.g:description: The Fjallraven High Coast Totepack in Mellow Yellow is versatile, light and practical, designed to carry over your shoulder, in your hand or on your back. The main compartment has a computer pocket with a padded base and a small zippered pocket. The entire bag can be folded into its front pocket when not in use. The outer fabric is waterproof but not the zippers and seams, so the bag can handle getting wet but not being submerged. item.g:title: Red Wing Shop Moc Oxford Shoes Black Prairie
item.g:description: The Red Wing Shop Moc Oxford Shoes in Black Prairie can be traced to style no. 895 when the oxford version first appeared in the Red Wing Shoe catalog in 1954; just two years after the release of the iconic 8-in Classic Moc. Today, the Shop Moc Oxford draws inspiration from this style and it’s iconic best-selling siblings at taller heights. It features the same Goodyear leather welt construction, Puritan triple stitching, leather insole and Traction Tred outsole. The easy, ankle-height oxford offers ease of lacing and styling for warmer seasons or pair with pants for the same look as our 6-inch moc with a lighter weight. PRODUCT FEATURES: Leather type: Black Prairie Leather care: Neatsfoot Cream/All Natural Conditioner Leather Protector Construction: Goodyear Welt Sole: Traction Tred Sizing: We would recommend you drop half to a full size in this shoe

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Shoulder Pads Khaki Dust
item.g:description: Kånken was created in 1978 to help prevent back problems among Swedish school children and, since then, has become one of Fjällräven's most appreciated products. The Mini-version is suitable for small children as well as for full-grown adults who are looking for a small backpack. It is perfect for carrying a change of clothes for preschool or food on an outing and as a smart everyday bag for books, water bottles, fruit and more. The shoulder straps are long and adjustable and fit both small and big backs. They can be fastened with a clasp so that they are not in the way when at their tightest. The material is hard-wearing, lightweight Vinylon F fabric that can withstand dirt and wetness. The main compartment has a large zipped opening, which makes it easy to pack and unpack. Two flat side pockets and a zipped pocket on the front. The included PE foam seat cushion is stored in the interior back pocket and also prevents the contents in the main compartment from poking against your back. Handles at the top and slender, adjustable shoulder straps. The logo on the front is reflective. It also has an address label inside the main compartment. Product Features: Popular backpack in hardwearing Vinylon F fabric. Carried as a backpack or a bag via convertible straps. Removable seat pad, reflective logo. Name and address label on inside of pack.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Mini Pink
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Kanken Mini backpack is a perfectly formed smaller version of the Kanken Classic. It is ideal for children or for adults who are looking for a smaller backpack as the straps can be adjusted to suit both. Just like its parent, the Kanken Mini is made from super strong Vinylon F fabric, which is built to withstand dirt, and moisture. This can be very handy with little ones! It features a main zip close compartment with a zip close pocket to the front and a flat pocket to each side, so there is plenty of storage space available. Inside you will find an interior pocket containing a PE foam pad which protects your belongings from rubbing on your back and can also be removed to sit on. Of course, the Fjallraven Kanken Mini is finished off with the iconic reflective arctic fox logo to the front.

Re-Kanken mini backpacks come in a beautiful array of colours, which are achieve through a SpinDye process using less water, chemicals and energy than typical dying processes. item.g:title: YETI Rambler 30oz Travel Mug Black
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 30oz Travel Mug in Black is designed to keep you energised and hydrated on even the longest journeys. Constructed from durable stainless steel, the Rambler® 30oz Travel Mug features YETI®’s double-wall vacuum insulation, ensuring your drinks stay at the perfect temperature for hours, whether hot or cold. Its leak-resistant Stronghold™ Lid securely fastens with a twist and is designed for both right- and left-handed users, offering practicality on the go. The elevated handle provides a comfortable grip, while the mug’s cupholder-compatible base makes it a travel-friendly choice for commutes or countryside drives. Finished in a sleek Black DuraCoat™ layer, the mug resists cracking, peeling, and fading, ensuring it remains rugged and reliable for everyday use. Both the mug and lid are dishwasher safe, simplifying cleanup after a long day on the move. Whether navigating country lanes, tackling rough roads, or enjoying a moment to yourself, the YETI® Rambler® 30oz Travel Mug Black is built to deliver durability, convenience, and reliable performance. Please Note: The Stronghold™ Lid is specially made for the Rambler® 30 oz. Travel Mug and won’t fit other Rambler® Drinkware models. The Travel Mug Stronghold™ Lid has 4 placement options and plays nice with both righties and lefties, just like all our Rambler® Drinkware. No other lids are compatible with this product.

The Core Collection features one of the most popular style, redesigned with cow hide and a softer insole, resulting in a boot that is much more comfortable. The Carrier reinterprets the Postman from the heritage collection, originally developed for postmen in the United States. The Carrier is built on a Black Traction Tred sole with a Goodyear welt. The Carrier showcases the Red Wing Black Chapparal Smooth Finished premium leather from Red Wing Shoes’ own S.B. Foot Tannery. FEATURES Red Wing Black Chapparal (Smooth Finished leather) Black Traction Tred sole Goodyear welt Product Care: Leather Cream, Foam Leather Cleaner

item.g:title: Red Wing Womens 6-Inch Classic Moc Mocha Oro-iginal
item.g:description: Red Wing first made the Classic Moc in 1952. In the decades since, it’s grown into one of the most beloved lifestyle boots in the world. Initially created for sportspeople, it became an immediate favourite of farm and factory workers for its long-lasting construction and all-day comfort. The women’s 6-inch Classic Moc uses softer leather for a faster break-in period. The hydrolysis-resistant polyurethane Traction Tred outsole provides extra comfort at a lighter weight. The boot’s iconic Moc toe construction and Puritan triple-stitching is an unmistakable symbol of Red Wing quality. The timeless staple is constructed with a Goodyear leather welt, allowing for years of daily wear. PRODUCT FEATURES: Outsole: Polyurethane Traction Tred Construction: Good year Leather Welt Last: 105 Leather Type: Full Grain, Oiled Hardware: Nickel Eyelets Outsole Heel Height: 1.0 Resoleable: Yes

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Marlow Pant Blue Worn Bleached Regular Leg
item.g:description: The Marlow Pant has a relaxed, straight leg cut, with a very slight taper below the knee. Constructed in Carhartt's ‘Edgewood’ blue denim. item.g:title: Clarks Originals Desert Boot Beeswax
item.g:description: The Clarks Originals Desert Boot in Beeswax is born in the '50s, its minimal, progressive style sparked a worldwide footwear revolution – worn by beatniks, mods, Britpop bands, and Jamaican rude boys. And every design detail today remains true to that first pioneering pair. Here, the boot is crafted with clean lines which are enhanced with premium beeswax leather and finished with an unfussy lace fastening. The authentic crepe sole completes this distinctive silhouette. Instantly recognisable, forever iconic. A true original. PRODUCT FEATURES: Premium beeswax leather uppers Breathable leather lining Lace-up fastening for a secure, custom fit Signature pebble crepe rubber outsole

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Keb Agile Trousers Reg Leg Laurel Green / Deep Forest
item.g:description: Created to be your favourite all-round trekking trousers for adventures where excellent freedom of movement, durability and protection are paramount, Keb Agile Trousers for women are low weight and durable. Made of a double-woven stretch fabric that dries quickly and protects legs from rough terrain. Low-profile design with tapered legs and articulated knees, and the zippered leg pockets and knees are reinforced with G-1000 Lite Stretch for extra durability.You can expect to stay the same size in our Improved Fit if you wear an EU 34 through 44 and go down a size in EU sizes 46 and above. Product Features Made from polyamide with four-way mechanical stretch with G-1000 Lite Stretch reinforcements. Articulated knees, tapered legs and elasticated leg endings. Two zippered hand pockets and two zippered leg pockets. Elasticated leg endings with gusset and snap button. Regular fit and available in three lengths; short, regular and long.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Keb Agile Trousers Short Leg Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Women's Keb Agile Trousers Short Leg in Black are designed to be your go-to trekking trousers for adventures where freedom of movement, durability, and protection are essential. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Abisko Hike Trousers Reg Leg Black
item.g:description: Lightweight, comfortable and packable trousers for women, designed for hiking and travelling in warm climates. Abisko Hike Trousers W in G-1000 Air Stretch have a relaxed fit with an adjustable, stretchy waistband and integrated, removable belt. The zippered hand pockets have mesh linings, as do the zippered leg pockets that double as ventilation openings. The articulated cut combined with adjustable leg endings that can be rolled up make these trousers perfect for hiking in hot climates. Product Features Made of G-1000 Air Stretch in partly recycled polyester and organic cotton. High waist with stretchy waistband and integrated, removable belt. Hand and leg zippered mesh pockets that double as ventilation openings. Articulated knees and adjustable leg endings that can be easily rolled up. Relaxed fit and available in three lengths; short, regular and long.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Poncho Graphite
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Poncho in Graphite is an underestimated functional lightweight garment that should always be included in your equipment when you are out in the wilderness. It can naturally be used when it rains, it is just a matter of throwing the poncho over yourself and your backpack. However, a poncho can also be used as a tarp, wind sack or to cover your sleeping bag when sleeping under the stars. It is useful during your day-to-day activities, when commuting to and from work or when you are at outdoor concerts. PRODUCT FEATURES: Waterproof and breathable poncho. Press buttons in the sides.

The bag offers multiple attachment points and adjustable straps, allowing you to wear it over the shoulder, across your chest, or on a belt. item.g:title: Goldwin Pertex Shieldair Mountaineering Pullover Mist Gray
item.g:description: The Goldwin Pertex Shieldair Mountaineering Pullover Mist Gray is made of Pertex Shield Air developed to stay active in hot and humid environments with the comfort and portability required outdoors. Its pullover design uses less fabric and is lightweight. Designed to be useful throughout spring, summer, and beyond. PRODUCT FEATURES: Pertex Shieldair 3L (Face: 100% Nylon (W/Resin Processing) / Back: 100% Nylon) The roomy 3D pattern features wider sleeves and a body for comfortable arm movement and body mobility. Opening the zipper at the underarm that goes all the way to the hem from the top allows convenient access to the inner pocket. These side zippers can also work as a ventilator by opening down. High moisture-permeation with higher breathability compared to conventional waterproof/breathable material. Tabs on both sides prevent flapping when opened. The front zipper is offset-styled to minimise any interference around the face. The inner collar is designed with a material resistant to stains from skin oil to prevent fabric deterioration. The front mesh pocket is designed to function as an inside-out pocket that allows the mesh bag to be used on the outside when storing wet gloves or caps. Originally designed velcro cuff with an added slit for stretch fit at the wrist. The hood is compatible with a helmet. Comes with a stuff sack for easy packing.

Product Features: Cotton×Bamboo Broad (58% Cotton, 21% Polyester, 21% Rayon) Cotton has a natural texture that feels excellent to the skin. Rayon derived from bamboo, a familiar material in Japan, has excellent moisture absorption and flexibility. The fabric is a well-balanced blend of polyester material that is quick-dry and wrinkle-resistant. For ease of movement, a fabric at the back is cut biased to improve elasticity, and under-sleeves are designed with a pivot pattern that expands the range of motion, increasing mobility around the arm area. Snap button for stress-free put-on and take-off. The collar can also be worn as an open collar. Partially made of recycled yarn.

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 18oz Bottle Chug Black
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 18oz Bottle Chug in Black is a robust and practical choice for staying hydrated during outdoor activities, daily commutes, or countryside walks. With an 18oz capacity, this YETI Rambler bottle gives you just the right amount of refreshment to keep you going throughout the day. Constructed from durable 18/8 stainless steel, this bottle features YETI® double-wall vacuum insulation, keeping your drinks cold for hours. The leakproof Chug Cap allows for quick, easy sips while on the move, making it ideal for active lifestyles. The wide-mouth opening simplifies filling and cleaning, while the bottle's compact size fits comfortably in most cup holders. Finished in a sleek Black DuraCoat™ layer, the bottle resists peeling, cracking, and fading, so it stands up to the demands of everyday use and outdoor adventures. Dishwasher safe, it's easy to clean and always ready for your next outing. Whether you're navigating a busy day, working outdoors, or enjoying a weekend hike, the YETI® Rambler® 18oz Bottle Chug Black brings dependable performance, practical design, and lasting durability. Please note: Do not use this Rambler® Bottle Cap with carbonated drinks, as a container for food or perishable items, or for holding boiling liquids or contents exceeding 185°F/85°C. Product Features Made with kitchen-grade stainless steel, so it is puncture and rust-resistant. Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation - keeps cold drinks cold and hot drinks hot until the last sip. Dishwasher safe 100% Leakproof

item.g:title: YETI Yonder Tether 34oz Water Bottle Tropical Pink
item.g:description: The YETI® Yonder™ Tether 34oz Water Bottle in Tropical Pink is purpose-built for anyone who needs dependable hydration while exploring the countryside or tackling outdoor tasks. With a 1L (34oz) capacity, this lightweight YETI water bottle gives you ample water to stay refreshed on longer adventures or busy days. Constructed from durable, shatter-resistant, and BPA-free material, the Yonder™ Water Bottle is robust enough for rugged use while remaining light enough to carry on longer days outdoors. Its Tether Cap design keeps the lid securely attached, allowing for easy carrying or attachment to your bag or gear. The bottle's ergonomic design and convenient size make it simple to transport and fit into your outdoor kit. The bold Tropical Pink finish adds a vibrant touch and makes the bottle easy to spot among your belongings. Whether you're hiking, working outdoors, or enjoying a countryside picnic, the YETI® Yonder™ Tether 34oz Water Bottle Tropical Pink brings together durability, portability, and practical everyday hydration. item.g:title: YETI Rambler 35oz Straw Mug Tropical Pink
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 35oz Straw Mug in Tropical Pink is a durable and practical solution for staying hydrated during long outdoor activities or daily commutes. With a generous 35oz capacity, it’s perfect for holding iced coffee, smoothies, or water, helping you stay refreshed throughout your day. The wide straw and shatter-resistant lid are designed for convenience, with a built-in stopper to prevent spills during transport. item.g:title: Red Wing Shop Moc Oxford Shoes Oro Legacy Leather
item.g:description: The Red Wing Shop Moc Oxford Shoes Oro Legacy Leather is a modern take on style no. 895 from the Red Wing Shoe catalog in 1954. item.g:title: Paramo Womens Grid Technic Baselayer Black
item.g:description: The Grid Technic helps reduce the number of layers you need by offering cooling when exposed to the wind, or insulation when covered with a windproof or waterproof. PRODUCT FEATURES The Grid Technic has a zipped neck, thumb loops and a feminine cut. Variable ventilation to the skin provided by the zipped neck. A zip garage at the top protects soft skin under the chin. Thumb loops to hold sleeves in place when required. In cold conditions this eliminates any gap between glove and jacket in order to maintain hand warmth. A comfortable, feminine silhouette with a broad range of movement provided by efficient styling in stretch fabric.

item.g:title: Filson Western Tracks Blanket Blue Gold Multi
item.g:description: Filson Western Tracks Blanket in Blue Gold Multi. The throw-sized Western Tracks Blanket is ideal for taking the chill mornings in the cabin while the coffee brews. It’s machine-washable, so there’s no need for concern about using it around a smokey campfire in the evening. The 13-oz. Portuguese cotton flannel is brushed for softness and comfort. PRODUCT FEATURES 13-oz. 100% cotton Throw-sized Machine-washable Blanket-stitched edges for durability Custom graphics

item.g:title: Filson Tin Cloth Bush Hat Otter Green
item.g:description: Filson Tin Cloth Bush Hat in Otter Green. On the job or in the field, Filson's Tin Cloth Bush hat offers extra protection from the elements with its 3"-wide full brim. Water-resistant oil finish Tin Cloth fabric withstands abuse for decades. Features a cotton sweatband, leather hatband and ventilating grommets in the crown. Equipped with a leather chin strap for security in gusty winds. PRODUCT FEATURES Built with water-resistant Tin Cloth Cotton sweatband for comfort Ventilating grommets in crown 3"-brim for maximum protection

item.g:title: UGG Womens Classic Ultra Mini Platform Boot Sand
item.g:description: UGG Womens Classic Ultra Mini Platform Boot in Sand. This ultra, elevated Classic boot is a must-have combination of newness and nostalgia. It's made with rich suede and lined inside with UGGplush™ wool blend for signature softness. The outsole of this product is either a sugarcane EVA outsole, which is a responsible compound using sugarcane foam that allows them to reduce dependency on fossil fuels by replacing petroleum-based ethylene, or a Treadlite by UGG™ outsole. This product was made in a factory that supports women in their supply chain with the help of HERproject, a collaborative initiative that creates partnerships with brands like ours to empower and educate women in the workplace. PRODUCT FEATURES Suede upper Overlock stitch detailing on seams, Rear pull tab, Asymmetrical topline 17mm UGGplush™ 80% upcycled wool, 20% TENCEL™ Lyocell lining or 17mm UGGplush™ 60% upcycled wool, 40% TENCEL™ Lyocell lining 17mm UGGplush™ 80% upcycled wool, 20% TENCEL™ Lyocell insole or 17mm UGGplush™ 60% upcycled wool, 40% TENCEL™ Lyocell insole EVA midsole Sugarcane EVA Outsole or Treadlite by UGG™ EVA outsole Polyester binding or 100% recycled polyester binding 3.5" shaft height 2" platform height Leather heel label with embossed UGG® logo Best for: Casual

item.g:title: Filson Twin Lakes Short Sleeve Sport Shirt Gray / Blue / Cream
item.g:description: A favourite for warm-weather action. The Twin Lakes features slight stretch built-in for complete freedom of motion, whether casting dry flies in high-desert streams, hiking into alpine lakes, or poling a skiff across the tide flats. The polyester-blend fabric wicks moisture away from the body, dries quickly, and blocks harmful UV rays. Chest pockets are covered with buttoning flaps for security, and the left side features a slotted tool patch to keep accessories handy. Embroidered eyelets under the arms aid ventilation and in the pocket bottoms aid drainage. Button-front closure. Spread collar. item.g:title: France: The Monocle Handbook
item.g:description: France: The Monocle Handbook, the third instalment in Monocle's series of country guides, takes you on a tour of our most cherished Gallic spots. We have traversed the mainland to scout out the crème de la crème of the nation’s bounty. Come with us to Marseille and Montpellier, Biarritz and Brittany, with stopoffs in the Alps and along the rugged coast of Corsica. Break bread at both new and established bistros, visit luxury ateliers with a discerning eye for design and check in to Paris’s most storied hotels and metropolitan boltholes. Plus: toast the nation’s vineyards, the cultural spots honouring France’s artistic heritage and the plucky retailers setting up shop in the country’s second cities. Fancy staying a while longer? We’ll take you through the places in which to linger, should you wish to put down roots. France is the world’s most visited country – and for good reason. PRODUCT FEATURES Features: 224 pages, hardcover Published by: Monocle Printed in: Italy Dimensions: 21cm x 14.8cm x 1.5cm

The front zipper is off-set styled to minimize any interference around the face. The inner collar is designed with a material resistant to stains from skin oil to prevent fabric deterioration. item.g:title: Beretta B-Xtreme GTX Bibs Veil Avayade
item.g:description: Beretta B-Xtreme GTX Bibs in Veil Avayade. The B-Xtreme GTX Bib is designed especially for waterfowl hunters where durability and weather protection is key. To make it even tougher the knees and seat are reinforced with a fabric comprised of 16% Kevlar®, which is a tightly spun fiber that is nearly impossible to separate. It also contains a waist adjuster to regulate fit, form, and performance. item.g:title: YETI Rambler 42oz Straw Mug V2 Key Lime
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 42oz Straw Mug V2 in Key Lime is a reliable and durable companion for keeping hydrated during long days outdoors or on the go. With its generous 42oz capacity, this mug is perfect for iced drinks, smoothies, or refreshing beverages, making it ideal for countryside adventures, extended road trips, or a day spent working outdoors. The included shatter-resistant Straw Lid is designed with practicality in mind, featuring a built-in stopper to prevent spills and ensure secure sipping on uneven terrain. The mug’s elevated handle provides a comfortable grip, even when fully loaded, while its cup holder-compatible design ensures easy transport in vehicles or outdoor settings. Crafted from durable stainless steel and featuring YETI®’s double-wall vacuum insulation, the Rambler® 42oz Straw Mug V2 keeps your drinks cold for hours. The vibrant Key Lime DuraCoat™ finish resists peeling, cracking, and fading, ensuring the mug remains as tough as your adventures require. Whether you're navigating rough tracks, working in the garden, or simply enjoying the great outdoors, the YETI® Rambler® 42oz Straw Mug V2 Key Lime delivers outstanding performance, keeping your drinks cool and your thirst satisfied. Please note that the Straw Lid is not suitable for hot beverages. FEATURES: Stainless Steel, puncture and rust–resistant. Double Wall Vacuum Dishwasher Safe Cup holder dimension is a minimum of 3” in diameter. 13.2W X 27.5H CM

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 35oz Straw Mug V2 Key Lime
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 35oz Straw Mug V2 in Key Lime is a practical and durable choice for staying hydrated during long days outdoors or on the go. Designed to fit standard cup holders, this mug offers convenience and versatility for road trips, countryside outings, or all-day activities requiring cold, refreshing beverages. With a 35oz capacity, the Rambler® 35oz Straw Mug V2 is perfect for iced coffee, smoothies, or chilled drinks to keep you refreshed throughout the day. The shatter-resistant Straw Lid features a built-in stopper to prevent spills, ensuring secure sipping during bumpy rides or outdoor adventures. Constructed from durable stainless steel, the mug features YETI®’s trusted double-wall vacuum insulation to keep your drinks cold for hours. The elevated handle provides a comfortable grip, and the vibrant Key Lime DuraCoat™ finish resists peeling, cracking, and fading, ensuring the mug remains rugged and reliable. Whether you’re cruising along backroads, working outdoors, or enjoying a relaxing day in the garden, the YETI® Rambler® 35oz Straw Mug V2 Key Lime is built to perform, delivering practicality and durability for all your hydration needs. For hot drinks, YETI® recommends swapping the Straw Lid for the MagSlider™ Lid for added safety. FEATURES: Stainless Steel, puncture and rust–resistant. Double Wall Vacuum Dishwasher Safe Cup holder dimension is a minimum of 3” in diameter. 13.0W X 21.1H CM

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 25oz Straw Mug V2 Key Lime

item.g:title: Gramicci G-Pant US Chino
item.g:description: The Gramicci Pant US Chino is designed for durability and movement, crafted from rugged organic cotton twill. Featuring the signature diamond crotch gusset, they allow for a full 180° leg reach, while the built-in nylon cinch belt and elasticated waist ensure a comfortable fit. These versatile pants aren’t just for climbers—the combination of tough fabric and a relaxed fit makes them ideal for any activity that demands flexibility, whether hiking, cycling, or simply relaxing on a sunny day. Often imitated but never surpassed, the G-Pants remain a classic for good reason. FEATURES: Made with 100% Organic Cotton Twill Hard-wearing twill fabric Built-in nylon cinch belt Elastic waistband Diamond-shaped crotch gusset Two front pockets Two rear welt pockets Reinforced lock-stitching throughout Relaxed fit and low rise Inseam 32", Leg opening 8" (Size M) PLEASE NOTE: We use the Japanese sizing, therefore we recommend sizing up as they come up small. Any queries for exact measurements, please get in touch.

item.g:title: YETI Yonder Tether 1L Water Bottle Navy
item.g:description: The YETI® Yonder™ Tether 1L Water Bottle in Navy is purpose-built for adventurers who need lightweight, reliable hydration on the go. Designed to be both shatter-resistant and durable, this YETI Yonder bottle is made from BPA-free materials, so it's safe for regular use in rugged environments or everyday outings. The Tether Cap is securely attached, making it easy to carry or clip to your gear, so your bottle is always within reach. The lightweight construction means you can pack essential hydration without unnecessary bulk, perfect for countryside hikes, long walks, or outdoor work. Its large 1L capacity gives you plenty of water to keep you going during extended activities. Please note: This Yonder™ Bottle is not designed for use with hot or carbonated beverages and should not be used to store food or perishables. Whether you're exploring high peaks or simply heading out for a day in the countryside, the YETI® Yonder™ Tether 1L Water Bottle Navy brings practicality, durability, and easy carrying to your hydration setup. Product Features Includes an always-attached 100% leakproof Yonder™ Tether Cap Made from BPA-free 50% recycled plastic, excluding Yonder™ Cap 50% lighter than Rambler® Bottles Compatible with all Yonder™ accessory caps & large Bottle Sling (both sold separately)

Made from 100% cotton pique, it features a classic two-button placket, a fold-down collar, and short sleeves. The shirt is accented with Barbour’s signature tartan on the button placket and the inner neckline, adding a touch of heritage detail. item.g:title: Deerhunter Eagle Waistcoat Tarmac Green
item.g:description: The Deerhunter Eagle Waistcoat in Tarmac Green is a versatile, water-repellent, and breathable hunting garment. Featuring a smart inner panel in the front placket for added width, it can be worn as outerwear in warmer weather or as a mid-layer in colder conditions. The Deerhunter Stormliner® membrane ensures high breathability, making it ideal for active hunts. Functional features include radio attachment straps, practical front and chest pockets, and a game pocket with dual access, allowing easy carrying of hunting gear. Its sleek, traditional style also suits everyday outdoor activities. FEATURES: Artificial suede details YKK 2-way zipper at the centre front Inner panel in the front placket for extended width Straps for radio attachment Vertical chest pocket with a zipper Two hand warmer pockets with concealed zippers Two front pockets with zippers Game pocket with concealed zippers on both sides Two mesh inner pockets with zippers Logo tape inside Adjustable hem with a drawstring

item.g:title: Veja V-12 Leather Trainer White Cosmos
item.g:description: The bovine leather comes from farms in Uruguay, a country known for its culture of animal husbandry and the quality of its leather. It is tanned in Brazil without using any hazardous or prohibited chemicals. VEJA uses conventional dyes that comply with regulations. Special attention is paid to water usage during the tanning process. item.g:title: Barbour Beaufort Wax Jacket Archive Olive
item.g:description: The Barbour Beaufort Wax Jacket in Archive Olive is a hallmark of British craftsmanship and one of the most recognisable styles in our men's Barbour country jackets. Made from Barbour's durable 6oz Thornproof waxed cotton, it provides reliable protection against rain and wind while staying comfortable during long days outdoors. The Archive Olive shade blends naturally into rural and rugged landscapes. Key features include a practical game pocket at the rear, making it a strong choice for shooting or outdoor activities, while the generously sized bellow pockets provide ample space for carrying tools, maps, or other essentials. A two-way zip with a storm fly front offers maximum protection from the weather, while the signature corduroy collar, complete with press-stud fastening, accommodates a hood for added versatility. The interior is lined with Barbour's iconic tartan, adding a touch of heritage to this functional jacket. Adjustable cuffs and waist allow for a comfortable fit, whether worn over heavy layers in winter or lighter garments in milder conditions. Built to last, the Beaufort Wax Jacket is also re-waxable, keeping its performance season after season. Suited to fieldwork, countryside walks, or an outdoor lifestyle, the Barbour Beaufort Wax Jacket is a dependable companion with a clear connection to tradition. KEY FEATURES: Outer: 100% cotton (waxed) Lining: 100% cotton Eco wax finish Barbour embroidery on the lower left pocket flap Back length: 84cm Care instructions: do not wash; sponge clean only
