item.g:title: Barbour Bedale Wax Jacket Archive Olive
item.g:description: The Barbour Bedale Wax Jacket in Archive Olive is part of Barbour's countryside jackets for men and a classic example of the brand's outdoor craftsmanship, combining heritage style with dependable functionality. Crafted from durable 6oz Sylkoil waxed cotton, this jacket provides reliable protection against wind and rain, making it suitable for both town and country settings. Originally designed with equestrian use in mind, the Barbour Bedale Wax Jacket features a relaxed fit for ease of movement and layering. Its two-way front zip, reinforced with studded storm fastening, ensures effective weatherproofing. Moleskin-lined handwarmer pockets offer comfort on colder days, while the large bellow pockets provide ample storage for outdoor essentials. The signature corduroy collar can be raised and secured with the throat flap for added warmth. The jacket also takes Barbour's zip-in liners and optional hoods, adding further versatility. The interior is lined with Barbour's Classic Tartan cotton, giving a touch of heritage to a highly practical piece. Suited to countryside use and everyday wear, the Barbour Bedale Wax Jacket in Archive Olive is a reliable choice where functionality and enduring style matter. FEATURES: 100% waxed cotton outer Pure cotton lining 100% cotton sleeve lining Inner ribbed sleeves Two-way zip Corduroy collar Two handwarmer pockets Two large bellow pockets Back length: 76 - 81cm | 30" - 32" Studded for optional hood Interactive zip

Offering an understated workman look, this style boasts a spacious silhouette with a high-rise waistband for a laid-back cool aesthetic. Simply pair this style with an oversized T-shirt and trainers for a blend of smart and casual. FEATURES 98% Cotton, 2% Elastane Washed stretch twill, Garment dyed.

item.g:title: Barbour Washed Stretch Twill Regular Fit Trouser Dark Navy
item.g:description: Enhance your outdoor attire with the men's Barbour Washed Stretch Twill Regular Fit Trouser, combining both style and comfort for a versatile addition to your wardrobe. Made from washed twill, these trousers offer a relaxed fit in the hip and thigh, allowing for full freedom of movement. With a comfortable rise and straight leg design, they present a polished yet casual look. Featuring a practical five-pocket layout, chambray pocket bags, and Barbour tartan tape trim to the interior, these trousers offer timeless elegance. Pair them with a classic checked shirt and durable boots for a refined yet rugged look that effortlessly moves from country walks to urban excursions. FEATURES: Crafted from washed twill for comfort and durability. Ample room in the hip and thigh for unrestricted movement. Comfort rise with a straight-leg fit for a relaxed yet polished look. Five-pocket jean-style layout for added practicality. Chambray pocket bags and Barbour tartan tape trim on the interior. Machine washable at 30°C for easy care.

item.g:title: Barbour Kirkhill Showerproof Jacket Navy
item.g:description: The Barbour Kirkhill Showerproof Jacket in Navy is a lightweight, packable layer made from matte-finish polyester with unlined garment construction. A fixed hood with cotton back-neck buggy, elasticated cuffs, front zip fastening and Barbour embroidery to the lower left pocket make it a simple wet-weather option within our men's Barbour showerproof jackets collection. It offers light rain protection without heavy padding, making it practical for daily wear, weekends and changeable conditions. The clean navy finish keeps the look understated. Features Outer: 100% polyester Back-neck buggy: 100% cotton Lightweight matte-finish fabric, unlined garment construction Barbour embroidery to wearer's lower left pocket Back length: 78cm Machine wash 30 °C

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Abisko Winter Stretch Trousers Wood Brown
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Abisko Winter Stretch Trousers are engineered for comfort and high performance in cold weather. Designed with articulated knees and an elasticated waistband, they provide excellent freedom of movement. The adjustable leg endings with cinches help prevent snow from entering, while zippered hand and leg pockets offer practical storage. Perfect for winter adventures, these trousers offer a great balance of warmth, durability, and protection from the elements. FEATURES All-round, soft-shell trekking trousers for cold conditions. Soft, warm, stretchy fabric with a brushed inside. Recycled polyamide, polyester and elastane blend with a DWR produced without PFAS. Articulated knees and elasticated waist giving excellent freedom of movement. Zippered hand pockets and leg pocket.

Reinforcement fabric with a water-repellent finish provides extra protection in rough terrain – Abisko Trekking Tights HD W are well-fitting, highly functional and technical tights perfect for all kinds of trekking where you need full freedom of movement combined with durability. A comfortable, high waistband with inside drawstring and full-length legs with low-profile hems. Secure leg pockets – one zippered and one with an envelope closure – angled for easy access and a flattering fit. FEATURES Double-knitted stretch fabric in recycled polyester. item.g:title: Fjallraven Greenland Jeans Long Deep Forest
item.g:description: Like a pair of jeans, but with built-in functionality. Greenland Jeans are a durable everyday pair of trousers that also work well on trekking or fishing outings. Articulated knees and gusset at the crotch give comfortable freedom of movement when stepping over logs and stones and the leg pocket takes care of a map, phone or a box of fishing lures. Durable, fast-drying G-1000. Regular Fit with tapered cut. Regular leg length. Gusset at crotch for comfort and freedom of movement. Articulated knees. Leg pocket with flap and button. Two hand pockets. Coin pocket. Two back pockets. Wind and water-resistant. Weather protection can be adapted with Greenland Wax. FEATURES: Hardwearing, functional 5-pocket jeans for everyday outdoor life. Made from G-1000 with recycled polyester and organic cotton. Two hand pockets, one small coin pocket and two back pockets. Leg pocket with buttoned flap and hidden bellows. Regular fit with slightly tapered legs.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Barents Pro Trousers Black
item.g:description: Durable trekking trousers for adventures in the mountains and forest. Made using durable wind- and water-resistant G-1000 fabric with a double layer over the rear and knees. Regular waist (mid waist) and regular fit with pre-shaped knees. Six practical pockets including a map pocket and a multitool pocket. Equipped with openings for knee pads (an accessory). Raw-length leg endings that can be easily adapted for your own height. FEATURES Hardwearing trousers in G-1000. Reinforced rear and pre-shaped knees with openings for knee pads (an accessory). Hand pockets, map pocket, multitool pocket, internal phone pocket. New Standard: Raw length 36". UPDATE: New, more inclusive fit.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Abisko Winter Stretch Trousers Deep Forest
item.g:description: Fjallraven Abisko Winter Stretch Trousers in Deep Forest. Hardwearing winter trousers in a double weave, four-way stretch polyamide/polyester blend with brushed inside for extra warmth and comfort. Abisko Winter Stretch Trousers for men have unrivalled freedom of movement and excellent durability, making them suitable for all kinds of outdoor winter adventures. Articulated knees and a tapered cut with leg endings that have zippered gussets that can be opened to fit over boots. Zippered hand pockets and a zippered security pocket in side seam. FEATURES Durable winter trousers in four-way stretch fabric. Made of a double weave recycled polyamide /polyester/elastane blend fabric. Fit allows for base layer garments underneath. Brushed inside for extra warmth and comfort. Tapered legs with gussets in leg endings so can be worn over boots.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens 1960 Logo Badge Sweater Port
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens 1960 Logo Badge Sweater is a versatile backpack and vest combination designed for various types of hunters, including bird hunters and dog handlers. item.g:description: The Fjallraven Women's Nuuk Lite Parka in Dark Oak is a lighter take on the Nuuk Parka and part of our women's winter parkas collection, made for milder conditions. A protective hood with detachable faux fur edging, a drawcord waist and a two-way zip with a press-button flap handle the weather, while warm chest-height hand pockets and bellows pockets cover storage. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Stina Fleece Black
item.g:description: Comfortable and soft fleece sweater; made from recycled polyester with a slightly marbled look. As appropriate on a mountain hike as it is when worn as a warm middle layer under a shell jacket or by itself over a shirt as the dew falls on a nice summer evening. The fleece is manufactured in an environmentally friendly process that both spins and dyes the thread in the same step. For this model, that means about 50 percent less water and 31 percent less energy consumption compared to a traditionally produced fleece sweater. High collar protects you from biting winds, and there is a protective flap of fleece between the zipper and chin. Two spacious zippered side pockets. All of the zipper flaps are made from natural tone leather. FEATURES Mélange fleece made from solution-dyed recycled polyester. Lightweight fleece that gives that extra layer on colder days. High collar with chin guard, and two zippered hand pockets.

FEATURES Warm hooded fleece in recycled polyester. Smooth outer face that slides easily under a shell jacket. Grid-structured lofty inside that transports moisture away and dries fast. Snug-fitting hood. Two-way full-length front zipper.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken No. 2 Hazel Brown
item.g:description: Straight backs are healthy backs! Kånken was released in 1978 to help prevent back problems seen among Swedish school children. Now over 35 years later Kånken has straightened out millions of backs and become one of Fjällräven’s most popular products, loved by generations of users. Kånken No. 2 is made from durable, double-waxed G-1000 HeavyDuty with an inside back pocket in G-1000 Lite. Just like its predecessor, it is a durable everyday backpack, just as practical to use on the way to school or work as when on an outing or out travelling. The main compartment has a generous opening that makes it easy to pack and take things out. The back pocket has a padded sitting pad in G-1000 HeavyDuty so a comfortable rest is never far away. Two open pockets on the sides and a zippered pocket on the front. Details and handles in leather, shoulder straps in textile. Impregnation can be easily enhanced with Greenland Wax, something that also further increases durability. PRODUCT FEATURES Kånken in G-1000 HeavyDuty with leather details. Seat pad made from G-1000 HeavyDuty. Inside back pocket in G-1000 Lite. Two side pockets and a zippered pocket on the front. Details and handles in leather.

Simply fasten it around your hips for convenience and ease of movement. FEATURES Made from durable, water-resistant Vinylon F fabric. Main compartment with inside pocket and key clip. Two zippered outside pockets. Adjustable hipbelt and handle at the top.

PRODUCT FEATURES Zippered main compartment with inside sleeve pocket and key clip. Zippered front pocket and security pocket at the back. item.g:title: Jackman Nap Sweat Crewneck Navy
item.g:description: The Jackman Nap Sweat Crewneck in Navy is designed with a unique blend of materials for both style and comfort. The front and middle sections are crafted from cotton threads, while the back is made from acrylic. The special brushing technique used on the backside fleece creates a nap-raised texture, similar to that of boa fabric. Please note that the back of the navy version is in the same color as the front, not olive as might be expected. Featuring an elaborate set-in raglan sleeve design, this crewneck is enhanced with covering stitching that conceals the seam allowance, offering both improved comfort and a sleek appearance. FEATURES: Front and middle made from cotton threads Back crafted from acrylic Nap-raised fleece with a texture similar to boa Same color navy on the back (not olive) Set-in raglan sleeve design for a modern look Covering stitching for a clean finish and extra comfort

item.g:title: Jackman Waffle Crewneck Black
item.g:description: The Jackman Waffle Crewneck in Black offers a vintage-inspired look with its tight crew neck design. The thick and uneven fabric is carefully crafted to prevent any waving, ensuring durability and a clean finish. This crewneck is made from soft, twisted cotton yarn and features a waffle-knit pattern, created using a rare 5G jacquard knitting machine—typically reserved for wool knits and rarely used for cotton items. The lightly twisted cotton yarn reduces weight, while the thick yarn contributes to a fluffy, bulky texture. FEATURES: Made from 100% cotton Tight crew neck design for a vintage look Waffle-knitted using a rare 5G jacquard knitting machine Soft twisted cotton yarn to reduce weight Thick yarn creates a fluffy, bulky feel Made in Japan

item.g:title: Jackman Waffle Midneck Olive
item.g:description: This unique piece by Jackman is a collaboration with Lavenham, a well-known British brand with over 50 years of history. Combining Jackman's signature waffle mid-neck and Lavenham's quilted elements, this sweater adds a refreshing twist to a timeless design. The waffle fabric is slowly knitted at low speeds using thick yarn, creating a soft and plush material that is naturally stretchy. The body is sewn with flat seams for a comfortable feel against the skin. The striped and diagonal quilting on the shoulders and forearms is inspired by reinforcement details on vintage baseball uniforms. Features: Mid-neck rib collar Waffle knit fabric Flat-lock seams throughout Ribbed hem, cuffs and collar Diamond quilting at shoulders and forearms Woven brand tag at side seam 100% Cotton Made in Japan

item.g:title: Jackman Henleyneck T-Shirt Navy
item.g:description: Jackman Henleyneck S/S T-Shirt In Navy. Features: It features the rough texture and rough look that is unique to American cotton. From the 2011 Spring/Summer season, the design has been changed to +3cm in width, +2cm in shoulder width, +2cm in length, and +2cm in sleeve length compared to the conventional JM5713. The 77Sumikuro color buttons are black faded buttons, which is different from the conventional buttons. This Henleyneck T-Shirt is now loose and easy to wear.

item.g:title: Jackman Waffle Knit Cap Dark Navy
item.g:description: Big waffle is a material that has a warm look, a plump and thick texture, and is also durable. To ensure that you can use it for a long time, the original big waffle fabric is rolled up and relaxed once before being cut and sewn. We have taken the time and effort to make it less likely to warp or shrink even after repeated wearing and washing. It has a unique design with a little extra at the tip to make it look cute when worn.

item.g:title: Jackman Dotsume Pullover Parka Olive
item.g:description: Jackman continues to impress with every release, and this piece is no exception. This round, we delve into the world of mid-heavyweight sweats with a wonderfully unique pullover. Featuring buttons at the collar and ribbed style cuffs similar to the mid-neck waffles, this sweatshirt is one of the most distinctive knits we've ever encountered. Its dense, thick texture is characteristic of all the Dotsume pieces from Jackman. This sweatshirt uses the original degree-stuffed fleece, knitted to the utmost limit using hanging knitting machines for even density. Though thin, it feels firm and is highly resistant to shrinkage or distortion, even after multiple wears and washes (which we've personally confirmed). Designed with ease of movement in mind, it features an integrated three-dimensional pattern and a loose silhouette, including a triangle gusset under the armpit for added comfort. item.g:title: Attirecare Stain Removing Extract Textile
item.g:description: Founded in 2017 by Abigail Brookes and Seb Collinge, Attirecare is a Manchester-based sustainable lifestyle destination - the first brand of its kind to offer all ranges under one umbrella. Family run, small-batch produced and championing a circular approach, Attirecare centers its values around people and the environment. Created by hand with entirely natural and organic ingredients and operating a zero-waste, made-to-order model, the elevated yet functional brand provides solutions to prolong the life of modern-day wares with its shoe care, garment care, and home care collections. FEATURES The Stain Removing Extract is an all-aqueous fluid, readily and rapidly biodegradable and carbon neutral, it has no environmentally hazardous ingredients, ensuring it is free from enzymes, bacteria, acids & phosphates. Made in United Kingdom Vegan and cruelty-free Free of parabens, phthalates, and sulfates Use as a pre-wash solution to tackle deep set stains 500 ml

item.g:title: Attirecare Shoe Deodoriser 250ml
item.g:description: Attirecares products offer something a little different to what you'd normally find on the market, great garment care products, well designed and in harmony with the planet. With a floral citrus-like undertone and a middle infusion of warm herbal notes, this takes a piece of Tuscan countryside with you. Made and produced in the United Kingdom, you simply spray inside your shoes and wait for them to try. FEATURES Ingredients: Purified water, essential oil, fragrance, food-grade preservative, sodium carbonate.

item.g:title: Attirecare Ultimate Shoe Care Kit 250ml
item.g:description: Keep your treasured footwear box fresh with The Ultimate Shoe Care Kit, containing everything you need to protect and restore shoes to mint condition. From protection when new, to saving your favourite pair; all in one kit. Attirecare's water-based, all-natural solutions are safe to use on all materials including leather, vinyl, cloth, suede, canvas and nubuck, leaving all well-loved shoes – from your favourite suede trainers to smart leather loafers – almost as good as new. FEATURES Protect and restore your shoes Water based All natural solution Can be used on many materials Includes: Cleaning solution (250ml), The Protector (250ml), Shoe Deodoriser (250ml), Soft Cotton Travel Pouch, Premium Brush and Cleaning Towel Unfortunately due to the glass contents we cannot ship this outside of the UK

item.g:title: Goldwin Pertex Double Cloth Field Warm Shirt Shadow Gray
item.g:description: Goldwin Pertex Double Cloth Field Warm Shirt in Shadow Gray. A lightweight shirt made of Pertex Equilibrium that has double weave structure with different densities on each side of its surface; ideal for outdoor activities such as mountain climbing, or as a wind shell. FEATURES The densely woven outer surface has excellent durability and water repellency, while uneven skin side is resistant to sticking to the skin. The lining is made from Octa, an environmentally friendly material that is extremely lightweight, soft, and has just the right amount of heat retention and breathability to prevent stuffiness and overheating. Boxy silhouette that pairs well with many outerwear, and the front has snap buttons for easy on and off. A three-dimensional design with pivot sleeves and a gusseted pattern on the sleeve bottom improves both shoulder and arm mobility. From the bottom of the sleeve to the side comes a zipper with a double slider to adjust how it opens, which also works as a ventilation. The inside of the right chest pocket is an inside-out mesh pocket that can be taken out as needed. Recycled yarn is partially used to lessen the environmental impact. ＜Face＞PERTEX EQUILIBRIUM (Nylon100% (W/Resin Processing)) ＜Lining＞Body: Octa (Polyester100%) / Sleeve Lining: Antistatic Taffeta (Polyester100%)

item.g:title: Red Wing Moc Toe Boot Black Harness
item.g:description: The Classic Moc was first made by Red Wing Shoes in 1952. In the decades since, the silhouette has grown into one of the most beloved lifestyle boots in the world. Initiallydesigned for sportspeople, the boot quickly grew into a favourite of farm and factory workers for its long-lasting construction, steady traction and all-day comfort. The Classic Moc’s features live on today, as the boot is built with the same pride and process now as it was then. The 6-inch Classic Moc’s iconic Traction Tred rubber outsole, Puritan triple stitching and Goodyear welt make the boot a legend in durability with more than 70 years in the making. FEATURES Leather: Black Harness | Leather care: Boot oil Construction / sole: Goodyear Welt | Sole: Black Traction Tread Outsole

item.g:title: Red Wing Beckman Boot Cigar Excalibur
item.g:description: Inspired by Red Wing's founder and the idea that a boot should easily transition from the muddy streets of his first shop to an important business meeting. The Beckman is our most premium boot in the nail-seat collection and carefully refined by the same design team that brought you the original when it first launched in the early 2000’s. Full-grain excalibur leather is pulled over an updated no. 224 last and added heel pad isplaced on the leather insole for a more comfortable fit. The full leather outsole with Gro-Cord forefoot and heel offers traction across terrains. Deep-coloured stitching allows for the boot to be polished with coloured creams for long-lasting wear.In his honour, the Beckman truly rises to the occasion.

Full-grain excalibur leather is pulled over an updated no. 224 last and added heel pad isplaced on the leather insole for a more comfortable fit. The full leather outsole with Gro-Cord forefoot and heel offers traction across terrains. Deep-coloured stitching allows for the boot to be polished with coloured creams for long-lasting wear.In his honour, the Beckman truly rises to the occasion.

item.g:description: In Monocle’s latest book, Swim & Sun, you’ll find their pick of the places in which to cool off when the mercury rises and plenty to get you dreaming about your next dip. We celebrate the joys of diving into the ocean, leaping into a river and allowing your limbs to stretch – and your mind to clear – as you simply swim. In its visually stunning pages, the guide celebrates the sunny pleasures on offer at our favourite beach clubs, urban pools and lakeside bathing spots. Pick up a copy and jump in. The water’s perfect.

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 26oz Straw Bottle Black
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 26oz Straw Bottle in Black is designed for easy hydration on the go, making it a reliable choice for countryside walks, outdoor adventures, or daily commutes. Its 26oz capacity gives you ample space for your favourite cold drinks, helping you stay refreshed throughout the day. Crafted from durable 18/8 stainless steel, this YETI straw bottle features YETI® double-wall vacuum insulation, keeping your beverages cold for hours. The flip-up Straw Cap makes sipping simple and convenient, while the shatter-resistant design helps it stand up to rugged use. A sturdy carry handle is integrated into the lid, making it easy to transport whether you're hiking, working outdoors, or heading to the gym. The sleek Black DuraCoat™ finish resists peeling, cracking, and fading, so the bottle maintains its appearance through everyday use. Dishwasher safe for easy cleaning, it keeps maintenance simple after long days outdoors. item.g:title: Paramo Womens Bentu Fleece Midnight
item.g:description: The Paramo Womens Bentu Fleece in Midnight. Hand-warming and secure storage from map-sized easy-access chest pocket and two zipped handwarming pockets. Excellent articulation and light stretch for full and easy movement. Nikwax Fleece is water-repellent, wind resistant and directional - Nikwax Fleece Fabric actively pushes liquid water away from you to keep you dry even in conditions of high humidity. The fleecy fabric traps still air to warm you. If combined with a Nikwax Windproof outer to deflect raindrops and cut wind chill, Nikwax Fleece will provide full weatherproof protection and remove perspiration very effectively, working well in all temperatures and humidity conditions. Nikwax Fleece+ is a high loft, highly insulating fabric that provides excellent directionality and extra warmth.

item.g:title: Paramo Womens Alta Trek Trousers Black
item.g:description: The Alta Trek Trousers are for people who require a comfortable and functional pair of trousers for a range of outdoor activities. If you enjoy walking, hiking or trekking across varied terrain, you need legwear that provides all-day comfort; easy, unrestricted movement; and clever, useful features. Good protection from wind and showers is also essential. The ergonomic and practical design of the Alta Trek Trousers, combined with Nikwax Wind Resistor fabric, delivers all the above in one efficient package. They are the ideal garment for tackling both low-level and high-level walking activities in changeable weather. The Alta Trek Trousers provide unrestricted movement, easy and rapid temperature control, and multiple functional features. FEATURES Unrestricted movement provided by 100% polyester microfibre fabric with a mechanical 4-way stretch, excellent articulation, and a clever cut. Easy, effective temperature control from long, zipped thigh vents that can be used on the move. Multiple features include 4 pockets for storage and handwarming, brace loops and a double popper waist closure for added security, an adjustable hem with popper closure for adaptable fit, and a high sitting back yoke for extra protection when needed.

item.g:description: Wide-wale corduroy and suede elbow patches give the Polo Ralph Lauren Classic Fit Suede-Patch Corduroy Shirt in York Brown a rugged, rustic feel, with a straight collar and two chest cargo pockets. item.g:title: Hanwag Cabin Loafer Wine Red
item.g:description: The Hanwag Cabin Loafer in Wine Red combines Tirolean wool expertise with Bavarian craftsmanship. Made by Gottstein, a leader in wool processing since 1926, this slipper is crafted from 100% mulesing-free new wool. It offers durability, moisture and temperature regulation, and comfort, with soft knit edging. The high-quality Tyrolean mountain water used in the felting process ensures a seamless, handcrafted fit. The loafer is finished with a non-slip, waterproof natural latex sole, providing excellent functionality and comfort. FEATURES 100% pure new wool Durable, moisture- and temperature-regulating natural material Comfortable to wear thanks to high elasticity Soft fine knit border Practical loop for hanging up/fastening Non-slip, waterproof natural latex sole

item.g:title: Fjallraven Wool Sock Navy
item.g:description: Never have cold feet again with Fjällräven Wool Socks in Navy, designed to keep your feet warm and cosy, even in damp conditions. The comfortable wool blend combines the temperature-regulating properties of wool with the durability of synthetic fibres. With mid-foot arch support, underfoot cushioning for extra comfort, and a reinforced heel for exceptional durability, these socks are a must-have for any outdoor adventure. FEATURES: Material: 70% wool (traceable), 15% polyamide, 15% elastane Temperature Regulation: Wool blend keeps feet warm even in damp conditions Comfort: Mid-foot arch support and underfoot cushioning Durability: Reinforced heel for long-lasting wear

item.g:title: Patagonia Womens R1 Air Full-Zip Fleece Hoody Black
item.g:description: The R1® Air Full-Zip Hoody is a lightweight, breathable and quick-drying technical fleece for high-exertion activities in cold conditions. The fabric is made of 100% recycled polyester and is structured for comfort during movement. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. item.g:title: Fjallraven Classic Sweatpants Grey Melange
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Classic Sweatpants are comfortable and durable men's sweatpants, made from 100% organic cotton. Pair them with the Fjällräven Classic Sweater or Classic Hoodie for a cozy and stylish look, whether at home or at the cabin. They feature an elasticated waistband with a drawcord for a customizable fit, along with elasticated leg cuffs for added comfort. The pants also include hand pockets and a patch pocket on the back. FEATURES Made from soft and durable 100% organic cotton. Comfortable sweatpants perfect for layering or relaxing by the fire. Elasticated waistband with drawcord adjustment and elasticated leg endings. Hand pockets and a patch back pocket. Can be matched with Fjällräven Classic Sweater or Fjällräven Classic Hoodie.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Lappland Vest Pack Dark Olive
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Lappland Vest Pack is a versatile backpack and vest combination designed for various types of hunters, including bird hunters and dog handlers. It features an internal frame that allows the pack to stand upright and makes it easier to put on and take off. The pack includes several roomy pockets, including a main compartment and a game pocket that can be easily cleaned. It also has a sleeve for a hydration system and a shoulder yoke design that ensures proper alignment when shooting. FEATURES Designed for all hunters including bird hunters and dog handlers. Main fabric is G-1000 HeavyDuty S in recycled polyester and organic cotton. Stand-alone frame. 7-litre backpack compartment. Multiple pockets including game pocket and two bottle pockets.

item.g:title: Filson Dryden Backpack Otter Green
item.g:description: The Filson Dryden Backpack in Otter Green is built for durability and weather resistance, crafted from 1000-denier Cordura® nylon. It features a double-layer reinforced bottom for extra toughness and a zippered rear panel with a padded laptop pocket. Heavy-duty coil zippers prevent snags, while Bridle Leather and nylon webbing provide versatile carrying options. Perfect for both travel and everyday use, this backpack combines strength with practicality. FEATURES Heavy-duty Cordura® nylon fabric is durable and water-resistant. Double-layer reinforced bottom Heavy-duty coil zippers throughout Panel-opening zipper provides ease of access to main compartment Zippered mesh pocket inside main-compartment; front zippered full-width pocket; front panel-opening pocket with internal organization and key-clip lanyard; side stow pockets; zippered rear panel with padded laptop pocket 25.5L Capacity

item.g:title: Filson Ballard Watch Cap Dark Mushroom / Black
item.g:description: The Filson Ballard Watch Cap in Dark Mushroom/Black is knitted from 100% breathable acrylic to minimize sweating. Its cuffed design ensures ear coverage, while the insulated material dries quickly when needed. FEATURES: 100% Acrylic Quick drying Cuffed design for adjustable coverage Insulates wet or dry

item.g:title: Filson Ballard Watch Cap Black
item.g:description: Warm your whole body when you put on Filson's Ballard Watch Cap. It's knitted with quick-drying acrylic that has none of the itch of wool caps. item.g:title: Filson Dog Bowl Dark Tan

PRODUCT FEATURES Durable tin cloth exterior Medical-grade waterproof nylon lining Collapsible for easy storage and transport Hanging loop for attaching to packs, vests, or belt loops

item.g:title: Filson Dryden Briefcase Otter Green
item.g:description: The Filson Dryden Briefcase in Otter Green is crafted from durable 1000D Cordura® nylon, known for its exceptional abrasion resistance. Ideal for daily carry, it features a padded sleeve that fits laptops up to 16". The back trolley strap allows for easy attachment to luggage, while large exterior pockets keep essentials organised. A removable, adjustable shoulder strap adds convenience, making this briefcase a reliable companion for both work and travel. item.g:title: Fjallraven Varmland Vest Orange Camo
item.g:description: Stay prepared in the field with this lightweight and versatile hunting vest in safety orange. Designed for bushland environments, its camouflage print ensures animals have difficulty detecting your presence while keeping you highly visible to your hunting team. This vest is easy to layer over other hunting gear and packs away compactly when not in use. Stretch panels on the sides ensure a comfortable fit, while practical pockets provide storage for essentials like a radio and other small items. FEATURES: Lightweight and durable construction for all-day wear. Camouflage print for effective concealment in natural environments. Highly visible safety orange for team awareness. Stretch panels for a flexible, comfortable fit. Three practical pockets: zippered chest pocket and hand pockets. Quick-drying fabric ideal for outdoor use. Relaxed fit with a two-way zipper for ease of wear. Outer material: 100% polyester with stretch panels (63% polyamide, 26% polyester, 11% elastane). CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Wash at 40°C on a normal cycle. Do not dry clean, bleach, or tumble dry. Iron on low heat (maximum 110°C). Avoid using fabric softener and wash with similar colours.

item.g:description: Introducing the Fjallraven Women’s Forest Wool Padded Vest in Deep Forest – the ultimate combination of comfort and style. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens HC Hydratic Trail Jacket Black
item.g:description: Built on a waterproof, breathable 2.5-layer Hydratic shell with mechanical stretch, the Fjallraven Women's HC Hydratic Trail Jacket in Black works for the city or the trail and is one of the more weatherproof shell jackets in the range. Made from recycled polyester with a PU membrane and PFC-free impregnation, it keeps you dry in heavy rain while leaving room to move. An adjustable hood, zipped side vents and a two-way front zip with a double placket manage airflow, while zipped hand pockets, reflective cuffs and a hidden pattern when zipped finish the design. Features Outer: recycled polyester with PU membrane and PFC-free impregnation 2.5-layer Hydratic shell with mechanical stretch Zipped ventilation openings at the sides Zipped hand pockets and two-way front zip with double placket Velcro cuff adjusters with reflective detail Adjustable hood and drawcord hem

item.g:title: Veja Campo Leather Trainer Extra White Natural
item.g:description: Upper : ChromeFree leather Panels : ChromeFree leather and suede Logo V : Suede Insole : Amazonian rubber (11%), sugar cane (42%), recycled E.V.A.* (11%) and organic cotton (12%) Outsole : Amazonian rubber (40%), silica (23%), recycled rubber (10%), synthetic rubber (11%), and others (16%) Lining : Tech (100% recycled polyester) Laces : Organic cotton (100%) Made in Brazil The bovine ChromeFree leather is smooth and light. Coming from farms located in the south of Brazil (Rio Grande do Sul), it undergoes an innovative tanning process where no chrome, heavy metals or dangerous acids are involved. By simplifying the tanning process, the use of chemicals and energy is limited, the use of water is reduced by about 40% and the use of salt by 80%. After tanning, the water is recyclable.

item.g:title: Patagonia Swiftcurrent Ultralight Waders Hex Grey.
item.g:description: The go-everywhere, fish-everything Swiftcurrent™ Ultralight Waders in Hex Grey are river-tested and built for discovery. With everyday durability and versatility that make them essential for travellers, hikers and warm-weather anglers, they roll up into a grande burrito-sized stuffsack and weigh in at just 36 ounces. item.g:title: Polo Ralph Lauren Loopback Fleece Hoodie Polo Black
item.g:description: The Polo Ralph Lauren® Loopback Fleece Hoodie in Polo Black is a versatile and comfortable layer designed for relaxed, everyday wear. Made from lightweight loopback cotton, it offers a breathable feel and features a soft terry-like interior for added comfort. Specially washed for a vintage-inspired look, this hoodie exudes effortless style. The design includes a drawstring hood and ribbed cuffs and hem, ensuring a snug fit that retains warmth on cooler days. A practical kangaroo pocket adds functionality, perfect for keeping essentials close or warming your hands. Finished with the iconic embroidered Pony on the chest, it delivers a touch of signature detailing. Ideal for pairing with joggers, jeans, or chinos, the Loopback Fleece Hoodie is a reliable choice for casual outings or laid-back days at home. Its combination of lightweight construction and classic design makes it a wardrobe staple. FEATURES Size medium has a 70 cm body length (front and back), a 47 cm shoulder, a 113 cm chest and an 89 cm sleeve length. Sleeve length is taken from the centre back of the neck. Drawstring hood. Long sleeves with rib-knit cuffs. Kangaroo pocket. Rib-knit hem. Signature embroidered Pony on the left chest. Shell, hood lining and rib-knit trim: 100% cotton. Machine washable. Imported.

item.g:title: Red Wing Womens 6-inch Classic Moc Black Boundary
item.g:description: The all-black Red Wing Moc Toe 3380 in the Black Boundary leather is part of the Red Wing Core Collection. FEATURES This shoe made Red Wing Shoe Company famous in the 1950s. Formed with last 105, it's a feminine version of the Classic Moc Toe fit that you know and love, with an elegant silhouette and smaller eyelets that minimize the bulky feel of the original. The white sole is made of a flexible, durable lighter polyurethane material. The Red Wing Heritage Women's Collection in general offers a softer leather, a reduced weight, a cushioned insole, a slimmer and more comfortable fit formed using different lasts, and more feminine proportions. It takes more than 230 steps to handcraft a pair of our boots.Red Wing combines the finest leathers, produced by the company-owned S.B. Foot Tannery, with quality materials and uncompromising craftsmanship. Made in USA.

item.g:title: Red Wing Womens 6-inch Classic Moc Black Boundary
item.g:description: The all-black Red Wing Moc Toe 3380 in the Black Boundary leather is part of the Red Wing Core Collection. FEATURES This shoe made Red Wing Shoe Company famous in the 1950s. Formed with last 105, it's a feminine version of the Classic Moc Toe fit that you know and love, with an elegant silhouette and smaller eyelets that minimize the bulky feel of the original. The white sole is made of a flexible, durable lighter polyurethane material. The Red Wing Heritage Women's Collection in general offers a softer leather, a reduced weight, a cushioned insole, a slimmer and more comfortable fit formed using different lasts, and more feminine proportions. It takes more than 230 steps to handcraft a pair of our boots.Red Wing combines the finest leathers, produced by the company-owned S.B. Foot Tannery, with quality materials and uncompromising craftsmanship. Made in USA.

item.g:title: Sunspel Womens Ribbed Tank Top White
item.g:description: The Sunspel Womens Ribbed Tank Top in White is an effortless, versatile tank top crafted from the softest Californian Supima cotton. With a contemporary slim fit, it looks elegant and elevated on its own but also makes an ideal underlayer. PRODUCT FEATURES: 100% Supima Cotton Fits true to size - take your normal size Slim fit Made in Portugal

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Womens Skyler Liner Jacket Black
item.g:description: The Carhartt WIP Womens Skyler Liner Jacket in Black is built from recycled polyester ripstop with an onion-quilted polyester lining. The collarless shape, snap-button closure and three front pockets make it a neat layering option within the Carhartt WIP liner jackets collection. Features Outer: 100% recycled polyester ripstop (2.2oz) Lining: 100% polyester (onion-quilted) Collarless design Snap-button front closure Three front pockets Woven Square Label

item.g:title: Patagonia Stealth Pack 30L Noble Grey
item.g:description: The 30-liter, water-resistant Stealth Pack is built for multiple hatches, changing conditions and toting extra gear for long floats or multiday trips. Ergonomic, lightweight and body-conforming, it features a large main compartment, quick-access exterior pocket and a top stash pocket. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. FEATURES Fabric Details Water-resistant shell is made of 100% recycled nylon ripstop with a polyurethane coating on one side and a TPU coating on the reverse Comfortable Design Back is cushioned, contains an integrated net holster and accommodates a hydration system Large Side Pockets Oversized water bottle pockets on both sides of pack for hydration or extra storage Pack Capacity Stealth Pack capacity is 30 liters; includes a waterproof pocket built with TRU® Zip technology—pocket can be mounted internally or externally, depending on your system External Organization Multiple exterior lashing points, D-rings, stash pockets and sleeves are all placed for intuitive, quick access to all accessories Internal Organization Padded sleeve fits laptops up to 13" Supporting the People Who Made This Product Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory, which means the people who made this product earned a premium for their labor Country of Origin Made in Vietnam. Weight 800 g

item.g:title: Ariat Burford Insulated Rubber Wellington Olive Night
item.g:description: The Ariat Burford Insulated Rubber Wellington is the perfect blend of durability and comfort. Equipped with ATS® technology, these boots offer stability and all-day comfort. The waterproof construction with vulcanised rubber upper ensures that your feet stay dry in even the wettest conditions. Designed with a 3.5 mm neoprene lining, these boots have a comfort rating from -10 degrees C at high activity levels to 10 degrees C at low activity levels, ensuring that your feet stay warm and cosy no matter the weather. The adjustable leather strap and leather-trimmed top offer a secure and comfortable fit. Made with an EVA midsole for lightweight shock absorption and cushioning, these boots are built to provide all-day comfort. The Duratread™ outsole offers maximum wear resistance with an easy-off "heel kick" feature, making it easy to take these boots on and off. The Ariat Burford Insulated Rubber Wellington is the perfect choice for those who want a comfortable and durable boot. Order yours today and experience warmth, comfort, and durability in one. Features: ATS® technology for stability and all-day comfort Waterproof construction with vulcanised rubber upper 3.5 mm neoprene lining Comfort rating from -10 degrees C at high activity levels to 10 degrees C at low activity levels Adjustable leather strap Leather trimmed top EVA midsole for lightweight shock absorption and cushioning Duratread™ outsole for maximum wear resistance with easy-off "heel kick" feature

item.g:title: Clarks Originals Womens Desert Trek Black Suede
item.g:description: The Clarks Originals Desert Trek Shoes have been around since the 70s and are a certified classic. Their original lace-up design features Clarks' iconic crepe sole and offers the ultimate combo of comfort and style. Desert Trek Classic crepe sole Original lace-up design Black Suede

item.g:title: Hestra Fält Guide Glove 5 Finger Brown / Black
item.g:description: The Hestra Fält Guide Glove, named after wilderness survival expert Lars Fält, is a popular choice among mountain guides, ski patrols, and other outdoor professionals due to its durability and warmth. Its combination of tough goatskin leather on the grip surfaces and flexible cowhide on the backhand is the result of a collaboration between Fält and Hestra. The removable wool liner is perfect for long days in the mountains, and the spacious design provides ample room for insulation. This reliable glove is suitable for both mountain and forest use and will last through years of ski tours and outdoor adventures with proper care.

item.g:title: Barbour Houghton Stripe Socks AsphaLight / Navy
item.g:description: The Barbour Houghton Stripe Socks in AsphaLight / Navy are crafted in a luxury wool-blend and feature a wide striped design. Boasting a contrast heel and toe, these socks are finished with a printed Barbour logo to the sole of the foot. FEATURES: 47% wool, 35% polyamide, 17% silk, 1% elastane Machine wash 30°C

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Single Knee Pant Blue Rinsed
item.g:description: The Single Knee Pant draws inspiration from classic work pant silhouettes and is constructed from Smith denim, which is a robust 13.5 oz cotton twill fabric. It is cut in a relaxed straight fit with a regular waist. The style comes in several iterations, including those which have been rinsed for softness without compromising on durability, as well as versions which have been stone-bleached for a lighter finish and worn-in appearance. Triple-stitched details make the pant more robust, while tool pockets and a hammer loop offer further nods to the item's utilitarian influences. FEATURES 100% cotton (Dearborn Canvas) Relaxed straight fit, regular waist Triple-stitched Zip fly Square Label

item.g:title: Barbour Cascade Sports Cap Navy
item.g:description: The Barbour Cascade Sports Cap is ideal for keeping the sun off of your head and face everyday and when travelling. Featuring a branded metal adjustment mechanism to the back and embroidered branding to the front for a premium casual look. Product Information Shaped peak Embroidered branding Adjustable strap 100% cotton

item.g:title: Barbour Wax Sports Cap Olive
item.g:description: The Wax Sports Cap from Barbour is an ideal casual accessory for sporting activities or general outdoor wear. The cap features a curved brim and a classic Barbour tartan lining for a hint of luxury and is crafted from a 100% wax cotton. Finished with an adjustable strap and Barbour branded metal buckle. FEATURES 100% waxed cotton Curved brim Tartan lining Barbour branded buckle: adjustable

item.g:title: Birkenstock Boston SFB Suede Leather Sandal Black
item.g:description: The BIRKENSTOCK Boston clog is a veritable classic that can easily be worn all year round. With its additional foam layer, the soft footbed offers extra comfort and pampers feet – all day long. Its natural design is down to the upper made from especially soft suede, which hugs the foot like a second skin. Original BIRKENSTOCK soft footbed; anatomically shaped Upper: suede Footbed lining: suede Sole: EVA Details: one strap with an individually adjustable metal pin buckle; soft footbed Made in Germany

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Classic Vest Hamilton Brown
item.g:description: The Classic Vest is constructed in a classic, hard-wearing ‘Dearborn Canvas’. This fabric is now created from organic cotton – but is just as robust as previous iterations. Features two front pockets and woven Carhartt WIP label. Standard sizing. 100% Organic Cotton 'Dearborn' Canvas, 12 oz quilted lined rib-knit collar kangaroo pocket front closure with zip square label

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Medley State Sweat Thyme
item.g:description: The Medley State Sweatshirt is made of sturdy unbrushed cotton-poly blend. It showcases a seasonal puff print design on the front and back, inspired by the brand's iconic State Flag symbol. The collar, cuffs, and bottom band all feature ribbed detailing. Loose fit. FEATURES 57% cotton / 43% polyester Loose fit Unbrushed Puff print Carhartt branding Ribbed cuffs, hem and collar

item.g:title: Polo Ralph Lauren Speckled Wool Blend Crew Neck Jumper Chambray Blue Donegal
item.g:description: The Polo Ralph Lauren® Speckled Wool-Blend Crew Neck Jumper in Chambray Blue Donegal combines traditional craftsmanship with contemporary style. Knit from Italian wool-blend yarn, this jumper features a distinctive speckled pattern, paying homage to classic Donegal knitwear. Designed with a regular fit, the jumper offers a comfortable silhouette suitable for various occasions. The crew neck design is complemented by rib-knit cuffs and hem, ensuring a snug fit and added durability. The left chest is adorned with Polo Ralph Lauren's signature embroidered Pony, adding a touch of brand heritage. This versatile piece is ideal for layering over shirts or wearing on its own, providing warmth and style during cooler months. The speckled wool-blend fabric not only offers visual interest but also delivers a soft and cosy feel, making the Polo Ralph Lauren® Speckled Wool-Blend Crew Neck Jumper a valuable addition to any wardrobe. FEATURES Regular Fit: wider at the chest while maintaining a modern silhouette. Size M has a 68.6 cm body length (front and back), a 106.7 cm chest and an 85.7 cm sleeve length. Sleeve length is taken from the centre back of the neck and changes 2.5 cm between sizes. Crewneck. Long saddle sleeves with rib-knit cuffs. Rib-knit hem. Signature embroidered Pony on the left chest. 70% wool, 20% nylon, 10% mulberry silk. Hand wash or dry clean. Imported.

item.g:title: RRL by Ralph Lauren Womens Embroidered Indigo Floral-Print Shirt Blue / Cream
item.g:description: Made with lightweight cotton cloth woven in Japan. Dyed with true indigo and discharge-printed with a vintage-inspired floral motif. Hand-embroidered detailing throughout. Straight hem. Genuine mother of pearl buttons. FEATURES Size 6 has a 56 cm body length and an 80 cm sleeve length. Body length and sleeve length are taken from the centre back of the neck. Sleeve length changes 0.63 cm between sizes. Straight collar. Buttoned placket. Genuine mother of pearl buttons. Long sleeves with buttoned barrel cuffs. Two chest patch pockets. Straight hem. Embroidery throughout. 100% cotton. Machine washable. Imported. Dyed with true indigo, which may rub off onto fabrics, leather and upholstery.

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Womens Signature Sweat Dusty Ice / White
item.g:description: The Women's Signature Sweatshirt is made from heavyweight cotton jersey with a brushed, fleece-like backing. Raglan sleeves emphasize the item's loose fit. Graphic embroidery appears on the chest. FEATURES Loose fit Garment-washed Raglan sleeves Graphic embroidery

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Womens Signature Sweat Dusty Ice / White
item.g:description: The Women's Signature Sweatshirt is made from heavyweight cotton jersey with a brushed, fleece-like backing. Raglan sleeves emphasize the item's loose fit. Graphic embroidery appears on the chest. FEATURES Loose fit Garment-washed Raglan sleeves Graphic embroidery

item.g:title: Carhartt WIP Womens Rayley Jacket Black
item.g:description: The Women's Rayley Jacket is made from robust cotton Dearborn Canvas with water-repellent qualities. The item is also padded and lined with recycled polyester taffeta. A chest pocket appears on the inside, while four pockets appear on the front, detailed with metal rivets. An adjustable and removable artificial fur collar offers further tactile detailing. An artificial leather Square Label completes the design. FEATURES: 100% Cotton (Dearborn Canvas) Water-repellent fabric (uncoated) Polyester taffeta lining (recycled) Adjustable and removable artificial fur collar Adjustable hem Rib-knit storm cuffs Front closure with snap buttons and hidden two-way zip Inside chest pocket Front pockets with metal rivets Artificial leather Square Label Item runs larger

item.g:title: Polo Ralph Lauren Jett Lug-Sole Leather Moc-Toe Shoe Black
item.g:description: The Polo Ralph Lauren® Jett Lug-Sole Leather Moc-Toe Shoe in Black offers a sophisticated take on rugged footwear, blending durability with refined craftsmanship. The oiled leather upper provides a sleek yet robust finish, enhanced by hand-stitched detailing on the toe and heel for a touch of artisanal quality. Pinking along the collar adds subtle character, creating a distinctive edge to this classic design. It features in our Ralph Lauren footwear collection. Built for both style and function, the shoe features a chunky rubber lug sole that delivers superior traction and durability on diverse surfaces. The rawhide leather laces ensure a secure fit while complementing the overall aesthetic. A padded insole and smooth leather lining add comfort, making this moc-toe shoe as practical as it is stylish. Whether navigating city streets or venturing into the countryside, the Jett Lug-Sole Leather Moc-Toe Shoe pairs easily with a variety of outfits, from tailored trousers to casual denim, offering versatility and performance in equal measure. Features Rounded toe Lace-up front with rawhide leather laces Padded leather insole. Reinforced heel “Polo Country Ralph Lauren”-debossed patch on the tongue. Woven “Polo” tab on the side Lined with leather Double-stitched leather welt. Rubber lug outsole Upper and lining: leather Imported

item.g:title: Wedgie Pabs Door Stopper
item.g:description: Meet Pabs: As a co-founding member of the doorstopism movement, Pabs is seen as a pioneer in the world of modern door-stopping. One of the most prolific doorstoppers of his time, hand him a paintbrush, and he’ll happily rustle up his next masterpiece whilst on duty.

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 25oz Straw Mug Wetlands Brown
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 25oz Straw Mug in Wetlands Brown is a practical and robust solution for enjoying your favourite cold beverages on the go. Whether it’s an energising smoothie, an iced coffee, or a refreshing drink, this mug is designed to handle it all, making it perfect for countryside adventures, commutes, or relaxing days outdoors. Crafted from durable stainless steel, the Rambler® 25oz Straw Mug features YETI®’s renowned double-wall vacuum insulation, keeping your drinks cold for hours. The wide straw and shatter-resistant lid make sipping effortless, while the built-in stopper ensures a secure fit to prevent spills. Designed to fit standard cup holders, this mug is ideal for use in vehicles or outdoor settings. Finished with YETI®’s tough DuraCoat™ finish in Wetlands Brown, it resists peeling, cracking, and fading, ensuring long-lasting durability. The sturdy handle provides a comfortable grip, and the generous 25oz capacity means you’ll have plenty to keep you refreshed throughout the day. The YETI® Rambler® 25oz Straw Mug Wetlands Brown combines convenience, durability, and performance, making it a reliable companion for any outdoor or everyday activity. Please be aware that this Lid is not intended for use with hot beverages. If you're craving a steamy cup of goodness, explore our compatible Large MagSlider™ Lid for a perfect fit. FEATURES Cup holder compatible Reusable straw Dishwasher safe Double wall vacuum insulated

item.g:title: YETI Rambler 42oz Straw Mug Lowcountry Peach
item.g:description: The YETI® Rambler® 42oz Straw Mug in Lowcountry Peach is designed to keep you hydrated through long journeys, outdoor adventures, or a busy day in the countryside. With an impressive 42oz capacity, this mug is perfect for holding generous servings of your favourite cold drinks, ensuring you stay refreshed wherever you go. Crafted from durable stainless steel and featuring YETI®’s renowned double-wall vacuum insulation, the Rambler® 42oz Straw Mug keeps your beverages cold for hours, even in warm conditions. Its shatter-resistant straw lid is equipped with a built-in stopper to prevent spills, making it ideal for use on the move or during outdoor activities. item.g:title: Fjallraven Kanken Classic Fossil
item.g:description: The Kanken Classic is the original and much loved Kanken backpack. It is ideal for many different uses such as travelling, education, work or simply everyday use. The Kanken Classic is crafted from extremely durable Vinylon fabric in a way that is designed to avoid discomfort and back problems. It boats a large main compartment which is easy accessible via the all-round double zip. There is also a large zip close pocket to the front and a flat pocket on each side, so you can keep your belongings organised. Inside the bag, you will find a foam pad, which stops your things from coming into contact with your back. This can be removed and used as a seat pad if you need a comfortable place to sit on your travels. The Kanken Classic can be carried either by the two top handles which can be joined together using the snap close fastening, or it can be carried on your back at the ideal length for you using the adjustable straps. Of course no Kanken is complete without the iconic white and red reflective fox logo to the front.

A small shoulder bag that can also be worn as a cross body bag. Just like the original, the Kanken Sling is made of exceptionally hardwearing Vinylon fabric and has the characteristic format with pliant straps and practical storage. A little pocket on the back is perfect for your phone and other small items you want to be able to get to quickly! 20cm H x 15cm W x 11cm D 2.5L Capacity Zippered main compartment with inside pocket. Zippered quick-access pocket on the back. Adjustable shoulder strap and handles at the top. Hardwearing and water resistant.

item.g:title: Goldwin Dry Mesh Knit Jacket Black
item.g:description: The Goldwin Dry Mesh Knit Jacket in Black is a comfortable midler jacket with excellent breathability and moderate heat retention. It is constructed with Polartec Power Dry fabric, featuring a double knit design that effectively wicks away sweat and maintains a comfortable microenvironment with its mesh structure. FEATURES: Its thickness retains heat while controlling the balance between coolness and warmth. Regular silhouette that is easy to layer. Slightly lower mock neck style. item.g:title: Goldwin KARAMI Woven Hike Shirt Sand Stone
item.g:description: The Goldwin KARAMI Woven Hike Shirt in Sand Stone is crafted using the traditional Japanese weaving technique of "Karami-ori," which has been used for summer kimonos and monks' robes for centuries. This shirt features a custom-made high-density "Karami-ori" fabric woven in Japan with AXIO WOOL, a special yarn made of fine polyester and soft wool fibers designed for breathability and comfort. Perfect for trekking during the spring and summer months. FEATURES: Wool’s moisture control properties prevent stuffiness and odor from occurring, and it naturally dries quickly, which are all ideal in active situations. “Karami-ori'' has a unique cooling effect as if the wind is passing through, yet it is less transparent despite of its lightness. It has a crisp feel and wrinkle resistant. The box silhouette works great to wear it over something, while its regular fit prevents fabric from interfering during active situations. Three-dimensional design and pivot sleeves with a gusset underarm enhance mobility around the shoulders and arms. The front has snap buttons for easy on and off, and a zippered pocket on the left chest. Snap buttons on both sides of the hem allow style adjustment. KARAMI x AXIO WOOL (60% Elasterell-P, 21% Wool, 19% Polyester)

item.g:title: Laboratory Perfumes Discovery Set (5 x 5ml)
item.g:description: The Laboratory Perfumes Discovery Set is for those seeking to explore the brand and discover a new signature fragrance. Elevate your everyday experience with five expertly crafted aromas. Product Features: AMBER: Amber is a warm and complex scent with a rich and woody base, ambergris and grasses are mixed with spicy top notes. GORSE: Gorse opens with a fresh hit of crisp citrus and smooth coconut, before maturing into a heady wrap of spiced cardamom. It’s the olfactory embodiment of sun-warmed skin and lazy summer evenings. SAMPHIRE: A pinch of spicy juniper berries, citrus oil and an intoxicating trio of lavender, rosemary and basil, join verbena to layer over white amber and oak moss to culminate in a fragrance that evokes the fresh coastal air. TONKA: The earthy and sweet vanilla of the tonka bean meets spicy pink peppercorns, zingy mandarin and woodland aromatics. HELIOS: Helios blends earthy and woody undertones with citrus and bergamot notes inspired by strolls through sun-baked orange groves in Tuscany.

Made from recycled polyester with a TPU coating to prevent water entry, it features durable ripstop fabric and a rugged Oxford bottom boot for extra strength. The padded, contoured shoulder straps with an adjustable sternum strap allow for hands-free carrying and can be removed to prevent snagging. The U-shaped zipper is covered by a storm guard for added water protection, and the interior and exterior pockets keep your essentials organized. Designed for durability and adventure, this duffle is built to last. FEATURES 50L Volume Highly water-resistant Made with 100% recycled fabrics Interior hanging pocket Exterior snap-flap pocket Removable backpack straps for hands-free carry Endcap grab handle

item.g:title: Filson Tin Cloth Travel Kit Otter Green
item.g:description: The Filson Tin Cloth Travel Kit Otter Green. Filson Tin Cloth bags are made for traveling light and fast, with all of the weather resistance and durability that’s made their bags legendary. Filson's Tin Cloth Travel Kit is a lighter-weight dopp kit that carries travel essentials for a lifetime of journeys. It’s made with their iconic waxed canvas that’s protected foresters, sportsmen, and tradesmen from harsh weather, brush, and abrasion for more than a century. It’s fully lined with nylon to protect contents, and secures with a heavy-gauge metal YKK® zipper. The cotton-webbing grab handle doubles as a loop for hanging. Bridle Leather zipper pull. PRODUCT FEATURES Made with durable Tin Cloth waxed cotton Fully nylon-lined Metal YKK® zipper Cotton-webbing grab handle Bridle Leather zipper pull

item.g:title: Filson Scout Tote Bag Olive / Black / Covert

Featuring a padded bottom and a laptop sleeve for devices up to 16", it protects your gear while offering smart organisation with interior and exterior pockets. A storm-flap-covered zipper and wide nylon webbing handles add durability and ease of use. 23L capacity, ready for any adventure. item.g:description: The Filson Swiftwater Rain Cap in Raven is a waterproof, high-performance cap designed to complement the brand’s lightweight, packable rain jacket and pants. item.g:title: Hanwag Kaduro Light GTX Boot Asphalt / Black
item.g:description: The Kaduro Light GTX goes that extra mile, both in terms of time and distance. HANWAG developed this low cut to make a lightweight, well-cushioned and hard-wearing hiking boot with superior energy return – 100% made in Europe. Whatever the distance, it realistically meets hikers’ demands. Its innovative midsole technology – the HANWAG Bead technology - combines the best properties of PU - stability, cushioning and durability - with eTPU’s light weight, comfort and energy return capability. Together with BASF HANWAG developed an innovative midsole technology – underpinned by extensive material tests – which is unique in the outdoor footwear sector. The sole absorbs the energy when feet contact the ground and returns it afterwards. The softer midsole is also more comfortable while people are walking. Both characteristics keep hikers happy, particularly over long distances. The sole is complemented by a new, custom-developed outsole in a multifunctional design that provides excellent grip on the most diverse of terrain. This lightweight sole’s tread is designed to wear out less quickly in the usual areas, which helps the boot last longer. Thanks to the lightweight GORE-TEX Invisible Fit membrane which is concealed in the boot and not felt because the laminate and upper are bonded, the boot is waterproof, windproof and breathable. FEATURES Durable cushioning and energy return thanks to HANWAG Bead technology with e-TPU particles (beads) and PU Hard-wearing HANWAG outsole with multifunctional design and superb grip on different terrain Lower-weight design with tough polyester/polyurethane upper GORE-TEX Invisible Fit Technology with lightweight, waterproof, breathable ePE GTX-membrane (PFAS-free) Protective toe cap made of TPU Rear fabric attachment loop 100% Made in Europe HANWAG ABCD Category: AB

item.g:description: A-Zoom Snap Caps for .243 are engineered for superior safety training, function testing, and safe decocking without harming your firearm’s firing pin. FEATURES Precision CNC machined from solid aluminium with hard-anodized finish for durability Features a "Dead Cap" synthetic primer plug that withstands over 3,000 dry fire Lasts over 30 times longer than conventional plastic snap caps for reliable firearm protection

Each snap cap features A-Zoom’s durable "Dead Cap," a synthetic primer plug designed to withstand over 3,000 dry fires while protecting the firing pin, with a lifespan over 30 times longer than conventional plastic snap caps. FEATURES Precision CNC machined from solid aluminium with hard-anodized finish for durability Features a "Dead Cap" synthetic primer plug that withstands over 3,000 dry fire Lasts over 30 times longer than conventional plastic snap caps for reliable firearm protection

item.g:title: Pachmayr A-Zoom Snap Cap 20G Pair - ONE SIZE

item.g:description: The Shotgun Basic Cleaning Kit – 20 Ga is a compact and practical set designed for convenient storage and use, whether at home or on the go. item.g:title: Fjallraven High Coast Rolltop 26 Backpack Patina Green
item.g:description: The High Coast Rolltop 26 in Patina Green is a light, waterproof backpack designed for beach outings and summer adventures near water. Large inside pocket and a smaller zippered pocket. 26L Volume 48H x 26W x 20D (cm) Care Instructions: Please use a soft brush and lukewarm water when cleaning this item.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Abisko Trek 48 M/L Patina Green
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Abisko Trek 48 M/L in Patina Green is a lightweight and durable 48-litre backpack designed for trekking in warm conditions. It features a fully adjustable carrying system with ergonomic shoulder straps, a supportive hipbelt, and excellent ventilation for long days on the trail. Practical storage includes a front panel zipper for easy access, an internal mesh sleeve, and a removable top lid that converts into a hip pack or shoulder bag. With attachment points for trekking poles or an ice axe and hydration system compatibility, it’s a versatile pack built for adventure. FEATURES Made from 210D recycled polyamide ripstop with a 1500 mm PU coating and C0 DWR. Reinforced base in 500D recycled polyamide. Lining made from 100% recycled polyamide. Removeable top lid that can be used as a hip pack on shorter excursions. 48L volume 72H x 42W x 25D (cm)

item.g:title: Fjallraven Hoja Field Suit Green
item.g:description: The Fjällräven Hoja Field Suit Green is a versatile all-in-one outfit built for cycling hiking and active outdoor lifestyles. item.g:title: Red Wing Blacksmith Boots Briar Oil Slick
item.g:description: The Red Wing Blacksmith Boots in Briar Oil Slick Leather are versatile and stylish for various settings. PRODUCT FEATURES: Leather Type: The boots are made from high-quality Briar Oil Slick Leather, which gives them a distinctive look and durability. Leather Care: To maintain the leather's quality, it's recommended to use an all-natural leather conditioner and foam cleaner. This will keep your boots looking their best. Construction: These boots feature Goodyear Welt construction, a hallmark of durability and the ability to resole the boots. This means they're built to last. Sole: The Vibram Mini-Lug Outsole offers excellent traction and grip, making these boots suitable for various terrains. Origin: These boots are proudly made in the USA, ensuring quality craftsmanship.Sizing: It's advisable to consider sizing down by half to a full size for the best fit. Whether you're wearing them for outdoor adventures or in a modern city setting, these Blacksmith Boots are a blend of rugged style and craftsmanship.

item.g:title: Helinox Table One Black
item.g:description: Helinox Table One Black is expertly portable and perfectly sized for Helinox chairs It features integrated mesh cup holders and a stable surface area ideal for plates of food or a game of cards A practical and compact addition for outdoor adventures and casual gatherings FEATURES Packs into a 41cm x 11cm x 11cm zip cylinder case Weighs 690g when packed and can hold up to 50kg when assembled Bluesign®-certified and recycled polyester mesh is breathable, easy to clean, and made to withstand the elements

item.g:title: Helinox StringTrees Outdoor Game Black
item.g:description: Helinox StringTrees Outdoor Game Black is a backcountry twist on shuffleboard where finesse accuracy and fun in the outdoors collide Fling your rings down the rope to score points or push your competition’s rings off to take the lead Gather your crew and enjoy Helinox’s new collection of packable outdoor games made to be played anywhere anytime FEATURES 20 cm x 11 cm x 6 cm 240g Easy to set up How To Play Divide into two teams. Slide metal rings down the rope into one of three scoring zones. There are three scoring zones. Zone (1) is BLUE and worth one point. Zone (2) is PURPLE and worth two points. Zone (3) is YELLOW and worth three points. The first team to score 21 points wins. Teams must win by at least two points.

item.g:title: Helinox ScoreKeeper Black
item.g:description: The Helinox ScoreKeeper Black is a portable scorekeeper that makes keeping track of the game easy. Ideal for use anywhere from the backcountry to the backyard it is part of Helinox’s collection of packable games designed for fun anytime anywhere. Gather your crew and always know who is in the lead. FEATURES 6 cm x 35.5 cm 16g Slide marker to keep score Compatible with your Helinox packable games

item.g:title: Helinox HeliDisc Outdoor Game Black
item.g:description: The Helinox HeliDisc Outdoor Game Black delivers fast-paced action and excitement for any outdoor adventure. Designed for spontaneous play, this lightweight and packable game challenges players to knock down targets with a flying disc and catch them before they hit the ground. Easy to set up and perfect for parks, campsites, and beach days, HeliDisc is part of Helinox’s new collection of outdoor games built for fun anytime, anywhere. FEATURES Weight: 1447g 24 cm x 41 cm x 10 cm when packed Easy to set up and play.

item.g:title: Tikka Overberget Rifle Sling Green
item.g:description: The Tikka Overberget Rifle Sling in Green is a versatile two-strap harness designed for improved comfort and stability in the field. The sling can also function as a safety strap and features a stabilizing loop for enhanced accuracy when shooting from a prone or kneeling position. Ideal for hunters and outdoor enthusiasts, it offers secure carry and added support for steady aiming. FEATURES Evenly distributes weight across both shoulders Includes loop for stabilizing aim in prone or kneeling positions Secure two-strap harness design for comfortable carry

Structured Foam Walls help the bag maintain its shape and prevent collapsing, making it ideal for use in truck beds, overhead compartments, or as checked luggage. With a rugged build, 60-liter capacity, and thoughtful design, this YETI duffel delivers reliable performance for any journey.. FEATURES Take it on a long weekend Internal divider panels Structured walls keep it from collapsing 31.8W x 31.8D x 61.0H cm Empty weight: 2kg PLEASE NOTE: Due to the size of this item, additional delivery charges may apply.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Abisko Trail Fleece Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Abisko Trail Fleece Black is a light and handy hooded sweater that uses two types of fleece to keep you warm where it counts while staying lightweight and easy to pack. The hood, shoulders, and chest feature soft brushed polyester fleece made partly from recycled materials. The sides, lower torso, and sleeves have a breathable grid fleece for better ventilation. It dries quickly and wicks moisture, making it great for day trips or cool summer nights. The cosy hood has a ponytail opening and there are zippered pockets on the chest and hands for secure storage. FEATURES Light fleece jacket in two different fabrics for optimized function and packability. Combines flat-knitted fleece on hood, shoulders and chest with grid-structured fleece on lower sleeves, sides and lower torso. Made from recycled polyester (new and recycled) that is moisture-wicking and quick-drying. Well-fitting feminine cut. Snug hood with opening for ponytail.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Hatfield Hat Green

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Hoja Hybrid Shorts Navy
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Hoja Hybrid Shorts in Navy are designed for comfort, mobility and performance both on and off the bike. Made with a blend of G-1000 Lite Stretch and 4-way stretch fabric, they offer lightweight durability, fast drying times and enhanced weather protection where it's needed most. These shorts are compatible with padded cycling liners, making them ideal for long rides as well as hiking and general outdoor use. FEATURES Made of G-1000 Lite Stretch and a 4-way stretch polyamide/elastane blend. Compatible with padded bike shorts. Reflective details on inside of hems, fold up the cuffs to expose them for more visibility. A great choice for all activities requiring unrestricted movement. Lightweight and fast drying. Reinforced crotch for durability and comfort. G-1000® Lite Stretch: 52% polyester (recycled), 13% polyester (T400), 35% cotton (organic), 88% polyamide (recycled), 12% elastane Care Instructions: Wash on a 40C mild process, tumble dry at low temperature.

Reinforced crotch for durability and comfort. G-1000® Lite Stretch: 52% polyester (recycled), 13% polyester (T400), 35% cotton (organic), 88% polyamide (recycled), 12% elastane Care Instructions: Wash on a 40C mild process, tumble dry at low temperature.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Hoja Field Suit Green
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Hoja Field Suit in green is a versatile all-in-one garment designed with cycling in mind but made for so much more. Blending timeless style with technical performance, it features two durable fabrics with mechanical stretch for enhanced comfort and long-lasting wear. The suit offers excellent freedom of movement and is packed with functional details including reflective elements, an adjustable waistband and multiple practical pockets. FEATURES Made from G-1000 Air Stretch and partly recycled polyester with mechanical stretch. The combination of two stretch fabrics gives great freedom of movement. Two zippered chest pockets that can be opened for increased ventilation. Leg ends can be folded up to reveal reflective details in low-light conditions. Classic fit with adjustable waistband. G-1000® Air Stretch: 52% polyester (recycled), 13% polyester (T400), 35% cotton (organic), 70% polyester (recycled), 30% polyester Care Instructions: Wash on a 40C normal process with similar colours, do not tumble dry.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Hoja T-shirt White
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Hoja Wool T-Shirt in White is a functional and lightweight short-sleeved top designed for active use. It features an athletic cut with a slightly longer sleeve and a high-low hem for a flattering fit and added coverage. Made from a traceable merino wool and polyester blend, it offers the natural temperature regulation and odour resistance of wool with the moisture-wicking and durable performance of polyester. Ideal for cycling, hiking or everyday wear, this versatile T-shirt keeps you comfortable in changing conditions. FEATURES Made from a merino wool/polyester blend. High-low hemline that is a little longer at the back. Slightly longer sleeves for extra sun protection. Fjällräven Hoja print on the front. Round neckline. 50% polyester, 50% wool (traceable) Care Instructions: Wash on a 30C mild process, do not tumble dry

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Hoja Adventure Vest Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Hoja Adventure Vest in Black is the ideal lightweight layer for cycling adventures. Designed with a bike-specific fit, it offers comfort and performance when you're on the move. The weather-resistant fabric on the chest and shoulders provides targeted protection from wind, while the breathable, flexible fabric on the lower front and back ensures ventilation and freedom of movement. This vest packs neatly into its own pocket, making it easy to carry and ready to wear when the breeze picks up. A smart and compact choice for active cyclists. FEATURES Made from recycled polyester and a polyamide/organic cotton blend. Waxable reinforced chest and shoulders for extra wind protection. Back and lower front in lightweight and breathable fast-drying polyester. High-low hemline with elastic trim at the back and around armholes. Packable into right-hand chest pocket. HC-Lite®: 54% polyamide, 46% cotton (organic), 100% polyester (recycled) Care Instructions: Wash on a 40C mild process with similar colours, do not tumble dry.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Hoja Rider's Wind Jacket Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Womens Hoja Rider's Wind Jacket in Black is the perfect compact backup garment for cyclists and outdoor enthusiasts. Made from wind- and water-repellent HC Lite fabric, it is lightweight, quick drying and can be waxed for added weather protection. Designed with practical features including articulated sleeves, elasticated cuffs that stay in place and reflective details for safety, this jacket is ideal for taking on the ride or any adventure where space is limited. A reliable and stylish choice to keep you protected in changing conditions. FEATURES Made from wind- and water-repellent HC Lite. Can be waxed for better resistance against rain and wind. Articulated sleeves with elasticated cuffs for increased freedom of movement when cycling. Top-loaded chest pockets, one buttoned and one zippered plus zippered hand pockets. Collar with button-up function for extra protection. HC-Lite®: 54% polyamide, 46% cotton (organic) Care Instructions: Wash separately on a 40C normal process, do not tumble dry.

item.g:title: Lacoste Original L.12.12 Petit Pique Cotton Polo Shirt Pine Green
item.g:description: The Lacoste Original L.12.12 Petit Piqué Polo Shirt in Pine Green is a timeless piece that marks the beginning of the modern polo. First introduced by René Lacoste in 1933, it set a new standard in sportswear with its breathable cotton Petit Piqué fabric, structured collar, and button placket. Crafted with care using 20 kilometres of thread and featuring the iconic crocodile logo made up of 2,367 stitches, this polo is a showcase of Lacoste’s attention to detail and commitment to quality. Designed for comfort, movement, and understated style, it remains a classic in any wardrobe. Product Features Petit Piqué, the Lacoste signature knit Ribbed collar and sleeves Classic fit, comfortable cut and sleeves Genuine mother-of-pearl buttons Embroidered crocodile sewn on the chest Cotton (100%) If you are between two sizes, we recommend the smaller size.

item.g:title: Beretta Duiker GTX Brown
item.g:description: Introducing the men's Beretta Duiker GTX boots in Brown - the ultimate choice for winter hunting. Featuring greased nubuck leather with PU-coated crust toe and heel, these boots are not only stylish but also durable. The GORE-TEX Sierra membrane ensures waterproofness and breathability, keeping your feet dry and comfortable in winter conditions. The nubuck leather upper and Ortholite 2D footbed provide excellent temperature control, breathability, and hygiene. The Cordura® inserts offer superior resistance, while the Vibram® Bristol sole with protective reinforcement guarantees optimal cushioning. Plus, the bottom configuration ensures unbeatable traction. Stay warm, dry, and in control this winter with the Beretta Duiker GTX boots.
