item.g:title: Sunspel S/S Riviera Polo Dark Green
item.g:description: The Riviera Polo Shirt exemplifies timeless Bond elegance, crafted from a distinctive mesh fabric originally developed by Sunspel in the 1950s for the refined French Riviera. This iconic garment was later bespoke tailored for Daniel Craig’s inaugural portrayal of James Bond in Casino Royale. Its slim engineered fit, corduroy-lined funnel collar, stowaway hood, two-way zip, storm fly front and four-pocket layout make it a substantial choice within our Barbour hooded wax jackets collection. Adjustable cuffs and an action back help with comfort and movement. For layering, consider sizing up, and as this jacket is waxed it should be sponge cleaned only. Features Outer: 100% Cotton (Waxed) Inner: 100% Polyamide 6oz waxed cotton Barbour tonal embroidery to front left lower pocket flap Back Length: 78.8cm - 83cm

item.g:title: Barbour Ashby Waxed Jacket Navy

item.g:description: The Barbour Womens Wilton Chelsea Welly Black is a modern take on the traditional wellington, shaped with Chelsea boot lines for a clean, versatile look. item.g:description: The Polo Ralph Lauren Wool Quarter-Zip Sweater Fawn Heather Grey is crafted from luxurious Italian wool for a soft, comfortable feel. It features a classic quarter-zip design for easy layering. Finished with the signature embroidered Pony, this jumper blends refined style with timeless Polo Ralph Lauren heritage. PRODUCT FEATURES Rib-knit mockneck. Quarter-zip front. Suede zip pull custom-developed with a "Polo" logo. Faux-suede piping on the interior back neck. Long sleeves with rib-knit cuffs. Rib-knit hem. Signature embroidered Pony on the left chest. 100% wool.

item.g:title: Polo Ralph Lauren Lennox Down Parka Ranger Green
item.g:description: The Polo Ralph Lauren Hooded Down Parka in Ranger Green combines heritage style with functional design. Crafted from water-repellent twill and filled with 650-fill-power down, it offers warmth and protection in chilly, wet conditions. Drawstrings at the hood and waist allow for a customizable fit, while underarm grommets improve ventilation. Tonal and leather trim, along with the signature shield patch, add refined Polo detailing to this versatile outer layer. PRODUCT FEATURES Drawstring hood with a built-in brim. Two snaps on the collar. Two-way full-zip front with a buttoned placket. Leather zip pull. Adjustable snapped tabs on the cuffs. Two chest angled pockets with concealed snaps. Two front pockets with buttoned flaps and snapped side entries. Two interior chest pockets. Interior left waist pocket. Interior drawstring on the waist. Silicone “Polo Ralph Lauren” shield patch with our signature Pony on the left sleeve. 650 fill power. Fill power measures the loft of the down and ranges from 450 to 1,000 for clothing. Shell and lining: 67% cotton, 33% nylon. Zip pull: 100% cow leather. Hood lining, sleeve lining and lower body lining: 100% polyester. Upper body lining: 51% cotton, 45% viscose, 4% elastane. Fill: 75% duck down, 25% duck feathers.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Kajka 55 M/L Green

Highly regarded by hikers and experts, the Kajka 55 is perfect for extended treks and demanding outdoor activities. Features: M/L models have longer shoulder straps that do not taper at the ends to better fit wider torsos. Made from Vinylon, recycled 500D polyamide and lining in 210D polyamide. Supportive, more adjustable hip-belt and ergonomic shoulder straps. Volume: 55 litres

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Bergtagen GTX Touring Trousers Black
item.g:description: The Fjällräven Women’s Bergtagen GTX Touring Trousers in Black are built for ski touring and splitboarding, offering durable protection with freedom of movement. Made with GORE-TEX® and an advanced ePE-based membrane, they provide waterproof, windproof, and breathable performance with a PFAS-free DWR finish. Guided by a design for repairability, these bibs are built to last, combining technical performance with long-term usability for demanding alpine adventures. PRODUCT FEATURES Shell: recycled polyamide with GORE-TEX® ePE membrane Waterproof, windproof and breathable Superior cut for fit and freedom of movement 2-way side/back ventilation zippers for heat release and easy bathroom breaks Zippered leg pockets with internal media pockets and transceiver loop GORE-TEX® Performance - 3-Layer Plain Weave Laminate: 59% polyamide 70D (recycled), 21% ePE/polyurethane, 20% polyamide 15D

item.g:title: Novesta x Noel Gallagher Lone Star Chukka Black

Each trainer has Noel's signature embossed on the insole and features a unique black star on the tongue, a homage to his single 'Black star dancing'. The limited edition trainer, made in support of Teenage Cancer Trust, comes in several colourways including Black, Chocolate, Khaki and Tan. item.g:title: Sealskinz Billockby Waterproof All Weather Mid Length Lightweight Cycling Sock Green
item.g:description: The Sealskinz Billockby Waterproof All-Weather Mid Length Lightweight Cycling Sock in Green is engineered for cyclists who demand dry, comfortable feet under all conditions. Featuring the patented Aquasealz™ waterproof membrane, it prevents external water ingress while allowing internal moisture to escape. The bamboo inner layer wicks sweat and offers natural anti-microbial properties, and hand-linked toe seams minimize friction and prevent blisters during long rides. PRODUCT FEATURES Outer: 85% Nylon, 15% Elastane – durable and long-lasting Mid-Section: 100% waterproof and breathable Aquasealz™ membrane Inner: 100% Bamboo Viscose for moisture-wicking and natural antimicrobial protection Arch elastication provides targeted support and reduces foot fatigue Hand-linked toe seams prevent rubbing and blisters Mid-foot grip ensures a secure, comfortable fit Lightweight design fits easily inside cycling shoes Premium construction designed to withstand rigorous use

Crafted from a wool-blend bouclé fabric with a pronounced nep texture, this jacket features shaved shearling panels, a spread collar, and adjustable buckled tabs at the sides. Raglan sleeves and a fully lined checked twill interior complete the elegant design. PRODUCT FEATURES Wool-blend bouclé fabric with a textured nep finish. Shaved shearling collar and body panels for warmth and style. Full-zip front with leather zip pull. Raglan sleeves with buttoned-tab cuffs and Corozo buttons. Two front waist zip pockets and one interior chest pocket. Adjustable buckled tabs at the sides for a tailored fit. Fully lined with checked twill; body lining 100% cotton, sleeve lining 100% viscose. Shearling sourced from Spain; spot clean only.

item.g:title: Hanwag Ancash II GTX Boot Brown / Asphalt

item.g:title: Barbour Liddesdale Quilted Jacket Navy

item.g:title: Fjallraven Keb Fleece Dark Navy
item.g:description: The Fjällräven Keb Fleece in Dark Navy is built for comfort and adaptability across all seasons. Its blend of recycled polyester, wool, and elastane creates a warm yet breathable layer that manages moisture effectively. The exterior is smooth to reduce friction under outer layers, while the inside is brushed for added softness. Reinforced shoulders with G-1000 fabric deliver durability where it’s needed most. PRODUCT FEATURES Warm, quick-drying fleece made from recycled polyester, wool, and elastane. Reinforced shoulder panels in G-1000 for lasting wear and support under a pack. Soft brushed inner fabric provides warmth and comfort against the skin. Low-profile cuffs and flat seams for reduced bulk and a smooth fit. Suitable as a standalone layer or insulating mid-layer throughout the year. Designed for trekking, travel, and daily wear in variable conditions.

item.g:title: Patagonia R1 Air Fleece Vest Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia R1 Air Fleece Vest in Black is a lightweight, breathable core-warmer designed for cool conditions and high-output activities. Built from 100% recycled polyester jacquard fleece, it wicks moisture, dries quickly, and provides warmth without restricting movement. With a slim fit, offset shoulder seams, and multiple pockets, this vest delivers comfort and technical performance whether you’re on the trail, commuting, or layering for outdoor adventures. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. PRODUCT FEATURES • Made from 100% recycled polyester jacquard fleece with hollow-core yarns • Lightweight, compressible zigzag knit for breathability and minimal bulk • Slim fit and mobility-focused design for full range of motion • Offset shoulder seams for comfort under pack straps • One zippered left-chest pocket and two front pockets with minimal zippers • Quick-drying woven binding at armholes and back hem for stretch and fit • Lightweight at 241 g • Fabric certified as bluesign® approved • Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory in Sri Lanka

item.g:description: The Patagonia Nano Puff Vest in Smolder Blue is a lightweight, packable synthetic insulation layer designed for climbers and outdoor enthusiasts. It delivers warmth even when wet, packs down easily, and is built to handle seasons of wear. Made from 100% recycled polyester with 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco and P.U.R.E.™ technology, this jacket combines performance, comfort and sustainability. Thoughtful fit refinements, a zippered chest and hand pockets, and adjustable hem make it an ideal midlayer for all your adventures. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. PRODUCT FEATURES • Shell made from 100% recycled polyester with DWR finish, free from PFAS • 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco 100% postconsumer recycled polyester with P.U.R.E.™ technology • Signature brick quilting with horizontal side panels for stability and low bulk • Evolved fit with improved shoulder and elbow mobility • Center-front zipper with wicking storm flap and chin zipper garage • Two zippered handwarmer pockets and internal chest pocket that doubles as a stuffsack • Drawcord-adjustable drop-tail hem seals in warmth • Lightweight at 369 g • Fabrics certified as bluesign® approved • Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory in Vietnam

item.g:title: Sitka Kelvin Aerolite Jacket Earth

item.g:title: Sitka Kelvin Aerolite Jacket Earth
item.g:description: The Sitka Kelvin Aerolite Jacket in Earth is a lightweight, compressible layer designed to provide warmth without bulk. Filled with PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation with Cross Core™ technology, it delivers down-like warmth and compressibility while remaining effective in wet conditions. Infused with silica aerogel, the insulation traps air for added thermal performance. Made from 20-denier polyester with a durable water-repellent finish, this jacket resists precipitation and dries quickly. Gusseted stretch cuffs, a fitted hood, and a deep zippered chest pocket add comfort, mobility, and practicality for backcountry hunts, scouting trips, or everyday use. PRODUCT FEATURES • Lightweight, compressible PrimaLoft® Gold insulation with Cross Core™ technology• Silica aerogel infusion for extra warmth• 20-denier polyester face and backer with DWR finish• Warm-when-wet synthetic insulation• Gusseted stretch cuffs for unrestricted movement• Fitted hood for low-profile warmth and visibility• Deep zippered chest pocket for valuables• Versatile layer suitable for outdoor activities and everyday wear

item.g:title: Filson Tin Cloth Insulated Work Vest Dark Tan
item.g:description: The Filson Tin Cloth Insulated Work Vest in Dark Tan is a versatile and rugged layer designed to withstand the harshest conditions. It combines the classic Tin Cloth fabric with cutting-edge PrimaLoft® insulation, offering a range of features inspired by Filson's best vests from the past decades. Here's what makes it stand out: Tin Cloth Durability: The shell is constructed from oil-finish Tin Cloth, known for its legendary durability and ability to withstand tough conditions. It's water and mud-resistant and provides excellent protection against thorns, brush, and abrasion. PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation: Featuring 60g PrimaLoft® Gold insulation, this vest offers lightweight warmth that is similar to goose down but remains effective even when wet. Comfortable Lining: The vest is lined with Filson's signature dry finish Cover Cloth, ensuring natural comfort during wear. Functional Pockets: The vest comes with a range of pockets, including flannel-lined handwarmer pockets and chest-stow and slotted-utility pockets for all your essentials. Metal Zipper and Wool Collar: The front zipper is made of metal for reliable performance, and the rib-knit collar is a special wool blend, providing warmth and comfort. Drop-Tail Hem: The vest features a drop-tail hem that offers extra coverage when bending or climbing. The Filson Tin Cloth Insulated Work Vest is not only built for tough jobs but is also ideal for outdoor activities, making it a versatile and dependable choice for those who require both durability and functionality.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Sormland Tapered Trousers Dark Olive
item.g:description: Fjallraven Sormland Tapered Trousers in Dark Olive are comfortable hunting trousers in hardwearing, quiet G-1000 Silent with tapered legs that fit easily into a pair of rubber boots. Developed for easier hunting in a timeless, simple style making them just as suitable on the shooting range they have every chance of becoming favourites for everyday use as well. The fabric is weather and wind-resistant and effectively ventilates out moisture. The fit is regular with a mid waist that is slightly higher at the back so they sit comfortably when squatting down or carrying a backpack with a hip belt. There is a knife pocket on the right-hand leg, hand pockets and back pockets with buttons. Reinforced brace zones for easy attachment of braces. Fixed leg length. Product Features: G-1000 Silent: 65% polyester (recycled) 35% cotton (organic)

item.g:title: Fjallraven Vidda Pro Ventilated Regular Leg Trouser Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Vidda Pro Ventilated Regular Leg Trouser Black are durable trekking trousers with technical features, made from wind- and water-resistant G-1000. The model is based on Fjallraven's best-selling Vidda Pro but has improved ventilation options and a slimmer fit with stretch fabric in crotch so still has great freedom of movement. The buttoned strap adjustments at the leg endings can be removed and there are numerous practical pockets and details – such as a knife pocket on the right leg and a loop for an axe on the side of the waist. PRODUCT FEATURES Traditional, robust trekking trousers with great ventilation in G-1000 for year-round trekking, bushcraft and other outdoor activities. Generous ventilation openings from the hips to the knees. Reinforced knees and attachment zones for braces and gear loops at the waist. Large leg pockets with buttoned flaps, one with an interior mesh pocket, knife pocket on right leg and axe loop at the waist plus two hand pockets.

item.g:title: Fjallraven Abisko Trek 48 M/L Black
item.g:description: The Fjallraven Abisko Trek 48 M/L in Black is a light and versatile pack designed for everyday outdoor use and travel. Its practical layout supports commuting, day-to-day activities and gentle hikes with ease. With a 23 l volume, 40 cm height and a weight of 400 g, it offers compact storage in a streamlined shape. The design allows the bag to be carried by hand, over the shoulder or as a backpack, giving flexibility for different situations. The main compartment includes a padded laptop pocket that fits devices up to 15”, along with secure internal storage for valuables. When not in use, the bag folds neatly into its own front pocket for easy packing. Water-resistant recycled polyamide fabrics add durability, while Bergshell reinforcement provides extra strength at the base. Although the fabric is waterproof, the seams and zippers are not, so the pack can resist light rain but is not fully waterproof. PRODUCT FEATURES • Multiple carry options including handles and two sets of straps • 100% recycled polyamide fabrics and Bergshell-reinforced base • Internal valuables pocket and padded laptop compartment for 15” devices • Zippered front pocket plus open side pockets for quick-access items • Front attachment points for a bike lock or small light

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Bergtagen GTX Pro Jacket Black
item.g:description: Built with a GORE-TEX® ePE membrane and a recycled polyamide shell rated to a 28,000mm water column, the Fjallraven Women's Bergtagen GTX Pro Jacket in Black is made for serious winter mountaineering and is one of the more capable GORE-TEX jackets in the range. It keeps out severe weather while letting moisture escape on long climbs, and the regular fit leaves room for layers. A helmet-ready hood, two-way front zip with a chin guard and underarm vents suit demanding alpine days, and the jacket is built to be maintained over time rather than replaced. Features Shell: recycled polyamide with GORE-TEX® ePE membrane (28,000mm water column) Helmet-compatible hood with drawcord adjustment Underarm zip openings for ventilation Two-way front zip with protective chin guard Articulated fit with a 75cm back length

item.g:title: YETI Loadout GoBox 60 Gear Case Rescue Red
item.g:description: The YETI LoadOut® GoBox 60 Gear Case in Rescue Red is a portable gear locker for longer camping trips, field work, site work or travel where kit needs proper protection. Built to handle snow, mud, dust and saltwater, it keeps essentials protected from the elements with rugged construction, secure organisation and a WildProof™ design. It is not a cooler and should not be filled with ice, but it can fit six Daytrip® Lunch Boxes. For chilled food and drink alongside your dry gear storage, pair it with a YETI hard cooler. Product Features Defender Material™: Built to withstand serious impact for long-term durability WildProof™ Design: IP65 and IP67 rated to be dustproof and fully submersible Removable cargo tray and divider: Keeps small essentials organised and accessible Pack-and-Stack Design: Stacks with other GoBoxes for efficient packing and storage NeverFail™ Hinge System: Made for long-term reliability LipGrip™ Handles: Comfortable to carry, even when fully loaded Lockdown Latches & AnchorPoint™ Tie-Down Slots: Help keep the case secure during transport Useful as a mobile camp kitchen, tool case or dry storage box External dimensions: 76.2W x 37.6D x 34.0H cm Empty weight: 7.8 kg PLEASE NOTE: Due to the size of this item, additional delivery charges may apply.

item.g:title: Sunspel Classic Boxer Short White / Blue / Green Archive Stripe
item.g:description: The Sunspel Classic Boxer Short in White / Blue / Green Archive Stripe is a heritage reissue celebrating 160 years of underwear craftsmanship. Originally designed over 40 years ago, this iconic style remains true to its original specifications. Made from 100% long-staple fine cotton, these boxer shorts offer exceptional softness, lightness, and breathability. Key features include double-turned, feldlocked seams for a smooth finish and a unique back panel that replaces the traditional central seam for superior comfort. FEATURES Heritage archive stripe design 100% long-staple fine cotton for lightness and breathability Double-turned and feldlocked seams to prevent rough edges Distinctive back panel for improved comfort Based on the original 1947 Sunspel boxer short design Made in Portugal FABRIC & CARE 100% Cotton Gentle wash at 40°C with similar colours Do not tumble dry Dry cleanable

item.g:title: Barbour Border Waxed Jacket Archive Olive
item.g:description: The Barbour Border Waxed Jacket in Archive Olive is a longer-length design made from mediumweight 6oz waxed cotton with 100% cotton Barbour tartan lining. Created in the early 1980s by Dame Margaret Barbour, it has a generous fit, extended sleeves, large bellows pockets, moleskin-lined handwarmer pockets and internal poacher pockets, making it a substantial piece within our classic Barbour wax jackets collection. The interactive design works with optional zip-in liners and hoods, while a corduroy collar with throat flap studs, Velcro storm cuffs, brass ring-pull zip and stormfly closure add extra protection. Features Longer-length design with a generous fit Crafted from 6oz waxed cotton for durable, weather-resistant performance Interactive with optional zip-in liners and hoods Two large bellows pockets and two moleskin-lined handwarmer pockets Internal poacher's pockets with detachable pocket bags Classic corduroy collar with throat flap studs Velcro stormcuffs for added protection Full front zip with large brass ring-pull and stormfly closure Outer: 100% waxed cotton (6oz) Lining: 100% cotton Barbour tartan Do not wash - sponge clean only Back length: 96.5 - 99cm

item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Trailmaker 2 Gore-Tex Speed Lace Hiking Shoes Cardboard / Grey Five / Carbon
item.g:description: The Adidas Terrex Trailmaker 2 GORE-TEX Speed Lace Hiking Shoes in Cardboard, Grey Five and Carbon are designed to move comfortably between trails, paths and everyday wear. The waterproof GORE-TEX lining offers protection in wet conditions without compromising breathability. Drawing on the feel of a running shoe, they provide cushioning and flexibility, supported by durable overlays and a grippy Continental rubber outsole. Speed lacing keeps the fit secure and easy to adjust, with a true to size fit recommended. PRODUCT FEATURES - Waterproof GORE-TEX lining - Breathable construction - Lightweight and flexible design - Speed lace closure system - Durable protective overlays - Continental rubber outsole for traction - True to size fit

item.g:title: Adidas Womens Adizero Evo SL Woven Trainers Core Black / Silver Metallic / Carbon
item.g:description: The Adidas Womens Adizero Evo SL Woven Trainers in Core Black, Silver Metallic and Carbon are lightweight road running shoes built for a responsive, fast feel. The synthetic and textile upper keeps the profile streamlined, while the LIGHTSTRIKE PRO midsole delivers cushioned energy return for racing and everyday runs. A neutral setup supports a natural stride on the road, with targeted rubber underfoot adding grip where it is needed most. This model fits small, so sizing up by half a size is recommended. PRODUCT FEATURES - Lightweight woven upper - LIGHTSTRIKE PRO midsole cushioning - Neutral road running support - 7mm heel to toe drop - 39mm heel and 32mm forefoot stack - Continental rubber forefoot patch - Clear rubber rearfoot patches - Contains at least 20 percent recycled content

item.g:title: Adidas Womens Supernova Rise 3 Glow Blue / Silver Metallic / Footwear White
item.g:description: The Adidas Womens Supernova Rise 3 Running Shoes in Glow Blue, Silver Metallic and Footwear White are designed for road running with a focus on comfort and consistency. A reworked Dreamstrike+ midsole delivers a balanced mix of soft cushioning and stability for a smoother stride, supported by a central heel strike zone. The lightweight Primeweave upper offers breathable support through laser cut perforations, while the Lighttraxion outsole provides dependable grip without adding weight. item.g:title: Adidas Terrex Womens Agravic 4 Trainers Blue Burst / Off White / Lime Burst
item.g:description: The adidas Terrex Womens Agravic 4 Trainers in Blue Burst, Off White and Lime Burst are trail running shoes designed for comfort, grip and confidence across mixed terrain. The lightweight, breathable upper helps keep feet cool on the move, while Lightstrike cushioning provides a softer, more responsive feel that supports stability and speed on uneven ground. A lugged outsole delivers dependable traction on loose and slippery trails, finished with a Continental rubber compound for reliable grip in both wet and dry conditions. item.g:title: Hanwag Kaduro Low Gore-Tex Shoe Black / Asphalt
item.g:description: The Hanwag Kaduro Low Gore-Tex Shoe is built for versatile outdoor use, offering lightweight comfort and dependable protection for day hikes and varied terrain. At the core is HANWAG Bead technology, combining polyurethane with energy-returning E-TPU particles to deliver responsive cushioning and long-lasting stability. A GORE-TEX® Invisible Fit membrane ensures waterproof, windproof and breathable performance, while the suede and textile upper adds durability without unnecessary weight. item.g:description: The Patagonia Womens '95 Oval Logo Daily Hoody is a relaxed-fit pullover sweatshirt featuring the brand’s iconic oval logo, originally released in 1995. item.g:title: Red Wing Shop Moc Oxford Shoe Copper Rough & Tough

item.g:title: Merrell Agility Peak 6 Gore-Tex Trainer Black
item.g:description: The Merrell Agility Peak 6 Gore-Tex Trainer in Black is built for technical trail running where grip and protection are essential. A waterproof GORE-TEX® membrane works with a responsive FloatPro™ midsole and Vibram® Megagrip outsole to provide cushioning, traction and dependable performance on uneven ground. PRODUCT FEATURES - Breathable mesh, synthetic and TPU upper - GORE-TEX® waterproof membrane with Invisible Fit construction - 100% recycled breathable mesh lining - FloatPro™ foam midsole for lightweight cushioning - Vibram® Megagrip rubber outsole for grip on wet and dry surfaces - Vibram® traction lugs designed to shed debris - FLEXconnect™ flex grooves in the midsole for improved ground feel - Underfoot rock plate for protection on sharp terrain - Bellows tongue to help keep out dirt and debris - Padded collar for added comfort - 3D print and TPU overlays for durability in high-wear areas - Cleansport NXT™ treatment for natural odour control - Stack height: 32-26mm with 6mm drop and 5mm lug - Vegan-friendly design - Weight per shoe: 295 g

item.g:title: Patagonia Boulder Fork Rain Jacket Forge Grey / River Rock Green
item.g:description: Among our Patagonia men's jackets range, the Men's Boulder Fork Rain Jacket in Forge Grey / River Rock Green is a versatile, low-profile waterproof shell for alpine days and streamside pursuits. Its 3-layer H2No® Performance Standard shell is breathable and PFAS-free. Features Shell: 3-layer H2No® Performance Standard, 3.7oz 30-denier 100% recycled polyester ripstop face with polyester membrane, recycled polyester tricot backer and PFAS-free DWR finish Regular fit, low-profile design Adjustable laminated hood with visor Watertight zips and functional pockets for fly boxes or maps Stormproof cuffs; lightweight and packable Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory

item.g:title: Patagonia Swiftcurrent Traverse Wading Pants Basin Green
item.g:description: The Patagonia Swiftcurrent Traverse Wading Pants are designed for anglers who need lightweight, versatile wading gear without the bulk of traditional chest-high waders. Crafted from 100% recycled 4-layer H2No™ Performance Standard fabric with a durable water repellent (DWR) finish, these pants are tough, quick-drying, and environmentally conscious. Features include an expandable waistband, SecureStretch wading belt, zippered fly with gusset, articulated seat and legs for freedom of movement, and stretch thigh pockets with drain holes. Reinforced ankle scuff guards and anatomical booties provide durability and comfort. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory in Vietnam, these pants balance performance, mobility, and sustainability for fishing, stream hiking, and water adventures. PRODUCT FEATURES Fabric: H2No™ Performance Standard 4-layer, 5.6-oz 50-denier 100% recycled polyester microfiber with waterproof/breathable barrier and DWR finish (PFAS-free) Regular fit wading pants with expandable waistband SecureStretch wading belt supports gear without sagging Zippered fly with gusset for comfort and quick relief Articulated seat and legs with repatterned crotch gusset for freedom of movement Two stretch thigh pockets with drain holes for easy access Heavy-duty scuff guards at ankles and anatomical sock-like booties Thigh pocket fabric: 3.9-oz 86% recycled polyester / 14% elastane stretch plain weave with DWR finish Weight: 1,134 g Made in Vietnam in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory Care Instructions: Hand wash, use mild detergent, hang dry, do not iron, do not use fabric softeners Fabrics are certified bluesign® approved

item.g:title: Patagonia '73 Skyline Uprisal Hoody New Navy
item.g:description: The Patagonia '73 Skyline Uprisal Hoody is a sustainably crafted pullover featuring a retro-inspired graphic and made from 100% recycled fabrics. Combining 55% postconsumer recycled polyester and 45% recycled cotton, it has a soft, brushed interior and natural stretch for all-day comfort. Designed with a classic pullover silhouette, adjustable hood, front pouch pocket, and rib-knit panels at the sides, cuffs, and hem, this hoody provides flexibility, warmth, and practicality. Produced in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory, it’s a conscious choice for both style and sustainability. PRODUCT FEATURES Fabric: 100% recycled knit fleece; body 55% postconsumer recycled polyester / 45% recycled cotton, side panels/cuffs/hem 50% postconsumer recycled polyester / 50% recycled cotton rib knit Regular fit pullover hoody with adjustable drawstring hood Front pouch-style handwarmer pocket Rib-knit side panels, cuffs, and hem for improved movement and fit Brushed interior for extra softness Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory Country of Origin: Mexico Weight: 680 g Care Instructions: Machine wash warm, do not bleach, tumble dry low, do not iron Fabrics are certified bluesign® approved

Designed for everyday wear, it features a classic hoody silhouette with an adjustable drawstring, kangaroo pocket, and rib-knit panels that provide flexibility and comfort. Crafted in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory, this hoody reduces reliance on virgin materials while offering a reliable, stylish layer for casual adventures. item.g:title: Patagonia LW All-Wear Gi Pants Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia LW All-Wear Gi Pants are lightweight, breathable, and designed for movement and comfort in warm conditions. Made from a blend of organic cotton, hemp, and elastane, these pants offer a relaxed fit, gusseted crotch for full range of motion, and a casual elastic waistband with an integrated webbing belt. Built sustainably in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory, they combine comfort, durability, and eco-conscious design. PRODUCT FEATURES Relaxed fit with gusseted crotch for unrestricted movement Fabric: 82% organic cotton, 16% hemp, 2% elastane stretch ripstop Elastic waistband with integrated adjustable buckle belt, zip fly, and button closure Two front pockets and two back drop-in pockets for practical storage Inseam length: 31" (79 cm) Lightweight, breathable, and cool-wearing design Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory Country of Origin: Vietnam Weight: 394 g Care Instructions: Machine wash warm, do not bleach, tumble dry low, warm iron

item.g:title: Patagonia Nomader Shirt Basin Green
item.g:description: The Patagonia Nomader Shirt is your go-to travel companion for comfort, durability, and style on the move. Constructed from a quick-drying 59% organic cotton, 28% recycled polyester, and 13% elastane ripstop fabric, it provides four-way stretch for unrestricted movement. Designed with a lie-flat collar, full button front placket, roll-up cuffs, and a practical left-chest pocket, this shirt balances functionality with a clean, versatile aesthetic. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory, it ensures ethical production while offering lightweight, travel-ready performance. PRODUCT FEATURES Fabric: 4.8-oz 59% organic cotton / 28% recycled polyester / 13% elastane ripstop with four-way stretch Lie-flat collar for comfortable wear around the neck Full button closure on the front placket Roll-up cuffs with button closure for adjustable sleeve length Drop-in left-chest pocket for small essentials Durable, quick-drying, and travel-friendly fabric Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory Country of Origin: Sri Lanka Weight: 301 g

item.g:title: Patagonia L/S LW Fjord Flannel Shirt Prime Shore Blue
item.g:description: The Patagonia L/S LW Fjord Flannel Shirt is a lightweight, soft, and durable flannel designed to be a long-lasting wardrobe staple. Made from 100% Cotton in Conversion, it supports farmers transitioning to organic certification while offering breathable comfort and reliable wear. Featuring a traditional button-front design, long sleeves, a collared neckline, and a left-chest pocket with a single-button flap, this shirt combines classic style with practical function. Its shirttail hem allows for both tucked or untucked styling, and it’s produced in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory for ethical manufacturing. PRODUCT FEATURES Fabric: 100% Cotton in Conversion double-sided brushed flannel Traditional long-sleeved button-front design with collar Left-chest pocket with single-button flap closure Shirttail hem for versatile tuck or untucked styling Lightweight, soft, and durable construction Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory Country of Origin: Vietnam Weight: 306 g

item.g:title: Patagonia Nano Puff Vest Forge Grey
item.g:description: The Patagonia Nano Puff® Vest is a lightweight, weather-resistant synthetic insulation layer designed for climbers and outdoor enthusiasts. With 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco made from 100% postconsumer recycled polyester and a durable ripstop shell, it provides excellent warmth even when wet. The vest features improved mobility, a low-bulk profile for layering, and practical pockets, all while being made sustainably in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. item.g:title: Patagonia Nano Puff Vest Forge Grey
item.g:description: The Patagonia Nano Puff® Vest is a lightweight, weather-resistant synthetic insulation layer designed for climbers and outdoor enthusiasts. With 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco made from 100% postconsumer recycled polyester and a durable ripstop shell, it provides excellent warmth even when wet. The vest features improved mobility, a low-bulk profile for layering, and practical pockets, all while being made sustainably in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. item.g:title: Patagonia Textured Fleece Vest Black

item.g:title: DB Ramverk Alu Carry-on Silver / Onyx
item.g:description: Constructed from aluminium, the DB Ramverk™ Alu Carry-on is built using custom-engineered components and a rivet-less structure that enables easier part replacement and repair while maintaining a clean exterior free from exposed rivets. Designed for durability and precision, it combines structural strength with a minimal, functional aesthetic suited to modern travel. EdgeFrame™: Increases torsional rigidity and impact protection by absorbing and redistributing forces during travel. Inspired by automotive body-in-white design, it combines stiffness with controlled deformation to protect the interior and preserve structural geometry. CenterFrame™: Forms a central spine that stabilises the luggage body, improving load distribution, enhancing repairability, and delivering a precise, tactile closing experience. Wheel housing: Specifically engineered for aluminium construction, integrating seamlessly into the shell to improve ground clearance, shock absorption, and structural strength while acting as a key precision junction point. Trolley handle: Uses a unibody aluminium housing to reinforce the full handle path, enabling smooth, silent extension and a solid, dependable feel during use. Carry handle: Features a refined mechanical design that exposes its functional logic, offering a comfortable grip with a controlled, intentional return. Volume: 36 litresDimensions: 54.5 × 39.5 × 22.5 cm (H × W × D)Weight: 5.85 kg

item.g:title: DB Ramverk Alu Check-in Luggage Medium Silver / Onyx
item.g:description: The DB Ramverk™ Alu luggage system is built around a set of engineered structural components designed to improve strength, durability, and repairability while maintaining a clean, minimal design. Each element plays a specific role in reinforcing the case, improving handling performance, and ensuring long-term reliability through thoughtful mechanical design. EdgeFrame™: Increases torsional rigidity and adds impact protection by absorbing and redistributing forces during travel. Inspired by automotive body-in-white design, it combines stiffness with controlled deformation to protect the interior and maintain structural geometry. CenterFrame™: Acts as a central spine that stabilises the luggage body, improving load distribution, enhancing repairability, and preserving a solid, tactile closing experience. Wheel housing: Integrated directly into the aluminium shell to improve ground clearance, shock absorption, and structural integrity, while serving as a precision junction point for multiple components. Trolley handle: Features a unibody aluminium housing that reinforces the full handle path and enables smooth, silent extension with a stable, dependable feel in use. Carry handle: Designed with a refined mechanical structure that emphasises functional clarity, offering a comfortable grip and a controlled, intentional return when released. item.g:title: Fjallraven Abisko Trekking Shirt Dark Navy
item.g:description: Fjallraven Abisko Trekking Shirt in Dark Navy is a lightweight long sleeve shirt designed for hiking, travel and warm weather adventures. Made from a technical stretch fabric, it offers excellent breathability and moisture wicking performance to help keep you comfortable throughout the day. The collar can be worn up for added sun protection, while the buttoned chest pockets double as ventilation openings for increased airflow when you're on the move. It also packs neatly into one of its own chest pockets, making it easy to carry between adventures. PRODUCT FEATURES Regular fit Lightweight technical stretch fabric 84% polyester, 16% elastane Long sleeves Press button fastening Moisture wicking and breathable construction Collar can be secured upright for extra sun protection Two buttoned chest pockets Chest pockets also function as ventilation openings Packs into its own chest pocket Ideal as a first layer

item.g:title: Birkenstock Womens Arizona Big Buckle Nubuck Sandal Mocca
item.g:description: Birkenstock Womens Arizona Big Buckle Nubuck Sandal in Mocca offers a fresh take on one of the brand's most recognisable styles. Finished with a lightweight EVA outsole, this sandal is designed for effortless everyday wear. item.g:title: &Sons Brandon Jeans Charcoal
item.g:description: &Sons Brandon Jeans in Charcoal are a versatile everyday jean made to develop more character with every wear. Crafted in partnership with ISKO from lightweight 12oz raw denim with a touch of stretch, it offers lasting comfort while maintaining an authentic denim feel. Designed with a slim, gently tapered leg and classic five pocket styling, the raw denim will fade naturally over time, creating a finish unique to you. PRODUCT FEATURES Slim fit with a slight taper Designed to sit on the hips 12oz raw denim Made in partnership with ISKO Lightweight denim with 1% stretch Classic five pocket construction Contrast overlock stitching Branded &Sons suede back patch Raw denim develops high contrast fading over time Recommended to avoid washing for the first six months

item.g:title: Beretta Shot GTX Boots Forest Night
item.g:description: Beretta Shot GTX Boots in Forest Night are built for active hunting and demanding outdoor use in temperate conditions. Combining a waterproof and breathable GORE-TEX Prism lining with a supportive Ortholite insole, they provide lasting comfort across long days outdoors. A Vibram® BT Evolution sole with a PU midsole delivers dependable grip and stability on a wide range of terrain, while the streamlined upper helps prevent dirt from collecting for easier cleaning. PRODUCT FEATURES Designed for active hunting in temperate climates Upper: Exagon 1.6 to 1.7 mm, Puma Cordura® and bycast protection GORE-TEX Prism lining Ortholite insole Vibram® BT Evolution outsole with PU midsole 3D mesh inner Side overlap construction to reduce dirt build-up Self-cleaning sole channels Reinforced toe and heel grip Polyurethane anti-shock midsole to reduce joint impact Boot height: 17 cm

item.g:title: Buffalo Systems Belay Jacket Black
item.g:description: Buffalo Systems Belay Jacket Black is a light and compact layer used by Military, Police, Mountain Rescue Teams and outdoor professionals. Made with a DWR-treated Pertex Quantum outer and AquaTherm pile lining, it is suited to hill walking, climbing, canoeing, sailing, cycling and general outdoor activities. The scooped back, adjustable cuffs and pile-lined zipped pockets add practical comfort, while the jacket is windproof up to 50 mph. item.g:title: Buffalo Systems Mountain Shirt Mile Stone
item.g:description: Buffalo Systems Mountain Shirt Mile Stone is an award-winning outdoor classic, tested for more than 30 years by Mountain Rescue teams and outdoor professionals in demanding conditions. The single-layer design combines a Pertex Quantum shell with an AquaTherm pile lining, making it suited to winter hill walking, trekking, winter climbing and general outdoor use. The scooped back provides extra coverage, while the hand warmer and large front map pockets offer useful storage on the move. PRODUCT FEATURES Pertex Quantum shell fabric AquaTherm pile lining Storm baffles on neck and side zips Touch-and-close adjustment tabs Touch-and-close collar attachment for DP hood, available separately Scooped back is 10cm longer than the front Hand warmer pocket Large front map pocket Rucksack hip belt can be fastened through hand warmer pocket Tape-and-buckle waist adjuster Windproof to 50 mph Temperature range: -5°C to +12°C Designed to work most efficiently when worn next to the skin Weight: 730g (Size 44) UK/US Size Inside Arm (Inches) Neck (Inches) 36 S 23 18 38 M 23 18 40 M 23 18 42 L 23 18.5 44 L 23 18.5 46 XL 23 19 48 2XL 23 20 50 3XL 23 20

item.g:title: Jackman Lead-Off T-Shirt Navy
item.g:description: Jackman Lead-Off T-Shirt Navy is made in Japan from 100% cotton, using 18/1 American cotton open-end spun yarn in a jersey knit fabric. The material has a dry texture and slightly rough feel, with a weight suited to wear from spring to late summer. The thick ribbed neckline uses binder construction to help prevent stretching and is carefully sewn for a neat fit. With no pockets, the T-shirt is suited to wearing as an inner layer. item.g:title: Frizmworks Smock Hooded Parka 002 Navy
item.g:description: Frizmworks Smock Hooded Parka 002 in Navy is a military-inspired layered outerwear piece based on vintage U.S. Navy rescue crew work uniforms. The original pullover structure is reinterpreted in a full-zip style, using durable and sturdy CPN pitch-finished fabric for the outer shell. A double-sided boa fleece lining provides enhanced warmth and wind resistance, while the wide fit and short length create a trendy silhouette. The design features a YKK METALUXE® 2-WAY zipper, 3D chest pockets and hand pockets at the side seams, with a total of four pockets. The lining can also be worn independently, while contrasting colour reinforcement is added to areas subject to wear. item.g:title: Frizmworks Madras Patchwork Relaxed Shirt Wine
item.g:description: Frizmworks Madras Patchwork Relaxed Shirt in Wine is Frizmwork's' take on the iconic Madras shirt, combining multiple check patterns in a patchwork design with unique colour combinations. Washed for a natural texture and colour, it is a statement shirt suitable for year-round styling. item.g:title: Frizmworks OG Double Rib Oversized Tee White
item.g:description: Frizmworks OG Double Rib Oversized Tee White is part of the Original Garments® line and crafted for exceptional durability. Its newly developed, high-density 20-count 2-ply heavyweight fabric has a firm hand while remaining relatively lightweight. The double-layered rib neckline is engineered for superior recovery, while the dual wrap design may feel slightly snug at first before naturally conforming to the neck with use. Side vents provide ease of movement, and the balanced oversized fit offers comfortable, effortless wear. item.g:title: Frizmworks OG Vintage Dyeing Half Tee Washed Navy
item.g:description: Frizmworks OG Vintage Dyeing Half Tee Washed Navy is part of the Original Garments® line and made from newly knitted 10-hand single heavyweight cotton in a midweight 375g fabric. Multiple dyeing and bleaching processes create a subtly unique vintage tone, while a full-garment wash gives the tee a consistent, worn-in texture and helps minimise future shrinkage. The 100% garment-dyed cotton construction offers durability with a soft hand feel, finished with a reinforced double-layer ribbed neckline designed to maintain its shape and naturally mould to the neck over time. Cut in a balanced normal-to-relaxed fit for comfortable ease without excessive volume. item.g:title: Frizmworks Patch Round Pullover Knit Navy
item.g:description: Frizmworks Patch Round Pullover Knit in Navy is a simple, timeless lambswool sweater made from a mid-weight 60% wool blend. Heritage-style suede elbow patches add subtle character, while the crew neck and drop-shoulder silhouette create a relaxed, flowing fit. Narrow-knit construction gives the sweater structure, with textural changes across the upper sleeves and moderate elasticity for natural drape. Colour accents at the elbows and sleeve cuffs complete the understated design. item.g:title: Patagonia Womens Nano Puff Vest Berry Fig
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens Nano Puff Vest Berry Fig combines lightweight warmth with a weather-resistant, packable design. Its 60-g PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco is made from 100% postconsumer recycled polyester providing excellent warmth for its weight, even when wet. The 100% recycled polyester ripstop shell has a DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS to shed light moisture. Brick quilting and horizontal side panels stabilise the insulation with tough, abrasion-resistant thread. The improved shoulder and armhole fit supports movement, while the longer body makes layering easier. item.g:title: Patagonia Womens Capilene Lightweight Zip-Neck Black
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens Capilene Lightweight Zip-Neck Black is a silky-feeling, lightweight baselayer designed for minimalist warmth in cool conditions. Its highly moisture-wicking fabric quickly wicks and releases moisture to help keep you dry, warm and comfortable, while the fitted shape sits next to the skin without being compressive for easy layering, optimal wicking and freedom of movement. A low-bulk half zip allows easy venting, with internal neck tape for added comfort. Set-in seams and an underarm gusset support a wide range of motion, while minimal, low-bulk seams help reduce chafing during extended wear. HeiQ® Mint odour control helps keep things fresh. item.g:title: Patagonia Womens Capilene Lightweight Crewneck Fuzzy Mauve
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens Capilene Lightweight Crewneck Fuzzy Mauve is a silky-feeling, lightweight baselayer designed to provide minimalist warmth in cool conditions. Its highly moisture-wicking fabric quickly wicks and releases moisture to help keep you dry, warm and comfortable, while the fitted shape sits next to the skin without being compressive for effective wicking, easy layering and freedom of movement. Set-in seams and an underarm gusset support a wide range of motion, while minimal, low-bulk seams reduce chafing during extended wear. HeiQ® Mint odour control helps keep things fresh. item.g:title: Patagonia Womens Lightweight Reversible Down Sweater Cardigan Den Brown
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens Lightweight Reversible Down Sweater Cardigan Den Brown is an exceptionally warm, versatile cardigan with a boxy regular fit and hip-length design. Its reversible construction lets you choose which side to wear out and gives you different pocket configurations, while the recycled nylon ripstop shell and lining are insulated with 800-fill-power 100% Responsible Down Standard down. One side has two on-seam zip pockets and a hidden zip pocket, with the cardigan stowing into the left pocket for easy packing. The reverse has two drop-in front pockets. item.g:title: Patagonia Womens Boulder Fork Rain Jacket Stingray Mauve
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens Boulder Fork Rain Jacket Stingray Mauve is a low-profile, waterproof 3-layer shell designed to provide rain protection on trails and in more remote conditions. It meets the H2No™ Performance Standard for waterproof and breathable protection, with long-term waterproof durability. The fabric, membrane and durable water repellent (DWR) finish are made without intentionally added PFAS. A low-profile hood with a laminated visor and single-pull adjustment provides visibility in poor conditions, while watertight zippers, high-set handwarmer pockets and stormproof cuffs and hem help seal out the weather. Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. PRODUCT FEATURES Waterproof/breathable H2No™ Performance Standard 3-layer shell Fabric, membrane and DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS Streamlined, minimalist features designed to be packable Low-profile hood with laminated visor and single-pull adjustment Accommodates a variety of headwear and lies flat when not in use Waterproof exposed centre-front zipper One left-chest zippered pocket Two high-set, watertight zippered welted handwarmer pockets Handwarmer pockets large enough for a fly box, map or notebook Streamlined cuffs with hook-and-loop tabs Adjustable hem drawcord routed through the front pockets Hem helps keep out weather and reduces bulk under a pack

item.g:title: Patagonia Womens '95 Oval Logo Daily Crewneck Cover Green
item.g:description: Patagonia Womens '95 Oval Logo Daily Crewneck Cover Green brings a relaxed shape to a soft and comfortable crewneck sweatshirt. It features the Patagonia oval logo, originally introduced in 1995 for the brand's new surf category at the time and later used across hats, fleece and other pieces. The fabric is made from 100% Cotton in Conversion, supporting farmers working towards organic certification. Dropped shoulders give the sweatshirt its relaxed fit, while rib-knit trim and taped shoulder seams offer comfort and fit retention. Finished with a straight hem and made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. PRODUCT FEATURES 100% Cotton in Conversion fabric Supports farmers working towards organic certification Relaxed-fit crewneck sweatshirt Dropped-shoulder seams Rib-knit neck, cuffs and hem Taped shoulder seams for comfort and fit retention Straight hem Screen-printed 1995 oval logo Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory

item.g:title: Merrell Agility Peak 6 GTX Trainer Mountain
item.g:description: Merrell Agility Peak 6 GTX Trainer Mountain brings waterproof protection, trusted grip and a lightweight feel to trail running. Designed for running miles rather than everyday wear, it combines a GORE-TEX® waterproof membrane with a breathable upper, FloatPro™ foam cushioning and a Vibram® Megagrip outsole for grip on wet and dry surfaces. FLEXconnect™ grooves across the full midsole improve ground connection, while the lightweight rock plate helps protect against sharp, uneven terrain. The updated upper is lighter and more breathable, with 3D Print and TPU overlays reinforcing high-abrasion areas. item.g:title: Uskees 3049 Evo Shell Coat Midnight Blue
item.g:description: Uskees 3049 Evo Shell Coat Midnight Blue is a minimalist, waterproof shell coat with a versatile, utilitarian design and boxy fit. Made from 55% cotton and 45% polyester, it has waterproof taped seams for added protection, an anti-static inner fabric and a curved high-low hem that is longer at the back for coverage. The fixed adjustable hood, elasticated cuffs and adjustable hem help adapt the coat to changing conditions, while multiple zipped and slip pockets provide practical storage. A mesh panel and back vent add breathability, and the two-way YKK zip gives flexible fastening. PRODUCT FEATURES 55% cotton, 45% polyester 100% waterproof Waterproof taped seams for added seal Anti-static inner fabric Two-way YKK zip, double ended Underarm side seam vent with secret zip Zip-jetted inner pockets and small chest pocket with invisible zip Secret slip pockets for hand warming and added storage Large chest pocket with flap and press stud closure Fixed, adjustable hood Adjustable hem with elastic drawcord and toggles Elasticated cuffs Mesh panel and back vent for breathability Minimalist shell coat Versatile, waterproof and utilitarian Boxy fit Curved high-low hem Longer at back for coverage True to size, no need to size up or down

item.g:description: Scholl Womens Beatriz Plain Clog Sandals Espresso feature a clean espresso suede upper with essential lines and a distinctive edge finished with hand-applied studs. The enhanced-contouring Adapta® anatomical footbed follows the foot’s natural morphology to provide support while walking. The TAKIBI fabric combines flame-resistant Modacrylic with durable nylon to create a lightweight layer for early autumn transitions. A generous upper chest game pocket and horizontal pleated patch-and-flap waist pockets provide practical storage, while the included liner can be worn separately or buttoned into the jacket for extra warmth. item.g:title: Snow Peak Kasuri Ripstop Jacket Black
item.g:description: Snow Peak Kasuri Ripstop Jacket Black combines a distinctive KASURI dyeing technique with a 90% nylon and 10% polyester construction. Reinforcement threads resist dye uptake, creating a contrasting ripstop grid pattern against the uniform surface colour. The pocket design includes a large main pocket for bulky items with additional compartments for organised storage, while large ventilation panels at the back help prevent heat buildup during active use. item.g:title: Fjallraven Lappland Bino Harness Green
item.g:description: Fjallraven Lappland Bino Harness Green offers a streamlined way to carry binoculars while spending time in nature, with a chest-mounted design that keeps essential gear close and accessible. The fully adjustable harness fits different body types and can be worn over bulky winter layers, making it suitable for all seasons. A silent bino case allows quick access while reducing noise when observing wildlife, while two detachable side pockets provide extra space for essentials and can be removed for a simpler setup. Made from 500D recycled polyamide with PU coating, the harness also features a standard webbing attachment to secure binoculars safely. item.g:title: Fjallraven Sormland Tapered Trousers Dark Grey
item.g:description: Fjallraven Sormland Tapered Trousers Dark Grey are designed for comfortable hunting in hardwearing, quiet G-1000® Silent, with tapered legs that fit easily into the shaft of a pair of rubber boots. Developed for easier hunting in a timeless, simple style, they are equally suited to the shooting range and everyday use. The wind and water resistant fabric effectively ventilates moisture, while the regular fit has a mid waist that is slightly higher at the back for added comfort when squatting down or carrying a backpack with a hipbelt. Practical details include a knife pocket on the right-hand leg, two hand pockets and back pockets with buttons. Reinforced brace zones allow easy attachment of braces, while the raw-length leg endings can be adapted to suit your own height. item.g:title: Fjallraven Sormland Padded Jacket Deep Forest
item.g:description: Fjallraven Sormland Padded Jacket Deep Forest is a windproof and waterproof hunting jacket made from hardwearing, rustle-free G-1000® Silent with a Hydratic liner. Lightly padded with PrimaLoft® Black Insulation RISE with P.U.R.E. Technology, it provides extra warmth for colder days while retaining a simple, classic style suited to the forest, work and urban settings. Practical storage includes a Napoleon pocket, bellows pockets, internal pockets and easily accessible hand pockets. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Classic Sweater Green
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Classic Sweater Green is a cosy everyday layer made from 100% organic cotton, designed for relaxed wear indoors or outside. Its lofty triple-thread fleece has a smooth outer and soft brushed inside for extra warmth and comfort. A relaxed fit with dropped shoulders keeps the shape easy to wear, while the ribbed neckline, cuffs and hem add a neat finish. Wear it on its own for casual days or as a light, breathable mid layer, with the embroidered Fjällräven logo adding a classic touch. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Anorak Green
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Vardag Anorak Green brings classic outdoor styling to hiking, day trips and everyday wear throughout the year. Made from durable, wind- and water-resistant G-1000®, it offers weather protection without being waterproof. The loose fit leaves room for layering, while the long front zip and side zippers make it easy to pull on and take off. An adjustable hood adds coverage, with zipped hand pockets and a buttoned kangaroo pocket providing practical storage. Simple, functional and designed for long-lasting use, it is a versatile layer for changing conditions. PRODUCT FEATURES G-1000®: 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton Wind- and water-resistant, not waterproof Adjustable hood Long front zipper with buttoned placket Side zippers for ventilation and easy pull on/off Zippered hand pockets Buttoned kangaroo pocket Loose fit for layering

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Raven Parka Green
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Raven Parka Green is a practical update of a 1970s Fjällräven favourite, with an extended silhouette that provides extra coverage below the hips. The wind- and water-resistant G-1000® fabric combines recycled polyester and organic cotton for a versatile multi-season layer. A stowable hood, adjustable cuffs and an internal waist drawcord help you adapt the fit, while the two-way zip and buttoned storm flaps add coverage when weather changes. Four large bellows pockets give plenty of room for essentials, with side openings on the chest pockets for quick access and hand warmth. PRODUCT FEATURES G-1000®: 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton Wind- and water-resistant Extended cut below the hips Stowable hood Inside drawcord at waist Adjustable cuffs Two buttoned chest pockets with side openings, bellows and flaps Two buttoned lower pockets with bellows and flaps Two-way front zipper with buttoned storm flaps Designed for easy repair

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Kiruna Hydratic Padded Parka Dark Navy
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Kiruna Hydratic Padded Parka Dark Navy is a warm, knee-length winter layer designed for cold and wet conditions. A fully waterproof Hydratic membrane helps keep rain out, while the durable G-1000® outer resists wind and wear. Lightweight PrimaLoft® insulation provides warmth even when damp, making it well suited to everyday winter wear and weekend walks. The updated hood features a protective brim for extra shelter, while an adjustable waist allows you to refine the fit. Warm hand pockets keep essentials close and provide a useful place for cold hands. PRODUCT FEATURES G-1000®: 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton Fully lined with waterproof Hydratic membrane PrimaLoft® insulation for warmth when damp Recycled polyamide liner and lining Knee-length design Updated hood with protective brim Two-way front zipper Press-button closures at collar, hem and cuffs Warm hand pockets Adjustable waist

item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Stina Padded Jacket Green is a practical, hip-length layer that brings the familiar Stina style into a warmer padded design. item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Abisko Padded Vest Black offers extra insulation without taking up much room in your pack. item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Keb GTX Jacket Black
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Keb GTX Jacket Black combines a technical trekking design with waterproof, windproof and breathable GORE-TEX® protection. The jacket uses a GORE-TEX® ePE-based membrane and DWR finish, with a recycled polyamide shell. Its superior cut is designed for a precise fit and enhanced freedom of movement, while the adjustable hood protects without restricting vision or head movement. Two vertical zipped front pockets can be reached while wearing a harness or backpack, and underarm zipped openings provide ventilation. The two-way front zipper adds versatility, while the overall design is guided by repairability so the jacket is made to be maintained rather than replaced. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Black Technical jacket for trekking GORE-TEX® ePE-based membrane Waterproof, windproof and breathable DWR finish Superior cut with enhanced freedom of movement Adjustable hood Two vertical zipped front pockets Pockets accessible with a climbing harness or backpack Two-way front zipper Zipped ventilation openings under the arms Shell: recycled polyamide GORE-TEX® Performance 3-Layer Plain Weave Laminate: 59% recycled polyamide 70D, 21% ePE/polyurethane, 20% polyamide 15D GORE-TEX® ePE membrane made from polyethylene Designed for repairability Model wears a different colour for illustrative purposes

item.g:title: Devold Nansen Wool Sock Falcon
item.g:description: Devold Nansen Wool Sock Falcon is a thick, warm and comfortable sock made from 80% pure new Norwegian wool. Designed for cold overnight mountain trips and warming your feet after a long day outside, its tight knit helps avoid bulking while the flexible construction provides a stable fit. Wool does not support bacterial growth, helping to prevent odour, so the socks rarely need washing and can simply be aired out. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Falcon 80% pure new Norwegian wool Thick and warm construction Rib-knitted welt Tight knit to avoid bulking Flexible and stable fit Wool does not support bacterial growth Helps prevent odour Rarely needs washing; air out instead

item.g:title: Jackman GG Sweat BB Shirt Old Glove
item.g:description: Jackman GG Sweat Crewneck Old Glove is made in Japan from 100% cotton, combining No.10 yarn on the face with thicker No.7 yarn on the reverse for a dense, weighty feel. Inspired by early-1900s stand-collar uniforms, the mid-weight fabric works as both outerwear and a layering piece. Dual chest pockets use gusseted construction for added dimension and functionality, while side slits at the hem allow greater ease of movement. Stabilising fabric inside the cuffs helps prevent twisting and maintain a clean shape over time. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Old Glove Made in Japan 100% cotton No.10 yarn on the face Thicker No.7 yarn on the reverse Dense, weighty fabric Mid-weight construction Inspired by early-1900s stand-collar uniforms Dual chest pockets with gusseted construction Side slits at the hem Stabilising fabric inside the cuffs Designed to prevent cuff twisting and maintain shape Suitable as outerwear or a layering piece

item.g:title: Jackman GG Sweat Crewneck Old Glove
item.g:description: Jackman GG Sweat Crewneck Old Glove is made in Japan from 100% cotton, using No.10 yarn on the face and thicker No.7 yarn on the reverse for a dense, weighty feel. The updated design features a discreet shoulder reinforcement panel sewn on the reverse, using rib fabric to follow the natural curve of the shoulders and improve the fit over time. Flat-seam cuffs and hem, W-gussets at the front and back of the neckline, and a combination of flat-seam, single-needle overlock and three-needle decorative stitching create a sweatshirt designed to resist distortion and develop a lived-in feel with wear. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Old Glove Made in Japan 100% cotton No.10 yarn on the face Thicker No.7 yarn on the reverse Dense, weighty fabric Reverse-side shoulder reinforcement panel Rib fabric shoulder panel follows the natural shoulder curve Flat-seam cuffs and hem Front and back W-gussets at the neckline Flat-seam stitching at the sides Single-needle overlock covering Three-needle decorative stitching Designed to resist distortion and develop a lived-in feel with wear

item.g:title: Black + Blum Explorer Flask Duo Large Stainless Steel
item.g:description: Black + Blum Explorer Flask Duo Large Stainless Steel is a 1.4L flask designed for sharing, with two double-walled stainless steel cups and a reinforced vegan leather strap for carrying or pouring. Made from 304/18-8 stainless steel, it keeps drinks hot or cold for 24 hours, while the steel cap lid provides easy pouring and a silicone gasket helps prevent drips when the cups are stored. Its reinforced structure and wide-based cups offer added stability on rough ground. PRODUCT FEATURES 1.4L capacity Weight: 870g 304/18-8 stainless steel Silicone, nylon and polypropylene Vegan leather BPA-free 100% leak proof Keeps drinks hot or cold for 24 hours Two double-walled stainless steel cups Reinforced vegan leather strap for carrying or pouring Steel cap lid with easy pouring mechanism Reinforced structure Silicone gasket to prevent drips from cups when stored Wide-based cups for extra stability on rough ground Dishwasher safe, remove strap first

item.g:title: Fjallraven Womens Keb Fleece Crew Neck Mesa Purple
item.g:description: Fjallraven Womens Keb Fleece Crew Neck Mesa Purple is a lightweight fleece designed for year-round active use, working as a sweater or an insulating, moisture-wicking mid layer. Its smooth outer surface and brushed inner side provide warmth and comfort, while flatlocked seams help reduce bulk. A hidden zipped side pocket keeps a phone or cards secure, and low-profile thumbholes at the cuffs add practical comfort. Reflective details, a drawcord with reflective threads and a Fjällräven fox logo on the sleeve complete the design. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Mesa Purple 20% wool, 73% polyester, 7% elastane Lightweight sweater or insulating, moisture-wicking mid layer Smooth outside with brushed inside Flatlocked seams to reduce bulk Low-profile thumbholes in cuffs Hidden zipped side pocket Reflective details Drawcord with reflective threads Fjällräven fox logo on sleeve Model wears a different colour for illustrative purposes

item.g:title: Fjallraven Expedition Down Lite Jacket Black Edition
item.g:description: Fjallraven Expedition Down Lite Jacket Black Edition is a lighter take on the 1974 Expedition Down jacket, combining dependable warmth with an all-black design. Down is placed in sewn-through channels to retain heat, while synthetic shoulder padding helps resist moisture and pressure from a pack. The jacket is 8 cm shorter for enhanced freedom of movement, with an adjustable hood, two-way zip and adjustable hem for changing conditions. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Black Edition Material: 100% recycled polyamide Lining: 100% recycled polyamide Filling: 90% goose down, 10% feather Supreme Microloft: 100% polyester Down padding in sewn-through channels Synthetic shoulder padding 8 cm shorter than the Expedition Down jacket Adjustable hood with all-black drawstrings and leather details Three internal pockets: two open and one zippered Spacious top-loading pockets with side openings Two-way zip with buttoned flap Adjustable hem Matt-black press buttons with Fjällräven fox logo DWR finish

item.g:title: RRL By Ralph Lauren Unconstructed Corduroy Sport Coat Distressed Brown
item.g:description: RRL By Ralph Lauren Unconstructed Corduroy Sport Coat Distressed Brown brings a vintage character to French cotton corduroy with a heavily washed and pigmented finish. Canvas elbow patches and trim feature on the long sleeves, while the half-lined construction includes several practical pockets and a single vent. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Distressed Brown Body: 100% cotton French cotton corduroy Unconstructed design Heavily washed down and pigmented for a lived-in, vintage look Notch lapels Buttonhole at the left lapel Three-roll-two silhouette Corozo buttons Long sleeves with canvas elbow patches Buttoned cuffs with canvas trim Left chest welt pocket Two front waist snapped pockets Two interior chest pockets Single vent Half-lined Front lining: 53% cotton, 47% cupro Sleeve lining: 100% polyester Yoke lining: 100% cotton Machine washable Imported Due to the natural characteristics of this material, the colouring may rub off onto fabrics and upholstery

item.g:title: Patagonia Houdini Jacket Black w/Black
item.g:description: The Patagonia Houdini Jacket is a lightweight, packable layer made for active adventures and unpredictable weather. Constructed from recycled nylon ripstop, it provides protection from light moisture while offering a slim, comfortable fit with a slightly extended back hem for ease of movement. Product Features Lightweight shell made from 100% recycled nylon ripstop DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS Provides protection against light moisture Slim fit with a slightly dropped back hem Adjustable one-pull hood designed to preserve peripheral vision Half-elastic cuffs provide a secure, comfortable fit Adjustable drawcord hem helps seal out cool air Chest pocket doubles as an integrated stuffsack for easy storage Reinforced loop for carabiner attachment Reflective P-6 logo detail on the left chest Produced in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory

item.g:title: RoToTo Washi Dress Socks Navy
item.g:description: RoToTo Washi Dress Socks are thin, breathable dress socks knitted with washi yarn, combining its crisp feel with the smoothness of cotton. The washi and polyester blend offers moisture absorption and release properties to help maintain a dry feel, while compact-spun cotton yarn helps suppress pilling. A linking technique at the toe removes raised seams and unevenness for a more comfortable fit, while the slim construction makes them well suited to tight leather shoes. PRODUCT FEATURES Knitted with washi yarn Washi and polyester yarn blend with moisture absorption and release properties Compact-spun cotton yarn helps suppress pilling Breathable fabric with a crisp washi feel and smooth cotton finish Thin construction, suitable for tight leather shoes Toe finished with a linking technique to reduce seams and unevenness Material: 44% Polyester, 22% Cotton, 33%, 1% Polyurethane Avoid using a dryer as it may cause shrinkage Country of origin: Japan

item.g:title: RoToTo Coarse Ribbed Crew Socks College Colors Faded Black / Vintage Orange
item.g:description: RoToTo Coarse Ribbed Crew Socks College Colors take inspiration from retro tube socks popular on the American West Coast in the late 1970s. Knitted on a limited number of special knitting machines using thick, sturdy cotton yarn, they feature a long pile knit on the sole for a distinctive bouncy feel. The simple ribbed design works across sporty skater looks and traditional styles, while the delicate surface should be protected from abrasion. item.g:title: Patagonia Torrentshell 3L Rain Jacket Black
item.g:description: Patagonia Torrentshell 3L Rain Jacket Black features a waterproof/breathable H2No™ Performance Standard 3-layer shell designed with long-term waterproof durability. The fabric, membrane and DWR finish are made without intentionally added PFAS. A two-way-adjustable hood with laminated visor rolls down and stows with a simplified cord-and-hook design, while the microfleece-lined neck provides comfort with a waterproof/breathable barrier. item.g:title: Patagonia Down Sweater Hoody Jacket Treeline Green
item.g:description: Patagonia Down Sweater Hoody Jacket Treeline Green features a durable NetPlus® 100% postconsumer recycled nylon ripstop shell made from recycled fishing nets to help reduce ocean plastic pollution. The lightweight, windproof jacket is insulated with 800-fill-power 100% Responsible Down Standard down certified by Control Union (CU 880272), with quilting patterned for warmth and movement. Its single-pull-adjustable hood, nylon-bound elastic cuffs and cord-lock hem are designed around the supplied warmth features, while multiple zipped and drop-in pockets provide storage. PRODUCT FEATURES Lightweight and windproof NetPlus® 100% postconsumer recycled nylon ripstop shell Recycled fishing nets used to make the shell, helping reduce ocean plastic pollution DWR finish made without intentionally added PFAS 800-fill-power 100% Responsible Down Standard down Down certified by Control Union (CU 880272) Quilting patterned for warmth and movement Single-pull-adjustable hood Centre-front zipper with interior storm flap and zipper garage at the chin Two on-seam, zippered, welt handwarmer pockets One zippered interior-chest pocket converts to a stuffsack with a carabiner clip-in loop Two interior drop-in pockets Comfortable nylon-bound elastic cuffs seal in warmth Adjustable hem with a cord lock Repair patch included for quick fixes on the go Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory

item.g:title: Patagonia Nano Puff Hoody Deer Brown
item.g:description: Patagonia Nano Puff Hoody Deer Brown is a lightweight, packable synthetic insulation layer with a 100% recycled polyester shell and lining. Its lightweight 100% recycled polyester ripstop shell has a durable water repellent finish made without intentionally added PFAS to shed light moisture, with matching recycled polyester ripstop lining. The brick quilting and horizontal side panels stabilise the insulation, while an improved shoulder fit and elbow articulation provide better mobility. item.g:title: Patagonia Capilene Lightweight Zip-Neck Blue Sage
item.g:description: Patagonia Capilene Lightweight Zip-Neck Blue Sage features a lightweight, highly moisture-wicking fabric that dries quickly and feels silky next to the skin. The half-zip design keeps bulk low while allowing easy venting, with internal neck tape and a locker loop for added functionality. Set-in seams and an underarm gusset promote movement, while low-profile thumb loops provide secure hand coverage and minimal seams help increase comfort. A secure left-chest patch pocket is made from NetPlus® 100% postconsumer recycled nylon faille, while two front welt pockets feature brushed-tricot mesh pocket bags. Set-in sleeves allow a wide range of motion, with elasticated cuffs and a soft, cleanly finished hem. item.g:title: Patagonia Insulated Boulder Fork Rain Jacket Smolder Blue
item.g:description: Patagonia Insulated Boulder Fork Rain Jacket Smolder Blue combines a waterproof H2No™ Performance Standard 3-layer shell with 40-g Thermogreen™ 100% recycled polyester insulation for breathable warmth and weather protection. The regular-fit jacket has a low-profile adjustable hood with a laminated visor, watertight zippers and functional pockets, while streamlined cuffs and an adjustable hem help seal out the weather. The fabric, membrane and DWR finishes are made without intentionally added PFAS, and the jacket is made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory. item.g:title: Snow Peak x Merrell Agility Peak 6 Boa SP Trainer Blue
item.g:description: Snow Peak x Merrell Agility Peak 6 Boa SP Trainer Blue combines trail-ready performance with a precise, adjustable fit in a special-edition collaboration between Snow Peak and MERRELL. Inspired by the blue-grey tones of the landscape before dawn, it features reflective detailing, a clear BOA® dial and a glow-in-the-dark insole logo. Designed for hiking, trail running, camping, travel and everyday wear, it pairs a FloatPro™ foam midsole with a Vibram® MegaGrip outsole and traction lugs for grip, propulsion and mud shedding. PRODUCT FEATURES Colour: Blue Mesh, synthetic and TPU upper BOA® Fit System with PerformFit™ Wrap construction Bellows tongue to help prevent pebbles and sand from entering Padded collar 3D-printed TPU overlays in high-wear areas 100% recycled mesh lining Mesh footbed cover made with 5% recycled materials Cleansport NXT™ antimicrobial and odour-resistant treatment Removable footbed made with 5% recycled PU FLEXconnect® dual flex groove construction Lightweight protective plate FloatPro™ foam midsole Vibram® MegaGrip outsole Vibram® Traction lug technology for propulsion and mud shedding Reflective upper overlays and logos Glow-in-the-dark insole logo

item.g:title: Fjallraven Skogso Jacket Suede Brown
item.g:description: Fjallraven Skogso Jacket Suede Brown is a hip-length trekking jacket with a slightly longer back, adjustable hood and practical ventilation for outdoor use or cycling to and from work. Made from G-1000® Lite with reinforced G-1000® on the shoulders and hood, it is designed to protect against wind and light rain showers. The front has a two-way zip concealed by a protective placket with push buttons, while the adjustable hem and sleeve cuffs help refine the fit. PRODUCT FEATURES G-1000® Lite in the body with G-1000® reinforcement on the shoulders and hood Hip-length design with dropped tail Fixed, adjustable hood Pre-shaped elbows Two-way front zip with placket and button closure Two vertical chest pockets and two hand pockets covered with plackets Adjustable hem Push-button sleeve cuffs G-1000® Lite: 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton G-1000®: 65% recycled polyester, 35% organic cotton

item.g:title: Fjallraven Pine Half Zip Microfleece Laurel Green
item.g:description: Fjallraven Pine Half Zip Microfleece Laurel Green is a lightweight and supersoft top in microfleece, designed as an intermediate layer or base layer. A half zip at the front leads to a high collar, while forward-positioned flatlock seams at the shoulders help prevent chafing when carrying a backpack. The regular fit keeps the design simple and comfortable. It has a straight collar, buttoned placket and long sleeves with buttoned cuffs, while the chest and waist patch pockets add practical detailing. The left chest pocket is finished with the signature embroidered Pony. item.g:title: YETI Rambler Shot Glasses and Carrying Case Black
item.g:description: YETI Rambler Shot Glasses and Carrying Case are made for keeping four shot glasses together and ready to take wherever they are needed. Each glass stacks neatly inside the fitted carrying container, making the set easy to pack for a post-hunt toast or a drink on the boat. Made from kitchen-grade 18/8 stainless steel, the shot glasses are puncture and rust-resistant, while DuraCoat™ colours do not peel or crack. PRODUCT FEATURES Four shot glasses Fitted carrying container Stackable design 18/8 kitchen-grade stainless steel Puncture and rust-resistant Dishwasher safe DuraCoat™ colours do not peel or crack
